raw.title: Growth Associate
raw.description:
As Sales Development Representative, you sit at the front of how Electric Twin grows. You decide which accounts deserve our attention, get us into rooms with the people who run insights, brand and strategy at large organisations, and hand the sales team conversations worth having.


You'll report into Sales with a dotted line into Marketing. Lead generation comes from Marketing, so there is a steady flow of inbound interest, event contacts and campaign responses to work. Your job is to turn that flow, plus your own account research and outbound, into qualified meetings that convert.


This is a broad remit for an Growth Associate. You won't just be working a queue. You'll own the territory map, decide where the effort goes, and build the outbound systems that make the next quarter easier than the last.


It suits someone early in a sales career who is genuinely curious about how large organisations make decisions, comfortable writing to senior people, and organised enough to run a patch rather than react to whatever lands in the inbox.

What You'll Do

  • Own the TAM map. Build and maintain our view of the total addressable market: who fits the ICP, how many of them there are, and where the concentration sits by sector, geography and company size. Keep it current as the product and the category move. This is the document the rest of GTM plans against.


    Identify and work focus accounts for ABM. Choose the named accounts worth a coordinated push. Research the buying group inside each one: who owns insights, who owns the budget, who feels the pain. Work with Marketing to sequence air cover and outbound so an account hears from us in a joined-up way. You will also own the ABM motion, ensuring the demand we drive on top of the funnel by sector is harnessed downstream and turned into leads. 


    Map signals to the funnel. Define the signals that tell us an account is in motion: leadership changes in insights or brand, hiring patterns, funding, agency reviews, content engagement, event attendance, competitor mentions. Then map those signals onto the funnel so we know where our ABM accounts sit and how they move through the funnel. You will co-ordinate with our growth lead to execute focused ABM campaigns for those insights. An account that has read one blog post needs something different from one whose Head of Insights has just downloaded the accuracy whitepaper. Getting that routing right is what ensures we deliver relevance at scale.

     

    Run outbound that sounds like a person. Build and run multichannel sequences across email, Lemlist, LinkedIn and phone. Write plainly, in first person, with a real reason for the message and a low-stakes ask. Test angles, track what earns replies, and retire what doesn't.

     

    Turn events into pipeline. Work with Marketing on the conferences, roundtables and industry events we attend. Build the target invite list, run pre-event outreach to book meetings into the diary, work the room on the day, and drive the follow-up afterwards so every conversation is logged and progressed. Events only pay back if someone owns the week after them.

     

    Set up and qualify meetings. Run first conversations that establish whether there is a real problem, a budget, a timeline and a route to a decision. Qualify honestly, including out. A well-reasoned disqualification is worth more to the team than a meeting that wastes an AE's afternoon.

     

    Hand over properly. Brief the AE before every meeting: what the account does, what triggered the conversation, who is in the room, what they said, and what good looks like from here. Stay close after handover so nothing stalls in the gap.

     

    Keep HubSpot clean. Log activity, maintain accurate contact and account records, and keep pipeline stages honest. Our forecasting, our signal routing and our marketing attribution all rest on what you enter.

     

    Close the loop with Marketing. You'll hear objections, language and competitor mentions before anyone else. Feed that back so campaigns, content and messaging reflect what the market is actually saying. Flag which sources produce meetings that convert and which produce noise.

Tools you'll use

  • We run a full AI stack and we expect whoever takes this role to get properly fluent in it, then push it further than we have.


    HubSpot for CRM, pipeline and reporting. Clay for enrichment, list building and capturing the signals that drive account routing. lemlist and Instantly for outbound sequencing and deliverability. n8n and similar workflow automation for joining the stack together so data moves without anyone copying it by hand. Claude Code for building your own tooling: research agents, enrichment scripts, briefing generators, whatever removes the repetitive part of the job.


    We'd rather hire someone who reads the docs and builds the automation than someone who arrives already knowing every logo on that list.

Your First Sixth Months

  • Month one. Learn the product properly. You get to know our ICP and sit in on customer calls and demos. You get  to know the current pipeline, the stack, and the ABM accounts already in motion.


    Months two and three. Deliver the first version of the TAM map and a shortlist of ABM focus accounts. Agree the signal set with Marketing and get the first routing rules live. Start running outbound sequences and booking qualified meetings. Own follow-up for at least one event end to end.


    Months four to six. Hit a consistent monthly meeting target. Have a repeatable outbound motion that isn't dependent on you improvising each week, signal routing running automatically rather than manually, and a clear view of which segments and messages convert.

What You'll Bring

  • Above everything, we're looking for a fast learner and a systems thinker. Someone who sees a task done three times by hand and builds the workflow that removes it, who is comfortable picking up an unfamiliar tool and having it working by the end of the week, and who thinks in terms of the whole funnel rather than their own inbox. The stack is only as good as the person wiring it together, and the right hire will take it several steps beyond where we've got it.


    Beyond that: you should be able to think about a market, write clearly to senior people, and stay organised without being chased. Some SDR, BDR or comparable commercial experience helps, as does familiarity with HubSpot or a similar CRM. Interest in market research, insights, brand strategy or behavioural science is a real advantage, because you'll be talking to people who do this for a living.

Network Production Engineer
raw.description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Production Engineering Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

  • Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.

  • Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up.

  • Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

Role Scope

  • Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers.

  • Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours.

  • Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs.

  • Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in.

  • Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

  • You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it.

  • You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution.

  • You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone.

  • You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet.

  • You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again.

  • You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero.

  • Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling.

Salary & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

  • Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

raw.title: Senior Quality Engineer
raw.description:
About Freetrade

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

About the role

As a Senior Quality Engineer at Freetrade, you will be embedded in our mobile team, testing our iOS and Android apps and helping us move from largely manual testing towards a more automated approach. You will extend our existing TypeScript mobile test framework and help build quality in earlier, working alongside engineers in a collaborative team that wants to shift left. You’ll get coaching, mentoring and support from our Staff Quality Engineer.

What you’ll do

  • Hands-on functional, acceptance and planned, risk-based exploratory testing of our native iOS and Android apps

  • Be instrumental in the implementation of mobile tests that support the CI/CD pipeline for the software stacks and frameworks we support (TS, XCode, WebdriverIO)

  • Work with the Staff QE to ensure the rollout and socialisation of proactive quality information, plans and reports to project teams, enabling them to make better decisions around processes, solutions and releases

  • Advocate for, coach and educate project teams on the contextual use of testing techniques that allow us to embed shift-left and shift-right testing practices

  • Bring a quality lens to ideas before they’re built, working with engineers, product and design (e.g. Three Amigos)

  • Work comfortably in ambiguity: find gaps, chase down requirements and take initiative without being spoon-fed

  • Contribute to upcoming projects, including acceptance testing to support the backend re-architecture and our quality strategy refresh

  • Use AI tools to move faster and go broader, with appropriate guardrails to keep quality high

About You

  • Hands-on experience testing iOS and Android apps, and adding tests to an existing automation framework (we use TypeScript; familiarity helps and tool agnosticism is welcome)

  • A blend of manual and automated testing, with breadth across testing types (functional, acceptance and exploratory, with non-functional a bonus) and the judgement to know which to use when

  • You’ve owned testing and built things, such as a framework, automation or a test process your team adopted

  • Strong written and verbal communication (fluent English) and influencing skills, comfortable sharing test plans and reports and advising engineers, product owners and project managers

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with uncertainty, curious, and looks for gaps and negative cases

  • Pragmatic: you know what “good enough” looks like and help teams ship

  • Experience in exploratory testing and/or requirements discovery

  • Strong independent testing skills and opinions, and a curious but pragmatic view of AI

We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Whatever your race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability - we want to hear from you.

To find out more about how we look after your personal data when you apply for a job with us, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy here.

Please note we are not accepting agency CVs.

Location: London (3 days a week in office)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer, healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

 

Role Purpose

This is a rare opportunity for a graduate to sit close to the heart of our Healthcare business. You'll work directly with Healthcare leadership and colleagues across corporate development, commercial and marketing, turning data and market insight into the business cases, proposals and strategic narratives that shape where Genomics goes next. If you want your analysis to influence real decisions from day one – not sit in a spreadsheet – this is the role.

 

A Day in the Life

  • Analyse & advise: You'll work with Healthcare leadership and teams across the business to turn data into insight that drives real decisions.

  • Track performance: You'll track key performance metrics and keep the data behind them accurate and trustworthy.

  • Build the case: You'll help build business cases, presentations and proposals that support sales pitches and internal investment decisions.

  • Scan the market: You'll spot emerging trends across pharma and therapeutics, and help the team get ahead of them.

  • Tell the story: You'll help craft compelling narratives for client presentations and strategic conversations.

Who You Are

  • Data-curious: A graduate (or equivalent experience) in Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field, comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets and keen to learn tools like Power BI or Tableau.

  • Genuinely interested in healthcare: You have a genuine interest in healthcare, pharmaceuticals and therapeutics, and enjoy following market trends and dynamics.

  • Detail-driven: You take pride in accuracy, keep things organised, and can manage several threads of work at once.

  • A clear communicator: You can explain complex ideas simply, and you're just as comfortable contributing in a team as working independently.

  • Self-motivated: You take initiative, follow through, and bring energy to everything you do.

     

Your Package

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

Compensation & Growth

  • Competitive Reward: Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure market-aligned compensation.

  • Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal.

  • Continuous Learning: Including external courses and a wide library of L&D materials, because your growth is our success.

Wellbeing & Time Off

  • Holiday: 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end.

  • Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance.

  • Enhanced Leave: Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents.

Work Environment & Culture

  • Hybrid Working

  • Truly Inclusive Time Off: Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you.

  • Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate.

  • Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs.

Ready to Build the Future?

If this opportunity excites you, apply now!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

raw.title: Fleet Shift Manager
raw.description:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 
 

Role Overview 📝

he Fleet Shift Manager oversees the work of the Fleet Coordinators. This team owns the day-to-day control, inspection, and performance of the vehicle fleet, ensuring vehicles are safe, available, compliant, and cost-controlled.

This team is responsible for early detection of damage and risk, fast recovery of repair costs, and close coordination with Maintenance and Operations to protect vehicle uptime and service reliability.

This team is also responsible for Fleet coordinating Delivery Driver daily vehicle collection & return.

This role involve team management as well as execution support.

Location will be primarily at one of our vehicle storage locations, but will involve some travel to and time at the nearby Depot. You may be asked to - very occasionally - support at our other Depot.

You will be working 5 in 7 days; this could be either Sun-Thurs or Tues-Sat.

You will report to one of our Fleet Senior Managers.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

Team management:

  • Ensure high process adherence and standards on-site, across Front-end and Back-end teams

  • Manage team of Coordinators & Night Chargers

  • Ensure coverage in case of sickness / absence

  • Escalate & fix issues

Execution support:

  • Daily on-site execution support

  • 2 mornings / week - vehicle inspections at different site

  • Cover for team-members’ sickness / holidays as needed

Vehicle-related responsibilities:

  • Ensure all vehicles are inspected, logged, and controlled to agreed standards.

  • Carry out basic repairs where possible and collaborate with local garage for more complex repairs

  • Coordinate repairs and servicing with Fleet Maintenance to minimise downtime.

  • Coordinate On the Road Breakdown with Fleet Maintenance/Third Party Partners to minimise downtime.

  • Protect fleet uptime through early issue identification and prioritisation.

  • Monitor driver behaviour and escalate safety or performance risks.

  • Ensure key management processes followed & regularly audit keys.

  • Ensure full compliance with health & safety and fleet standards.

  • Produce clear fleet performance insights and improvement actions.

Driver-related responsibilities:

  • Morning shift:

    • Allocate & hand over vehicles to Delivery Drivers, & coordinate route allocation.

  • Evening shift:

    • Receive vehicle returns, ensure vehicles correctly returned with keys.

    • Receive undelivered parcels & return to Depot.

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • 2-5 years’ experience operating in operational roles or vehicle-related roles.

  • Experience of working with vehicles - uptime, light repairs, vehicle inspections, maintenance & servicing.

  • Experience managing teams successfully - achieving results, maintaining high standards.

  • Valid Driving licence (held for minimum of 12 mths, maximum 6 points)

  • High integrity & trustworthiness.

  • High urgency, proactivity, and ownership.

  • Comfortable solving real-time operational pressure during peak windows.

  • Able to communicate effectively & build relationships & work cross-functionally

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Dynamic working environment with a diverse and driven team

  • Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays

    • if you're on a 4 days on - 4 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 18 days paid holiday plus public holidays

    • similarly on 4 days on - 3 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 20 days paid holiday plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

  • Bi-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans

  • Annual compensation review

  • Team lunch provided once a week

  • Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • Community volunteer days

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Dog friendly office and depots

  • MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)


🔍 Want to learn more?

  • HIVED is B Corporation certified

  • HIVED is #7 on The Sunday Times Tech 100

  • Read how HIVED raised $42M to transform parcel delivery with AI and all-electric logistics network

  • Check the Impact Reports for 2024 and 2025

  • Keep up with HIVED ✨ here ✨

raw.title: Senior / Staff ML Engineer (Routing & Optimisation)
raw.description:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 


Role Overview 📝

We're looking for a Senior or Staff ML / Operations Research Engineer to take on some of the hardest problems at HIVED: the planning systems that decide how every parcel moves through our 100% electric delivery network.

You'll join the Routing Squad, which owns HIVED's entire planning pipeline: demand forecasting, capacity planning and scheduling, sortation, our collections network and large-scale route optimisation. You'll design the optimisation, forecasting and ML models at the core of it, and bring them into production together with backend engineers, data scientists, analysts and our operations teams.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll shape how we model the network and your work shows up in the routes our drivers take, the cages filled at our depots and the parcels that arrive on time.

The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? How should parcels flow through sortation and our collections network so nothing is handled twice? How do we turn each day's parcels into routes that are efficient, reliable and on time? And how do we model the cost and geography of our network as we expand into new cities?

What You'll Be Doing 🚀

  • Build the models. Design and implement optimisation models and algorithms for routing, supply-demand matching, capacity planning and other core logistics challenges.

  • Turn ambiguity into models. Take complex operational problems, break them down, and see them through from first investigation to production.

  • Put models into production. Build and productionise optimisation, forecasting and ML models with our backend engineers, making them robust, observable and ready for peak volumes.

  • Explore new approaches. Lead the exploration and evaluation of new approaches, from linear programming and heuristics to machine learning-based optimisation.

  • Stay close to the operation. Work directly with operations teams, see how plans perform on the ground, and close the loop with data.

  • Raise the bar. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and set the standards for how we test and evaluate our models.

What We're Looking For 🔎

  • Typically 5+ years of experience building optimisation or ML models and shipping them into production systems.

  • A track record of technical ownership beyond your own work: you've shaped the modelling approach or direction of systems spanning multiple components or teams.

  • The ability to translate complex, ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact.

  • Solid coding skills: Python preferred, though experience in other languages like C++, Java or Go is also valued.

  • An appetite for hard optimisation problems: routing, scheduling, forecasting, supply-demand matching, or other constraint-heavy domains.

  • Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, data science, analytics and operations.

You also bring depth in at least one of:

  • Optimisation / operations research: linear and integer programming, constraint programming or heuristics, and integrating solvers such as OR-Tools or Gurobi into production systems.

  • Machine learning: forecasting and predictive models that feed planning decisions, from development to monitoring in production.

Technologies We Use 💻

  • Python, Go

  • AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL), CDK (TypeScript)

  • GCP, BigQuery, Looker

  • Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus

  • GitHub, GitHub Actions

  • Claude Code

  • Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design


Our interviewing process 🪜

  • Intro call with the hiring manager

  • Live coding challenge solving a problem

  • A take home case study, followed by a discussion

  • On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture)


Our Values

raw.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with near zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure. It’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company built to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Value Consulting team

The Pricing & Innovation team helps customers get the most from hx Renew, our market-leading SaaS pricing platform, and helps prospects and customers understand the value hx can create across pricing, underwriting and AI. Within it, Value Consulting turns complex customer problems into clear business cases, analysis and value stories that support better commercial decisions.

The team sits at the heart of our go-to-market motion, building the business cases and ROI stories that unlock strategic enterprise opportunities and drive adoption, expansion and long-term growth. You will work as a bridge between Sales, Product, Customer Success and senior customer stakeholders, turning ambiguous problems into quantified value stories that strengthen commercial conversations.

We are a small, high-ownership team. The culture is analytical, commercially minded and highly collaborative, with a strong expectation of independence, learning agility and comfort operating without a fully established playbook.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build clear, data-driven business cases and ROI models that quantify the financial impact of hx for prospects and customers, helping them make confident buying decisions.

  • Partner with Sales on strategic enterprise opportunities, getting involved early to shape tailored value narratives that accelerate deal cycles and increase win rates.

  • Run value workshops with stakeholders from junior underwriters to actuarial, pricing, transformation and executive leaders.

  • Develop benchmarking, ROI analysis and customer insight that give Sales and senior leaders compelling proof points for executive-level conversations.

  • Translate complex customer problems, workflows and data into simple, credible value stories.

  • Build the reusable models, benchmarks and templates that let Account Executives run a first-pass value case themselves on standard deals, so your time goes to the deals that need your judgement.

  • Continuously refine how we work, using AI and other tools to improve efficiency and impact.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Built robust business cases or ROI models for a technical or data-driven product, using clear assumptions and logic to demonstrate measurable commercial impact, that a buyer used to make a decision.

  • Presented numbers to a sceptical commercial or technical audience and held your ground when challenged.

  • Taken messy data and ambiguous customer problems through to clear, actionable recommendations, without close direction.

  • Translated complex quantitative analysis into simple, executive-ready stories or presentations that have influenced decision makers.

  • Worked cross-functionally with Sales, Product and Customer Success (or similar teams) to align on value drivers, messaging and success criteria.

  • Pushed back when a number was being stretched, because the case needed to be right.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer highly defined, static playbooks and feel uncomfortable operating in ambiguity or helping to build the motion as you go.

  • You are not motivated by digging into the details of financial models, customer data and assumptions to create credible, defensible analysis.

  • You find it difficult to challenge or influence senior stakeholders, or you avoid direct collaboration with Sales on commercial outcomes.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process. Our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations, and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager interview (1 hour)

  3. Skills assessment (1 hour)

  4. Values interview (1 hour)

  5. Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do; it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

raw.title: Office Manager (Part-time)
raw.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We're looking for an Office Coordinator

You'll run the day-to-day of our Leeds office, making it a well-run, safe and welcoming place for the iwocans who work from there.

The Leeds office is home to most of iwoca's collections, customer success and account management teams, plus smaller groups from across the business. It's the busiest midweek, when most teams come in together.

The office team looks after iwoca's four offices in London, Leeds, Berlin and Frankfurt, and the events that keep iwocans connected across them. The team is led by the Office & Community Manager, who is based in London.

The role

You'll report into our London based Office & Community Manager while acting as the autonomous onsite lead for our Leeds hub, keeping operations running smoothly and serving as the go-to person when something needs sorting

  • Ownership. You'll run the office day to day: the weekly food and drinks order, deliveries, post and supplies, and the office Soldo card, reconciled each month. You'll walk the office each week and fix small issues yourself.

  • Variety. You'll welcome visitors and candidates, sort out meeting room clashes, and book and oversee cleaners, tradespeople and suppliers, from the coffee machines and Billi taps to the plants.

  • Responsibility. You'll keep the office safe. You'll be one of the office's fire marshals and first aiders, carry out facilities maintenance checks, and keep the first aid kits stocked.

  • Community. You'll help iwocans in Leeds feel part of iwoca and enjoy being here. You'll run the weekly office tour for new joiners, help teams to celebrate key moments like work anniversaries and organise community events.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Office operations. You have at least a year's experience running the day-to-day of an office, including ordering, deliveries and visitors.

  • Suppliers and contractors. You have worked with building management, contractors and facilities suppliers, and held them to what they agreed to deliver.

  • Fixing things without being asked. You have been the person who spots what isn't working in an office and sorts it. You can talk us through examples.

  • The physical side. You're comfortable unpacking deliveries, setting up for events and moving supplies of up to 15–20kg.

Bonus:

  • First aid and fire safety. You hold first aid or fire marshal certificates. If not, we'll train you when you join.

  • Expenses. You have managed company expenses on Soldo or a similar platform.

  • Facilities qualification. You have an IWFM qualification or equivalent.

  • AI Literacy. Experience using generative AI tools to drive efficiency in administrative tasks, paired with the judgment to audit and fact-check all AI-generated content.

The salary

We expect to pay from £26,500 to £30,000 (pro rata for 20 hours a week) for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation: £26.5K – £30K

Analytics Engineer
raw.description:
Analytics Engineer

 

Location: London or Bristol (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Team: Data
Contract: Permanent
Reporting To: Analytics Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

  • Deliver reports end to end: Capture requirements and agree metric definitions, then build, test, publish and document reports, with dashboards that work for non-technical users.

  • Design data models independently: Build dbt models that meet business needs, and explain your design choices.

  • Work through gaps: Explain what data is available and what's missing, document your assumptions so gaps don't block delivery, and push to fill the ones that matter.

  • Write production-quality SQL: Write complex, performant SQL that follows the team style guide and coding standards.

  • Turn data into insight: Validate the data, find themes and patterns, and turn them into a clear story for stakeholders.

  • Support experiments: Design and interpret A/B tests with support, and help product teams act on the results.

  • Apply data security: Use role-based access and data classification in what you build, handle personal data requests, and raise data breaches through the right channels.

  • Support junior engineers: Help onboard and coach C1 engineers, and give clear code reviews.


What you’ll bring

  • Advanced SQL — window functions, nested data and time series; can tune and troubleshoot queries.

  • Production dbt — can build, test, document and release production dbt models independently using Git workflows.

  • Reporting and visualisation — experience of the full reporting lifecycle, from requirements and metric definitions to build, testing, publishing, documentation and clear dashboards.

  • Data modelling — can design dimensional models that meet business requirements and perform and scale well.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working?

 

You’ll be joining the Identity & Access Management (IAM) team, which sits within the Cyber Security squad in the Kaluza technology community, working hand-in-hand with security engineering as well as with Kaluza’s architecture team and technical leaders across our software engineering community. Your initial focus will be on our product IAM space, covering authentication & authorisation services that ensure the appropriate accesses are permitted on the Kaluza retail platform, whether that’s human or machine. The role will broaden over time to encompass our enterprise IAM and PAM solutions which protect us as a business, enabling us to better align these two aspects of IAM in use across Kaluza.

 

With millions of customers across multiple geographic regions, we naturally invest significant effort into availability, performance, security and observability, and the teams pride themselves on their ability to maintain a balance between rapid development of new services, iterative quality & feature enhancements alongside being highly responsive in incidents.

What will I be doing?

 

  • Collaborate with technical, product leadership to help shape and continuously improve our IAM technical strategy and solutions architecture

  • Lead the team hands-on in resolving complex technical issues, evaluating technical options, designing services and scoping engineering work

  • Work with client engineering teams to help them understand our IAM architecture and how to get the most out of our platform

  • Take the lead on evolving our identity and access best practices across engineering, proactively helping teams to apply these with expert advice and automation

  • Use your deep understanding of the IAM domain to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders across Kaluza as well as client teams

  • Mentoring and coaching engineers within the IAM space, helping them balance risk with speed and quality

  • Continuously improve quality across reliability, observability, functional and non-functional testing as well as development processes and documentation

  • Horizon scanning for emerging technologies and approaches to IAM, enabling Kaluza to continue to evolve, keeping us ahead of adversaries as well as cost-effective

What you will bring

 

  • Good experience of both mentoring engineers as well as developer collaboration (e.g. pairing, swarming)

  • Developing, testing, deploying and maintaining quality SaaS APIs in AWS

  • Working with (and continuous improvement of use with) fundamental DevSecOps engineering elements such as CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure As Code, Kubernetes containerization and platform health alerting & monitoring

  • Application of basic modern identity & access management techniques and standards, such as OAuth2.0 or SAML2.0

  • Integrating an IdP into services to enable SSO and/or federated identity

  • Use of encrypted JWTs as part of an OIDC-compliant user authentication flow and/or creating policies in an RBAC and ABAC environment

  • Experience of applying AI to your own work as well as enabling others to safely build it into their development ways of working

  • Working knowledge of Okta or equivalent solutions, to enable workforce identity and enforce access management policies

  • Experience of applying architectural and software design patterns in a complex domain/environment

  • Experience of being a senior subject matter expert in operational incidents

We would still encourage you to apply even if you don’t have experience of all of the above - we look for potential as much as skills fit.

  • Proficient at applying your technical and commercial knowledge to a risk based approach, taking the lead on assessing current and future technology and designs

  • A pragmatic decision-maker who takes into account the technical & commercial costs and consequences of those decisions

  • Skilled at identifying new or improved ways of working and driving efficiencies

  • Keen to drive compliance and NFR improvements within the platform to balance meeting information security and commercial goals

  • Accomplished at influencing both upwards and outwards, using a mixture of communications skills

  • Skilled in bringing alignment, clarity of thought and direction to information security, product and engineering challenges

  • Able to establish a clear vision for large-scale technical direction and champion alignment to that vision across multiple teams.

  • Experienced in fostering a culture of learning and improvement, challenging engineering leadership to better support this

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You'll be joining the Engineering Experience & AI Foundations team within our broader Kaluza Technology community. Your work will directly impact how Kaluza scales productivity safely and with high quality, and defines the gold standard for Agentic Software Development in the organisation. As a collective we strive for engineering greatness and support others to deliver engineering best practice with every commit.

In this role, you’ll play a pivotal role in architecting and evolving our Internal AI engineering platform and the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework (KASF). You'll be building the infrastructure—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to shared agentic workflows supporting the ways users interact with LLMs — that empower our software teams to move faster and more securely.

Our tech stack is very fluid, but broadly you can find yourself working with: LLMs (Claude, GPT, etc.), writing & deploying custom tools (APIs, user-interfaces, custom agents, bots), AWS, Kubernetes, MCP servers, Typescript, Scala, Go,, and modern observability tools.

Key responsibilities include:

  • AI Foundations & Tooling: Design, plan, build and evolve our AI platform foundations and tooling. This includes the Kaluza AI Control Plane (KAIC) and associated infra, AI Governance layer (MCP & LLM gateways), introducing and evolving shared Agents, Skills, Workflows and Standards.

  • AI Tooling Eval & Deployment: Support the trials, evaluation and deployment of next-generation engineering tools keeping Kaluza at the forefront of new technologies in the fast moving AI space.

  • Agentic SDLC: Working with different stakeholders and disciplines to build and evolve the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework and get it into the hands of our Engineering teams helping everyone adopt the best practices of those at the forefront of agentic tooling. Taking learnings and feedback from engineers/ stakeholders, coupled with metrics and advances from industry and applying them to improve and scale our software development capabilities safely and securely.

  • Champion Engineering Experience: Support the definition and evolution of engineering experience at Kaluza and enable our engineers to do more. Drawing on established frameworks such as DORA and SPACE alongside integrated tooling to surface trends, feedback and points of friction to drive improvements and optimisations across the organisation. Evolve our understanding and assessment of AI Metrics and their impact on outcomes.

  • Security & Usage Optimization: Partner with security and operations teams to ensure our AI usage reinforces our security safeguards and maximise our investments.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Systems Thinker: You possess a solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems and understand how to integrate third-party AI APIs (like Claude or OpenAI) without compromising system reliability or latency.

  • LLM know-how: You have extensive experience working with LLMs and kept pace with developments and trends in the space such as prompt, context and harness engineering as well as experience of multi-agent systems, evals / LLM-as-a-judge test suites.

  • Full-Stack Experience: You have hands-on experience across the stack and know what good looks like. Ideally you have experience with AWS in production, and you treat AI prompts, MCP configurations, and agent definitions with the same version-control rigor as your infrastructure.

  • The EngEx Mindset: You are passionate about engineer productivity. You don’t just build tools; you build experiences that make an engineer's day-to-day life easier and more creative. Supportive and empathetic towards others and able to make connections between symptoms and underlying causes.

  • Security & Governance: You understand the risks of AI (data leakage, prompt injection) and can design approval processes and security guardrails that protect the business without slowing down innovation.

  • Data-Informed: Comfortable authoring and interpreting metrics to help guide work, inform priorities, measure success —like tracking AI-generated code volume or PR velocity—to prove the value of the tools you deploy.

  • Collaboration: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs, and shared best practices for the wider engineering. community. Consideration for different audiences, including non-technical, being friendly, approachable and non-judgemental are key.

  • Curiosity: The AI landscape changes weekly. You are motivated to continuously trial new tools and aren't afraid to pivot when a better solution emerges.

raw.title: Senior Engineer II - EngEx AI Engineer
raw.description:
Senior Engineer II - EngEx & AI Engineer

● Location: UK Hybrid

● Level: TL1

● Team: Engineering Experience & AI Foundations

This role is based in the UK and requires an existing right to work in the UK.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You'll join the Engineering Experience & AI Foundations team within our broader Kaluza Technology community. Your work will directly impact how Kaluza scales productivity safely and with high quality, and defines the gold standard for Agentic Software Development in the organisation.

As a Senior II Engineer, you'll help set the technical direction for our Internal AI Engineering Platform and the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework (KASF). You'll design and implement the infrastructure, from Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to shared agentic workflows, and use your influence across teams to make it the way Kaluza builds software. In 2027, our goal is org wide adoption of KASF across engineering, and you'll be a technical owner of getting there safely, securely and with measurable impact on quality and velocity.

  • Technical Direction & Architecture: Drive the architecture and technical roadmap for our EngEx & AI Platform Foundations team, including the Kaluza AI Control Plane (KAIC), the AI governance layer (MCP and LLM gateways), and shared Agents, Skills, Workflows and Standards. Shape and document build-vs-buy decisions and balance fast-moving vendor capabilities against long-term platform stability.

  • Hands-On Delivery: Stay close to the implementation. Design, build and ship core platform components, set the engineering bar through your own code, and prototype new approaches to prove them before the team scales them.


  • Agentic SDLC (KASF) Adoption: Drive KASF from early adoption to all engineering teams during 2027. Oversee creation and evolution of reference architectures, standards and adoption playbooks, work with engineering leaders to embed KASF in how teams plan, build, review and ship, and use feedback and metrics to remove blockers.

  • AI Tooling Evaluation & Deployment: Lead structured, time-boxed trials of emerging engineering tools with clear success criteria and go/no-go recommendations. Keep Kaluza at the forefront of the AI space while retiring tools that don't earn their place.

  • Governance, Security & Risk: Act as the technical authority on AI risk for engineering. Work with Security, Legal and Data Protection to design approval processes and guardrails (data leakage, prompt injection, model access) that protect the business without slowing innovation.

  • Champion Engineering Experience: Support the definition and evolution of engineering experience at Kaluza and enable our engineers to do more. Drawing on established frameworks such as DORA and SPACE alongside integrated tooling to surface trends, feedback and points of friction to drive improvements and optimisations across the organisation. Evolve our understanding and assessment of AI Metrics and their impact on outcomes.

  • Cost Optimisation: Partner with Finance and Security to keep AI usage secure and cost-efficient at scale, including guardrails and unit economics for model spend.

  • Technical Leadership: Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers, lead design reviews, and raise the technical standard of the team and the wider engineering community. Influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, and build a network of AI champions in engineering teams. Pragmatic and open-minded and able to see things from different perspectives with both technical and non-technical cohorts.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Technical Leadership Experience: A substantial engineering background, with a track record of leading technical direction on platform, infrastructure or developer-experience work, and still hands-on in the code.

  • Production-Grade AI Implementation: Experience building and running production systems, ideally including LLM-based or agentic systems, and a deep interest in the "LLM-ops" lifecycle beyond chat interfaces, including evaluation, observability and reliability. Ideally experience across multiple model providers and multi-agent systems.

  • Systems Thinker: Strong distributed systems foundations and the judgement to integrate third-party AI APIs (Claude, OpenAI and others) without compromising reliability or latency.

  • Full-Stack Experience: You have hands-on experience across the stack and know what good looks like. Ideally you have experience with AWS in production, and you treat AI prompts, MCP configurations, and agent definitions with the same version-control rigor as your infrastructure.

  • The EngEx Mindset: You are passionate about engineer productivity. You don’t just build tools; you build experiences that make an engineer's day-to-day life easier and more creative. Supportive and empathetic towards others and able to make connections between symptoms and underlying causes.

  • Security & Governance First: You understand AI risks such as data leakage and prompt injection, and can design guardrails and approval processes that protect the business without slowing it down.

  • Data-Informed: You define success measures up front, automate the metrics AI-generated code volume, PR velocity, adoption), and change course when the data says so.

  • Influence & Communication: You can bring senior stakeholders and sceptical teams with you, and translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs and shared best practice.

  • Collaboration: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs, and shared best practices for the wider engineering. community. Consideration for different audiences, including non-technical, being friendly, approachable and non-judgemental are key.

  • Curiosity & Judgement: The AI landscape changes weekly. You enjoy trialling new tools, and you have the judgement to pivot, or to say no, when a better option emerges.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

raw.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
raw.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role:

  • We are looking for Mid-Market Account Executives.

  • This role is focused on selling into global mid-market businesses with distributed teams, multiple buying centres, layered governance, and high data sensitivity. These are strategic accounts where the impact of accurate hierarchies and clean CRM data is measured in millions.

  • Our first ramped AEs are far exceeding quota, so we know the motion works.

  • Our mid-market motion is working. We are generating strong demand and building pipeline within large organisations.

  • You will be responsible for driving high six-figure opportunities and are confident that we will close the first 7 figure deals this year through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Our targets call for millions of additional ARR over the next year. You will play a major role in that.

Important to Know:

  • Hours - This will be an exciting but intense job. Kernel is growing extremely fast and hours can often be long. Many of our customers are on the West Coast, and meetings can be held late in the evening.

  • Working location - Minimum 4 days a week in the London office (most people do 5). There will be international travel involved for this role in visiting prospects.

Responsibilities:

  • You’ll manage complex sales cycles with some of the best mid-market businesses out there, from mid six-figure through to seven-figure+ deals.

  • Multi-thread within accounts and build executive-level relationships, including VP and C-level stakeholders.

  • Most opportunities will be sourced for you by the SDR team and Growth team, however sourcing additional pipeline is expected.

  • You’ll collaborate with the wider team on GTM strategy as we expand our ICP & experiment in other verticals.

  • You’ll help to create our sales processes as you build them.

  • You’ll become the best person in the company at explaining & pitching the product.

  • You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and customer success, bringing in insights from across the company and performing an essential part of our product feedback loop.

Your Traits:

  • Entrepreneurial: creative, resourceful.

  • Executive presence: You are comfortable engaging VPs, CROs, CIOs, and senior RevOps leaders.

  • All-in: hard-working, excited to stretch yourself, willing to take out the trash.

  • Clear thinker, good writer: you can crisply articulate your ideas, goals, and plans and help our customers make sense of hairy consulting-like problems.

Essential Qualifications:

  • 2-5 years of experience.

  • At least 1 year consistently closing deals worth $50k+/year in a multi-stakeholder sales process, consistently hitting six- to seven-figure targets.

  • Ability to execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology (MEDDPICC).

  • Track record of consistent over-achievement in past sales roles.

  • Ability to discuss technical concepts with prospective customers and translate requirements into a demonstrable product.

  • Comfort negotiating and navigating contracts, security and legal discussions without support.

  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills.

Nice-To-Have:

  • Startup/scale-up experience is a plus.

  • Experience selling to Revenue Operations, GTM and/or Sales teams.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £110k-£140k OTE + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

Interview Process

Stage 1 – 30-minute intro call with Talent Partner. You’ll discuss your sales experience and motivations.

Stage 2 – 1-hour interview with Head of Sales. You’ll deep dive into your experience, sales targets & achievements, and Mid-Market AE at Kernel.

Stage 3 – Discovery role play (≤ 2 hours prep).

Final Stage – Founders interview with Anders (CEO) for culture and values alignment.

If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer.

Compensation: £110K – £140K • Offers Equity

  • • OTE £110K – £140K • Offers Equity
