raw.title: DeFi Quant Trader Intern (Credit) - London
raw.description:
DeFi Quant Trader Intern (Credit)

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

 

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

 

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

About the Internship Program

Our internship programme gives early-career talent the opportunity to build practical skills, contribute to meaningful projects and learn alongside experienced colleagues in digital finance.

Typically lasting six months and based in our Brussels office (London possible), each internship includes hands-on experience, clear learning goals and dedicated guidance and regular feedback. We look for curiosity, relevant foundational skills, deep, active interest and passion for digital assets and the potential to grow exponentially with us - you don’t need to arrive with all the answers. Where performance, business needs and available opportunities align, an internship may lead to a permanent role, though this is not guaranteed.

We are looking for 3-4 high-caliber Quantitative Analyst Interns to sit within our Strategic Market Making (HFT), Credit and Corporate Development desks/teams (see other openings on our career page for details).

Application deadline: 30 November 2026
Start date: 1 March 2027

Selection process:

  • Interview with Talent Acquisition representative

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Recruitment Challenge



The role
About Credit Desk

In our Credit & On-Chain Liquidity team, we design strategies and deploy capital across decentralized lending protocols, managed vaults, and credit facilities. Operating at the intersection of quantitative finance and smart contract technolgy, the Credit Desk is responsible for optimizing yield, evaluating counterparty and protocol risk, and deploying programmatic credit solutions across digital asset markets. As a Credit Desk DeFi Quant Trader Intern, you will work directly with quant traders and credit strategists to build quantitative risk models, automate yield harvesting, analyze on-chain liquidity pools, and evaluate DeFi protocol mechanics.

Key Responsibilities of a DeFi Quant Trader intern in this unit

  • On-Chain Risk & Credit Modeling: Develop and refine quantitative risk models to assess protocol health, collateralization ratios, liquidation risks, and smart contract vulnerability exposure across DeFi credit platforms.

  • Yield Optimization & Execution: Build Python-based tools and algorithmic models to analyze real-time yield curves, liquidity pool depth, and funding rate arbitrage across lending and borrowing protocols.

  • Data Analytics & Monitoring: Query on-chain data, EVM event logs, and lending protocol data using SQL, Subgraphs, and Python to generate actionable insights for credit positioning and risk allocation.

  • Protocol Due Diligence & Forensics: Perform quantitative forensics and stress testing on emerging lending primitives, liquid staking protocols, and structured credit products prior to capital deployment.

Who You Are/Key Requirements

  • Technical & Quantitative Skills: Strong code-first foundation in Python, familiarity with Rust with Solidity as a plus. Understanding of smart contract mechanics and DeFi primitive mathemtaics (including propAMMs, lending pool utilization curves, liquidation thresholds).

  • Quantitative & Trading Mindset: Rigorous background in a quantitative field (Math, Physics, CS, Finance, or Engineering) with a systematic/trading mindset. Ability to model yield dynamics, credit risk, backtesting strategies, and protocol insolvency scenarios.

  • DeFi “Skin in the Game”: Hands-on experience interacting with decentralized lending protocols (e.g., Aave, Morpho, Compound, Maker/Endgame), yield aggregators, or credit markets.

  • Nice-to-Haves: Familiarity with Rust, Solidity, Foundry, or specialized credit risk models and backtesting frameworks.

Our offer

  • A 6 month paid internship at world-renowned digital assets company with accommodation provided for entirety or part of it

  • The opportunity to learn about digital assets and blockchain from a 30,000 ft view of the entire ecosystem

  • Working from one of Brussels newest, nicest and most advanced office spaces

  • A global, collaborative and tech-driven environment.

  • Autonomy & Impact - our flat structure means you can contribute your ideas from day one and help shape the foundation that will power Keyrock’s future business.

  • Culture of Excellence - we value nimbleness, drive for success, owner mentality and collaboration.

  • Opportunity to leave your mark and start your career in one of the most reputable companies in the digital assets world

  • We are envisioning for the internship to be based pre-dominantly in Brussels. It is possible for a selected candidate to be based in London, UK, provided at least 1-2 months onboarding period would be spent in Brussels together with the rest of the interns cohort.

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

https://keyrock.com/careers/

Salary: £80,000-£100,000 + share options

  • Build Jerry's listening mode: a fast classifier that watches live consult transcripts and triggers Jerry to surface missed charges, tests, or risks in real time

  • Build Jerry's voice mode: a hands-free, voice-first experience for ambulatory vets on the road, where everything is spoken and any change waits for the vet's approval

  • Build long-running and scheduled Jerry tasks: turns that keep running after the vet closes the tab, and scheduled jobs that prepare drafts for the vet to approve

  • Own what you build in production across the TypeScript server and Python AI service: deploys, monitoring, fixes, weekly releases, and a share of on-call

  • Be a trusted reviewer on AI pull requests and write the design docs for new AI features

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering, including at least a year shipping LLM features to real users in production

  • TypeScript in production (Node.js backend and React) and Python in production (FastAPI or similar)

  • Has built with LLM APIs in production: tool calling and agent loops, structured output, prompt and model iteration

  • Deploys and owns code in production: CI/CD, Docker, a cloud platform (AWS ideally), monitoring and fixing live issues

  • SQL and Postgres, with git fluency across branches, rebasing, pull requests, and code review

  • RAG experience: embeddings, hybrid vector and keyword search (pgvector), reranking, citations (nice to have · the first project)

  • Voice AI experience: real-time voice agents, speech-to-text, telephony integration (nice to have)

  • Works well with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and reviews their output critically

  • Own your code end to end, from design doc to production, and do not consider a feature done until it is monitored and stable

  • Can explain the code you wrote, including the code your AI tools wrote for you

  • Shipping to production every week and contributing to on-call

  • Jerry's guideline library v1 is live for pilot clinics: it answers only from approved guidelines, cites exact lines, and passes the clinical team's test questions

raw.description:
We are looking for a Shared Services Manager to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

About Us

M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers and has extended $2 billion+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to earn income. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services, you lead day-to-day service delivery: queue health, SLAs, escalations, quality and business continuity, with functional leadership and coaching for colleagues. You also own UK HR operations, from onboarding and right-to-work to payroll and benefits cover, offboarding and contractors. You partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT and external partners including the Home Office, our payroll provider, Papaya, brokers, insurers and NEST. Success means healthy queues, SLAs met and 100% audit-ready right-to-work records.

This is a remote role, you would be working with a diverse group of other employees working remotely from locations such as UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services.

Why this timing matters

We are not hiring at random. Reaching 10 by 10 means building the people infrastructure behind our growth. A UK team that delivers onboarding, immigration, payroll and benefits to audit-ready standards is part of that foundation, and you would help set it.

What makes this different

Your current role: one process, one market. This role: leading HR Shared Services across global and market client groups, while owning UK HR operations and compliance. Every case you close helps someone who is helping deliver financial inclusion.

What You'll Do

  • Lead HR Shared Services delivery in Freshservice, managing case allocation, prioritisation, SLAs, ageing items and escalations, and coordinating capacity during peaks and absences.

  • Own UK right-to-work checks and immigration records through the Home Office portal, including annual audits, pre-expiry follow-up, Certificates of Sponsorship and sponsor reporting.

  • Run UK onboarding from accepted offer to first-day readiness, creating accurate HiBob profiles with Talent Acquisition, IT and hiring managers.

  • Manage employee lifecycle transactions, contracts, probation, letters and audit-ready HR records, reconciling data across HiBob, Freshservice and payroll files.

  • Act as UK backup for payroll, Group Benefits, NEST pensions, Global Mobility and employee relations, supporting inputs, provider deadlines and compliant case documentation.

  • Coordinate offboarding for UK employees, EOR workers and contractors, and maintain the UK Contractor List as the source of truth.

  • Produce regular reports, close audit findings, maintain SOPs and the knowledge base, and improve processes while protecting data under UK GDPR.

What You'll Need

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Relations or a related field. CIPD qualification or progress toward it is desirable.

  • Proven experience managing end-to-end HR Shared Services across multiple processes, stakeholders and client groups, including queues, SLAs, escalations, controls and continuous improvement.

  • Practical UK experience in right-to-work checks, immigration records, sponsorship administration and Home Office processes.

  • Experience coordinating UK payroll inputs, benefits, pensions, contracts, onboarding, lifecycle changes and offboarding with external providers.

  • Experience with HRIS and service-management platforms. HiBob and Freshservice are preferred.

  • Strong attention to detail, stakeholder management, sound judgement and high standards of confidentiality. Experience working across countries or markets is strongly preferred.

The reality check

This role is demanding. You will run a global service queue and a UK compliance portfolio at the same time, with competing priorities, high-volume requests and confidential cases arriving together. Right-to-work and sponsorship deadlines don’t move, and as payroll backup your accuracy shows up in someone’s payslip. When colleagues are away, you are the cover for payroll, benefits, mobility and employee relations. If you are already the person who tracks every expiry date and closes every loop, you’re probably ready for exactly this.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

raw.title: Key Account Executive - UK
raw.description:
As Marqeta’s Key Account Executive based in London, you will be passionate about scaling the success of our business in Europe. This exciting role is ideal for individuals seeking to go deep in all aspects of complex business and technical engagements and will span multiple areas of development:

(1) Cultivating and managing relationships with executives seeking to innovate and disrupt B2B & consumer payments;

(2) Working closely with internal stakeholders in Product, Legal, Compliance and Delivery to define solutions that will empower our customers; and

(3) Originating new customer opportunities, responding to inbound opportunities, and shepherding deals from opening through to contract and closing stage.  

The team at Marqeta focuses on the largest and most impactful commercial opportunities in Marqeta’s evolving business. These customers include established brands, fintech innovators and labour / retail marketplaces, all looking for solutions to launch, scale and continuously evolve their financial products and services.  Key to this role is an ability to understand Marqeta's technology and how it brings value to the market, expertly communicate its benefits, and win the trust of the key stakeholders across revenue growth, product and technology teams of our potential partners.

We're looking for a self-motivated, experienced solution seller, who is eager to further deepen their knowledge of embedded finance and possesses the business judgment and sales acumen to vet opportunities and close deals. In this role you will spend the first 3 months learning the ins and outs of Marqeta and our customers and our programme management capabilities, supporting Team Leads on strategic projects, and building a sales pipeline. Additionally, you will need to understand the process of selling a complex platform technology and be able to communicate technical and product benefits to both sophisticated and unsophisticated buyers.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.

The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll Have

This role is about generating and closing new opportunities while playing a key role supporting the Sales Director in setting the strategic vision for the business - here are a few key expectations:

  • Closing and launching enterprise customers: Work alongside the team Director in identifying, closing and onboarding new customers. Manage the back end of the process including Salesforce rigour and reporting, financial modeling, and garnering internal approvals. 

  • Qualify leads and prioritize the right opportunities: Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects by identifying their needs and requirements, responding to requests for information and proposals, and vetting them against our current and future product offering.

  • Run a Sales Process end to end: Manage real customer opportunities through a sales process, from initial engagement to scoping to final contract negotiations. At any given time, you will be responsible for partnering with the team to grow and renew existing accounts and working opportunities in various stages of that process in Salesforce.

  • Contracting: Work with our Legal team as required to shepherd opportunities through the contracting process, including negotiation and execution.

  • Know the Tech: Quickly get up to speed on Marqeta's technical and programme management capabilities, the unique features and customer benefits our platform offers and how to speak with confidence, knowledge and credibility about what we bring to our customers and prospects.

  • Sell the partnership vision: Work with internal SMEs to identify and develop solutions for prospects who are trying to understand what makes Marqeta’s platform and service offering so exceptional and differentiated.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in sales and/or strategic business development roles; payments, investment banking and strategic consulting backgrounds preferred but not required. Bachelor’s Degree or comparable experience required.

  • Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem and card issuing is crucial, with bonus points for having worked in a regulated programme manager offering full stack solutions to customers.

  • Strong familiarity and ease with the fintech ecosystem, B2B technology applications and how technology platforms serve customer businesses.

  • Financial Acumen. The payments business and caliber of customer relationships necessitates complex deal structures and financial modelling. We’re looking for an individual who is comfortable and capable of evaluating and modeling customer proposals and resulting contract financial models. 

  • Confidence in serving as the face of Marqeta for prospective customers and partners who may comprise C-suite executives and senior leadership members.

  • Ability to prioritize, manage, and deliver on multiple projects simultaneously; highly motivated and able to work against aggressive schedules.

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to work cross-functionally to deliver on the customer’s needs.

  • Superior communication skills (interpersonal, verbal, email, and presentation) with the ability to successfully orchestrate the sales process by managing the time and resources of the team and specialist partners.

  • Positive attitude, team player, adaptable, resourceful, and self-starter who is able to work independently.

Recruiter for this role

  • Lou Devlin - Linkedin Profile (no agencies please!)

Typical Process

  • Application Submission

  • Recruiter video call

  • Hiring manager video call

  • Virtual “Onsite” consisting of 2 x 45 min calls

  • Presentation Round to team

  • Offer!

Compensation and Benefits

  • Premium Private Medical and Dental coverage

  • Generous time off program with additional “Floating Holiday days”

  • Retirement savings program with company contribution

  • Equity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase Program

  • Monthly stipend to support our remote work model

  • Annual development stipend to support our people's growth and development

  • Family-forming benefits and up to 20 weeks of Parental Leave

  • Wellbeing programs i.e. Modern Health, HealthKick and much more…

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

– Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish.

– Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes.

– Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. We lead with humility and set aside hierarchy to work as a team.

– Make it Count: We drive forward with focus and agility. With a sense of urgency and purpose, we get the job done, and done right.

Equal Employment Opportunity, Accommodations and Privacy

Marqeta is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), veteran status or uniformed service member status, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information (including testing or characteristics) or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Marqeta endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please submit this form with your specific accommodation request.

Marqeta cares about your privacy. Personal data that is provided as part of the application and recruitment process is processed in accordance with the Applicant Privacy Notice. Additional information for California residents can be found here.

To keep our interview process fair and consistent, we ask that all candidates join video interviews with their camera on.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in our recruitment processing consistent with the requirements of applicable laws. For more information, review our AI notice here.

raw.title: Account Executive, Digital Natives
raw.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across France and Northern Europe. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency.

You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams.

This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters.

What You Will Do:

Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound):

  • Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models

  • Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships

Technical evaluation:

  • Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear

  • Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements

Deal management and closing:

  • Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams

  • Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps

Account growth:

  • Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models

  • Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production

Working with product and science:

  • Bring customer feedback, usage patterns, and competitive insight back to our product and science teams to inform priorities and the roadmap

  • Connect customers directly with our product and research teams where it accelerates their success

What We're Looking For:

  • 5 to 8 years of sales experience, with a track record of closing deals with startups and scale-ups for a technical product (API, developer tools, infrastructure, or data)

  • Experience selling to technical buyers: founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders

  • Working knowledge of how AI products are built, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about models, evaluation, and deployment with an engineering audience

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, ideally in AI, developer tools, or infrastructure

  • Comfort with usage-based revenue, where growth comes from what customers ship rather than from a single contract

  • Excellent English and French

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, and a hands-on, low-ego approach

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

raw.description:
Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

Neko is scaling fast. Our clinical teams already outnumber HQ across the US and Europe, and that ratio will keep growing. They deliver Neko’s promise to every member, every day – and right now, the information supporting their work is fragmented, inconsistent, and ungoverned. At our current pace, that's not just operational noise. It's a quality and safety risk. The role exists to fix that.

The role sits at the centre of two funnels. Inbound: you'll work closely with every team at Neko to shape what reaches clinical staff, when, and how. That means building trusted relationships across the organisation, helping teams understand what clinical staff need, and together making deliberate decisions about what gets communicated, what waits, and what can be consolidated. Outbound: once aligned and prioritised, you translate that into structured, cadenced formats that a dispersed clinical workforce can act on – right channel, right format, right frequency.

This is change management as much as communications. You're not just sending updates. You're redesigning how the whole organisation relates to its clinical teams.

 

What you'll deliver in the first 6-12 months

Build and enforce the intake model

  • Design the process that governs how every team at Neko communicates with clinical staff – how requests are submitted, evaluated, sequenced, and approved

  • Build the centralised view that ensures nothing reaches clinical staff in an uncoordinated or duplicative way

  • Document decision criteria clearly enough that stakeholders understand and trust how calls are made

  • Define escalation paths for urgent communications that need to move faster than the standard cadence

 

Drive organisation-wide change management

  • Partner with senior leadership to establish the intake model as an endorsed, org-wide norm – not an optional service, but the way Neko works

  • Run a structured roll-out across every team with touch points to clinical staff

  • Build the relationships that make the process feel collaborative rather than bureaucratic

  • Report regularly on intake volume, team compliance, and where we need to evolve.

 

Operationalise clinical communications

  • Start with a clear-eyed audit of how information reaches clinical teams today – the gaps, the overlaps, the friction

  • Build a global clinical programme with a single source of truth that clinical staff can rely on

  • Design the right mix of channels and formats for a dispersed, non-desk workforce – including AI-enabled formats like short-form video, audio briefings, and visual summaries

  • Create repeatable templates that make consistency straightforward for programme managers and local teams

  • Equip clinic leads with the tools and confidence to communicate well within their teams without losing global coherence

  • Define the metrics that prove it's working – comprehension, consistency, engagement, reduction in operational noise – and report on them regularly

  • Build a global communications cadence that helps leadership teams understand what’s changing, what’s ahead and how to prepare.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in change management, or programme management, with direct ownership of communication or enablement strategy at scale

  • Proven experience designing and enforcing intake or governance processes across multiple cross-functional teams – you've built the model, sold it in, and made it stick

  • A track record running structured communications programmes for large, dispersed frontline workforces

  • Strong programme management instincts: you bring structure to ambiguity and build systems that hold

  • A creative communicator who knows when a policy document is right and when a 60-second video does the job better

  • Genuine fluency with AI tools and an appetite to use them to improve quality, efficiency, and reach

  • Sharp stakeholder skills: you can align leadership and cross-functional teams, hold the line when needed, and build trust in the process

  • Experience in high-growth, multi-site consumer services or healthcare strongly preferred

  • Comfortable working across multiple geographies and time zones

  • Strong written and verbal English; additional European languages a plus

About titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so the title on this posting may differ from your internal title. We’ll be open about the scope and level of the role throughout the process, so you know exactly what you’d be taking on.

raw.title: Head of People Tech, Data & AI
raw.description:
Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

Our members' experience in the clinic is delivered by our people, so people systems and people data are core to how Neko runs, not a back-office report. This role brings People technology, people data and the AI tools our People function builds under one leader. You'll own the architecture of how it all fits together: our HRIS, applicant tracking system, a new ticketing system, identity and access, integrations, automation and analytics, across HQ, our clinics and several countries, and how all of it connects to the rest of Neko.

You'll lead a small team of HR technology engineers, people data specialists and product builders who already design and ship AI tools and automations used across the company. You'll work very closely with Corporate Engineering, People Operations and Payroll. Your team builds and runs the systems; you decide what good looks like and stay close enough to the work to tell.

Most of this is being built now, and the scope grows with every clinic we open. It also comes with something very few people in this field get to do: connecting people data to member experience, so we can see how staffing, training and performance in our clinics show up in member feedback and NPS, and act on it.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

• Set one architecture for people systems, data and workflows, with clear ownership, shared definitions and build-versus-buy decisions

• Build scalable workflows inside and outside Workday, including our new ticketing system, together with Corporate Engineering

• Create a trusted source of truth for people data, with self-serve analytics that leaders actually use and clear rules on who can see what

• Bring people data into executive and board decisions, from what we measure and why to how it is presented (Impact, not activity)

• Connect workforce data to the headcount planning Finance and Operations run for clinic openings

• Put a shared AI foundation in place, with privacy and GDPR built in, that teams outside People build their own tools on (Chase 10X, not 10%)

• Ship the first data products behind performance, progression and feedback, and the first measured link between people data and member experience (Member-first, always)

Minimum Qualifications

• Senior experience shaping people technology, people data or internal platforms in a complex, multi-country organisation, at a level where you set the direction, not only run the systems

• A technical foundation, from engineering, data or systems integration: you understand how data flows, how integrations work and how systems talk to each other

• You know HR systems such as Workday well enough to design around them and to direct the people who configure them. You don't need to have led an HRIS team or configured Workday yourself

• You are AI-forward in practice: you use AI in your own work every day and have put AI tools, automations or agents into real use for other people, and you can explain where they helped and where they didn't

• Judgement on data models, metrics and definitions, and on which decisions are hard to reverse

• You can take a technical picture or a data story to executives and turn it into a decision

• You have led specialists or engineers, and you measure yourself by what other teams can do without you

• Able to work from our London or Stockholm office 2–3 days a week

Preferred Qualifications

• AI in production, not only prototypes: agents, knowledge integrations, evaluation and access control for agents

• Led complex migrations or integrations across systems and countries

• A background in data or people analytics

• Experience with large shift-based or frontline workforces

• Built privacy and access rules for employee data from the start

Organization and Way of Working

You'll report to our Director of Rewards and Enablement, and your closest partner outside People will be Corporate Engineering. The team works on European time and meets in our London and Stockholm hubs.

raw.title: Mobility and Compliance Lead
raw.description:
Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

We are looking for a Mobility and Compliance Lead to be the champion of mobility policy and compliance across Neko as we scale. You will make sure that everyone who joins Neko from another country, relocates between our locations, or works across borders for us can do so lawfully and with a seamless experience, and that the business is never exposed to right-to-work, immigration or cross-border employment risk.

This role sits at the point where detail meets people. You will get into the detail of immigration rules, relocation packages and cross-border obligations, and you will be the visible, reassuring face of mobility for candidates, new joiners, employees and leaders. When the answer is no, or not by that date, you will say so clearly, explain why, and show what the compliant alternatives are.

You will lead through ownership, expertise and influence, working closely with People Enablement, Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal and our external advisers.

What you'll do in the first 6-12 Months

Own mobility policy and the programme behind it

  • Run and oversee Neko's Global Mobility Programme day to day: company-initiated relocations, self-initiated moves, long-term assignments and business travel, applying the Global Mobility Guideline consistently and fairly

  • Partner with Rewards, who own the guideline, to keep it current, fit for scale and clear on the edge cases, including short-term remote work abroad

  • Manage the mobility process end to end: feasibility review, approval, vendor engagement, assignment and relocation letters, repayment agreements and post-move check-ins

  • Manage our immigration, relocation and tax vendors, brief them well, hold them to timelines and quality, and keep costs visible

Protect the business on right to work and immigration

  • Run pre-offer mobility and right-to-work checks with Talent Acquisition, giving a clear outcome before any offer goes out (clear, hold or stop) and a realistic earliest safe start date

  • Own work permit, visa and sponsorship casework across the UK, Sweden, Germany, Belgium, Switzerland and Ireland, and flag where US requirements differ

  • Keep right-to-work evidence in Workday complete and audit-ready, and track permit expiries and renewals well before they lapse

  • Give the business a straight answer when a plan cannot work, and hold the line on compliance even when timelines are tight

Manage cross-border compliance risk

  • Assess the wider consequences of a move or remote working arrangement: permanent establishment, social security, payroll, tax reporting, posted worker and business visitor rules

  • Work out how each arrangement behaves under direct employment and under an employer of record, and raise the gaps early

  • Consider both our HQ and Clinic populations, including professional registration and licensing for clinical roles and the impact of shift patterns

  • Keep a clear audit trail for every decision: the facts, the source, the reasoning and who approved it

  • Escalate complex or high-risk cases promptly to the Head of People Enablement, Europe, and to external counsel where needed

Create a seamless experience for our people

  • Be the front-facing point of contact for candidates, new joiners, employees and leaders: explain what happens next, who is doing what, and by when

  • Run kick-off calls and pre-move briefings, and prepare the documents people need, such as relocation letters, invitation letters and employment certificates for visa applications

  • Build clear self-serve guidance, FAQs and SOPs in the People Hub and the People Enablement SOP manual, so routine questions are answered without a ticket

Build for scale

  • Improve how cases are tracked, reported and automated with People Tech, across Workday, Ashby and our case tools

  • Report on the mobility pipeline, cycle times, spend and risk, so that leaders can plan hiring and openings with eyes open

  • Spot patterns across cases and turn them into policy, process or tooling changes

What good looks like

  • No one starts work without a verified right to work, and no permit lapses unnoticed

  • Offers go out with a mobility outcome and a start date that holds

  • Candidates and employees say the experience was clear and well supported, including when the answer was no

  • Every case has a documented, defensible decision trail that stands up to audit

  • Routine questions are handled through self-serve guidance, and your time goes to the hard cases

Minimum Requirements

  • Substantial experience in global mobility, immigration or right-to-work compliance, ideally in a fast-growing, multi-country organisation, or in an immigration adviser, law firm or mobility provider

  • Working knowledge of immigration and right-to-work requirements across several of the UK, Sweden, Germany, Belgium, Switzerland and Ireland, and an understanding of the US

  • Understanding of relocation programme design and delivery, including the tax, social security and payroll implications of moving people across borders

  • An analytical mind: you can read a complex case, find the risk in the detail, and build a clear recommendation from the evidence

  • Confident and credible with candidates, employees and senior stakeholders, able to deliver a firm no calmly, with reasons and alternatives

  • Strong problem-solving instincts and good judgement on when to escalate

  • Meticulous record keeping and comfort with trackers, reporting and audit trails

  • Experience with Workday

  • Fluent English; Swedish or another European language is an advantage

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a healthcare, medtech or other regulated environment, including registered clinical professionals

  • Experience managing sponsor licence obligations or employer of record arrangements

  • A formal immigration or mobility qualification

  • Background in process automation or people analytics

About titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so the title on this posting may differ from your internal title. We’ll be open about the scope and level of the role throughout the process, so you know exactly what you’d be taking on.

  • Work out how each arrangement behaves under direct employment and under an employer of record, and raise the gaps early

  • Consider both our HQ and Clinic populations, including professional registration and licensing for clinical roles and the impact of shift patterns

  • Keep a clear audit trail for every decision: the facts, the source, the reasoning and who approved it

  • Escalate complex or high-risk cases promptly to the Head of People Enablement, Europe, and to external counsel where needed

Create a seamless experience for our people

  • Be the front-facing point of contact for candidates, new joiners, employees and leaders: explain what happens next, who is doing what, and by when

  • Run kick-off calls and pre-move briefings, and prepare the documents people need, such as relocation letters, invitation letters and employment certificates for visa applications

  • Build clear self-serve guidance, FAQs and SOPs in the People Hub and the People Enablement SOP manual, so routine questions are answered without a ticket

Build for scale

  • Improve how cases are tracked, reported and automated with People Tech, across Workday, Ashby and our case tools

  • Report on the mobility pipeline, cycle times, spend and risk, so that leaders can plan hiring and openings with eyes open

  • Spot patterns across cases and turn them into policy, process or tooling changes

  • No one starts work without a verified right to work, and no permit lapses unnoticed

  • Offers go out with a mobility outcome and a start date that holds

  • Candidates and employees say the experience was clear and well supported, including when the answer was no

  • Every case has a documented, defensible decision trail that stands up to audit

  • Routine questions are handled through self-serve guidance, and your time goes to the hard cases

Minimum Requirements

  • Substantial experience in global mobility, immigration or right-to-work compliance, ideally in a fast-growing, multi-country organisation, or in an immigration adviser, law firm or mobility provider

  • Working knowledge of immigration and right-to-work requirements across several of the UK, Sweden, Germany, Belgium, Switzerland and Ireland, and an understanding of the US

  • Understanding of relocation programme design and delivery, including the tax, social security and payroll implications of moving people across borders

  • An analytical mind: you can read a complex case, find the risk in the detail, and build a clear recommendation from the evidence

  • Confident and credible with candidates, employees and senior stakeholders, able to deliver a firm no calmly, with reasons and alternatives

  • Strong problem-solving instincts and good judgement on when to escalate

  • Meticulous record keeping and comfort with trackers, reporting and audit trails

  • Experience with Workday

  • Fluent English; Swedish or another European language is an advantage

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a healthcare, medtech or other regulated environment, including registered clinical professionals

  • Experience managing sponsor licence obligations or employer of record arrangements

  • A formal immigration or mobility qualification

  • Background in process automation or people analytics

raw.title: Research Scientist, Embodied AI
raw.description:
About Niantic Spatial

We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

Niantic Spatial makes the physical world computable, helping people and machines collaborate safely by aligning how they understand reality. One of the fundamental problems we're helping autonomy teams and engineers overcome is the sim-to-real gap for visual-spatial understanding. We're applying our team's decades of experience encoding the world precisely as it is at Google Maps, Google Earth, and Niantic Labs to build the scalable real-to-sim stack for embodied AI.

Niantic Spatial's R&D Team in London is seeking a Research Scientist to push the frontiers of Spatial AI, advancing our Large Geospatial Model as a dedicated member of the Embodied AI group. You will invent and develop algorithms and systems that sit at the cross-section of computer vision, machine learning, AI, graphics, and robotics.

We're passionate about discovery, so we're looking for scientists who want to learn, publish, teach, and deploy every new invention.

What You'll Do

  • Develop New Spatial Representations - Develop new spatial representations that embodied AI can learn from, train in, and act on.

  • Advance Real-to-Sim Pipelines - Advance real-to-sim pipelines connecting real-world observations, 3D reconstruction, simulation, and robotic policy learning.

  • Solve Emerging Spatial Problems - Solve emerging problems that relate to spatial intelligence, 3D scene representation, training data, model efficiency, and interactive systems.

  • Take Capabilities Through to Evidence - Take new capabilities through to evidence: what changed for the policy, not only what changed in the reconstruction.

  • Build Prototypes - Build proof of concept prototypes, initially for internal use, where some will need to run at production scale on customer data.

  • Collaborate Across Research and Product - Collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and product partners to bring novel models to production.

  • Publish Your Work - Publish and present your work.

What You'll Bring

  • A PhD in computer vision, robotics, graphics, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience, with a publication record at top venues.

  • Substantial expertise in robotics or embodied AI, including experience in sim-to-real transfer, domain randomization, policy evaluation, and simulation-based learning.

  • Deep experience with 3D scene representations: Gaussian splatting, neural fields, meshes, point clouds, or implicit representations.

  • You have applied generative or diffusion models to 3D data, such as scene completion, inpainting, relighting, or novel view synthesis from sparse capture.

  • You have worked on 3D semantics, open-vocabulary scene understanding, or scene graphs.

  • Proficiency in Python and Deep Learning libraries such as PyTorch.

  • GPU or graphics programming experience, such as custom CUDA kernels, shaders, or differentiable rendering.

  • A track record of contributing to widely used open-source research codebases.

Nice to Have

  • Proficiency in C++.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary range of £103,500 to £202,500. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office.

Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed - you may be exactly who we're looking for.

Equal Opportunity

Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process.

Candidate Privacy

I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant-privacy-notice.

raw.title: Applied AI Engineer - Startups
raw.description:
About the team

The AI Deployment Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior.

This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems.

About the role

We are seeking a technically proficient, product-minded engineer to help push the frontier of advanced AI with our strategic startup customers. You'll work with some of the most exciting AI startups in the world, helping them optimize their own systems and turning those learnings into durable improvements across OpenAI’s research and products. You will partner deeply on complex workflows, identify the gaps that matter, and help transform those gaps into reproducible evaluations, technical insights - helping shape OpenAI's research and product direction.

This role is well suited to engineers who are equally comfortable debugging a workflow, iterating on prompts or agents, designing evaluations, and collaborating across research and product. You should be excited by ambiguous, high-impact problems and motivated by the opportunity to shape how advanced AI systems improve in practice.

This role is based in Israel. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance.

In this role, you will:

  • Work directly with strategic startup customers to understand critical workflows, uncover failure modes, and identify high-impact opportunities for improvement.

  • Prototype and iterate on prompts, agents, and workflow designs to better understand system behavior and unlock customer value.

  • Synthesize and deliver valuable feedback to the Product and Research teams, turning real usage patterns into clear, reproducible evals, benchmarks, and technical artifacts that improve model and product quality and ensure customer-grounded learnings influence roadmap and model development.

  • Build repeatable tools, patterns, and evaluation approaches that raise the quality bar across multiple use cases.

  • Operate with strong judgment in ambiguous environments, balancing immediate technical problem-solving with longer-term system improvement.

  • Build relationships within the startup ecosystem, serving as a technical partner to both individual customers and the broader community.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have strong software engineering & AI fundamentals. For example, experience as a startup CTO, software engineer, ML engineer, Data Scientist or equivalent. Experience shipping production systems end-to-end is a strong plus.

  • Have experience as a technical founder, or engineer at an early stage startup

  • Have familiarity with, or interest in, model training pipelines and reinforcement learning.

  • Have experience building AI applications, agents, or evaluation systems, and can reason clearly about model behavior in complex workflows.

  • Are comfortable working directly with highly technical users and translating their challenges into concrete technical signals.

  • Can move fluidly between prototyping, debugging, evaluation design, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Bring high agency, strong product sense, and a bias toward building durable improvements rather than one-off fixes

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

raw.title: Senior Solar PV Engineer – Southampton
raw.description:
Position Summary

Location: South East England – based within ~30 miles of Southampton

Are you an experienced electrician who enjoys fault-finding more than fitting? Otovo is building its UK field service team and we’re looking for a senior Solar PV & Battery Service Engineer to lead our service work across the South East.

The role is mainly service, maintenance and repair: you’ll take on the more complex solar PV and battery faults, work independently across the region, and help set the standard as the team grows. It suits a qualified electrician with solar PV experience who likes solving problems and looking after homeowners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot and repair domestic solar PV systems, inverters, battery storage (EESS) and associated electrical equipment

  • Lead on complex faults, escalations and warranty repairs across the South East

  • Carry out preventive maintenance, inspection and testing to BS 7671

  • Commission new systems and upgrades, completing certification and documentation correctly

  • Use test equipment such as multifunction testers, clamp meters, insulation testers and thermal imaging cameras

  • Keep accurate service records, test results, reports and photo documentation

  • Follow safe working practices including safe isolation, PPE and working at height

  • Mentor and support junior engineers as the regional team grows

  • Communicate clearly with homeowners about system status and recommended repairs

  • Represent Otovo professionally at customer sites

What We Offer

  • Salary of £44,000 – £50,000 per year

  • Company van and fuel card

  • Paid holidays

  • Full-time, permanent role in a growing renewables company

  • A senior role helping to build Otovo’s UK field service team


Requirements

  • Level 3 electrical qualification and a valid ECS card

  • BS 7671 18th Edition

  • Solar PV experience essential; City & Guilds 2399 preferred (we can support experienced electricians to gain it)

  • Proven hands-on experience installing, servicing or fault-finding domestic solar PV systems

  • Confident fault-finding on inverters and DC/AC circuits, working independently

  • Full UK driving licence

  • Comfortable working at height, on roofs and outdoors in all weather

  • Strong communication and customer service skills

  • Based within ~30 miles of Southampton and willing to travel across the South East

Nice to Have

  • Battery storage (EESS) training or experience

  • Inspection & Testing qualification (e.g. City & Guilds 2391)

  • Experience leading or mentoring other technicians

  • EV charger installation experience

raw.description:
Senior IT Manager

| Enterprise Systems & Information Security

 

➡️ Are you an experienced IT leader who combines strategic thinking with the technical expertise to get hands-on and make things happen?

➡️ Have you led improvements across enterprise IT systems, information security and business-critical technology, taking ownership from strategy through to implementation?

➡️ Want to shape the future of corporate IT at a global AI-native company, driving smarter, more secure and efficient ways of working?

If this sounds like your next move, we’d love to hear from you!

 

Role Summary:

We’re looking for a technically strong, commercially minded Senior IT Manager to lead our global corporate IT operations, strengthen enterprise information security and continuously improve the technology and systems our teams rely on.

Supporting our offices in London and Toronto, alongside our remote teams across the US, you'll play a key role in ensuring our global IT environment is secure, scalable and efficient, enabling our people to work and collaborate effectively, wherever they're based.

This is a hands-on leadership role, combining technical expertise, strategic thinking and operational ownership, with the opportunity to shape how we manage, protect and evolve our technology as Patsnap continues to grow.

This is a predominantly office-based role, with regular onsite attendance expected in our Farringdon Office and occasional flexibility to work remotely when business needs allow.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

 

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. This is a high-autonomy, hands-on position suited to someone who has already developed strong technical foundations and is confident working independently. You'll be responsible for resolving technical issues, administering our Microsoft 365 environment, managing employee IT onboarding and offboarding, maintaining office infrastructure and supporting IT security and compliance.

We're looking for someone who can hit the ground running. Someone who doesn't need constant direction, takes ownership of challenges through to resolution and can confidently make decisions, manage priorities and identify opportunities to improve how we operate.

Just as importantly, we're looking for a genuine people person. Someone approachable, patient and professional, who understands that great IT support isn't simply about fixing technology; it's about ensuring colleagues feel supported and can do their best work.

As Patsnap continues its transformation into an AI-first organisation, you'll also play a role in supporting the secure adoption of enterprise AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude Enterprise.

This is a predominantly office-based role in our Farringdon office, with onsite attendance currently expected Monday to Thursday and occasional flexibility to work remotely depending on business needs.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

 

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle, using domain-specific AI to accelerate the creation of market-ready products. With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Singapore, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.   

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Act as the primary onsite IT contact for the London office, providing visible, hands-on first and second-line support for hardware, software, Microsoft 365 and connectivity issues, and remote support for colleagues across the UK, Europe and parts of APAC.

  • Deliver a seamless onboarding and offboarding experience by setting up user accounts, provisioning devices, managing application access, and ensuring secure deprovisioning.

  • Manage user provisioning and permissions across Microsoft 365, Salesforce and other business SaaS platforms, applying role-based access principles.

  • Configure and maintain Windows and macOS devices through Microsoft Intune, and manage IT assets and inventory for the region.

  • Own the office IT infrastructure, including video conferencing and meeting room technology, door access, printers and the communications room, and coordinate with our outsourced network provider on connectivity and access point issues.

  • Take on practical, hands-on tasks such as cabling, equipment setup and desk moves

  • Work closely with the UK Office Manager, providing practical support with day-to-day office needs and shared projects.

  • Support our security and compliance programs by assisting with access reviews, audit evidence, and IT controls for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 using Vanta.

  • Administer and support enterprise AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, and Microsoft Copilot, promote secure adoption and best practices, and actively look for ways to apply AI to improve IT support and everyday workflows.

  • Prioritise competing requests based on business impact, proactively identify improvements, and take issues through to resolution.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across our global IT team on projects, escalations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Technologies You'll Work With

  • Microsoft 365: Teams, Outlook, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID and Intune.

  • Enterprise AI: ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise and Microsoft Copilot.

  • Security & Compliance: Vanta, ISO 27001 and SOC 2.

  • Office Technology: Video conferencing, meeting room systems, networking and door access.

  • Business SaaS: Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Gong, ZoomInfo and Lusha.

And plenty more! We're continually evolving our technology, so there'll be opportunities to learn and work with new tools as we grow.


What We'd Love From You:

Above all, we're looking for someone who combines strong hands-on technical expertise, proven independence and a genuine passion for helping people. You'll be comfortable being the go-to IT specialist in an office, confident making decisions and resolving issues without constant supervision, while remaining approachable, collaborative and focused on delivering an exceptional employee experience.

  • Relevant IT Support Experience: A minimum of 3 years' professional experience in IT support, desktop support, IT operations or a similar hands-on technical role. Ideally, you've worked in a standalone, primary onsite IT support or similarly autonomous position, taking responsibility for a broad range of technical requirements.

  • Strong Microsoft 365 Administration: Demonstrable hands-on experience independently administering Microsoft 365, particularly Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online and SharePoint, including user management, identity and access controls, licensing and device administration.

  • Technical Independence & Troubleshooting: Proven ability to independently diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating system and connectivity issues across Windows and macOS. Comfortable investigating unfamiliar problems and knowing when to escalate appropriately.

  • SaaS & Access Management: Experience administering cloud-based business applications, managing user provisioning, permissions and secure access, alongside employee onboarding and offboarding processes.

  • IT Security & Compliance: Practical experience supporting IT security controls, access reviews, device compliance or audit activities relating to frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

  • Ownership & Accountability: A self-sufficient, dependable professional who takes responsibility for IT issues, follows through to resolution and proactively identifies opportunities to improve systems and processes.

  • Prioritisation & Judgement: Confident managing competing priorities, responding calmly to unexpected challenges and making sound decisions based on business impact, without requiring day-to-day supervision.

  • Excellent People Skills: Approachable, patient and an excellent communicator, with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and making technology accessible to employees of all technical abilities.

  • A Practical, Hands-On Mindset: Comfortable taking responsibility for onsite IT needs, from device configuration and meeting room technology to hardware troubleshooting, cabling and equipment setup.

  • Adaptability & Continuous Improvement: Curious, resourceful and comfortable working in a fast-moving technology environment, with an interest in AI, automation and emerging workplace technologies.

Even better if you have:

  • Previous experience as the primary IT contact for an office or supporting multiple locations with limited onsite technical assistance.

  • Experience working in a growing SaaS, technology or internationally distributed business.

  • Experience with Vanta or direct involvement in ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits.

  • Experience administering Salesforce, HubSpot or other enterprise SaaS platforms.

  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, MS-900 or Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator.

  • Experience supporting or mentoring less experienced IT colleagues.

  • Mandarin or Cantonese language skills, which would be helpful when collaborating with colleagues in our East region.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, collaborative, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

raw.title: GTM Engineer
raw.description:
Competencies

You are an applied AI engineer whose product is the revenue engine. You find where the customer lifecycle can work better and ship production-grade agentic workflow, LLM pipelines and integrations that make each process best in class for reps, CSMs and marketers. You operate independently and own each build end to end: architecture, prototype, evals, deployment and observability. You spar on solution design with the team, then ship.

We care more about what you have shipped than where you studied. If you have built something real, show us.

Must-haves

  • You have shipped AI systems GTM teams use daily. Agents, workflows or integrations used by sales, CS or marketing that moved a number.

  • Strong integration skills in JavaScript or TypeScript. You’re comfortable building and running integration services. Working with APIs and webhooks, handling auth, rate limits and errors, and shipping tested code.

  • Hands-on Salesforce or equivalent, declarative and code. Declarative: object model, Flows, validation rules, permission sets, record types. Code: Apex triggers and classes, SOQL and SOSL, Lightning Web Components, Platform Events and Change Data Capture, REST and Bulk APIs, SFDX deployments.

  • Applied AI engineering. You build with LLM APIs, not just chat interfaces, and can show the skills listed below in real work.

  • You understand the revenue engine. Experience in RevOps, GTM Systems, growth or a GTM engineering agency in B2B SaaS. You know how pipeline, renewals and expansion actually work.

  • Data quality fundamentals. SQL, CRM data models, deduplication, enrichment waterfalls and data quality at scale.

  • GTM data stack. Clay, n8n, Make + warehouse and reverse ETL experience.

  • Production mindset. You ship fast and build things others can maintain: logged, monitored, documented.

  • Clear communicator. You can sit with a top rep, find the work that shouldn't exist, and explain the fix in plain words.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with a customer platform or CSM tool (Planhat, Gainsight, ChurnZero), or HubSpot alongside Salesforce.

  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I or II, or Platform App Builder.

  • Side projects, open-source tools, public write-ups or a GitHub that shows you build for fun.

  • Founder, agency or early-stage startup experience.

Trajectory

You’ll own each build end to end, from architecture and prototype through evals, deployment and observability. Here’s what that looks like:

  • Agentic GTM workflows: Design and ship AI agents and workflows that optimise productivity: account research, signal detection, enrichment, call and email analysis, personalised outreach, renewal and expansion plays.

  • Planhat on Planhat: Run our own GTM on our own platform. Build with Planhat's AI, automations and APIs, and feed what you learn straight back to Product as a power user.

  • Signals and data: Turn product usage, intent, firmographic and conversation data into scores and triggers that route the right account to the right person at the right time.

  • Integrations: Connect tools that don't talk natively. Build the webhooks, MCP connection and transformations that keep data clean across the stack.

  • Build vs buy: Run tight pilots on new GTM and AI tools, measure fit and ROI, and make a clear call.

  • Enablement: Document what you build, teach teams to use it with confidence, and raise how the whole company builds with AI.

Definition of Success

Success is measured in outcomes: productivity gains, pipeline acceleration, data quality and adoption of what you ship.
