raw.title: Head of Supply Chain Delivery
raw.description:
About Plentific

Plentific is pioneering real-time property operations for real-world impact. Our platform connects property owners, operators, service providers and residents, and covers more than 1.7 million properties and 5,000+ service providers. We believe property repairs, maintenance and management can and should work better for everyone. That means giving landlords more control, supporting trade professionals and strengthening the communities they serve.

The Role

Our clients, mainly social housing providers and local authorities, rely on Plentific's contractor network to deliver their repairs and maintenance works on time and to standard.

We're looking for a Head of Supply Chain Delivery to lead that team. You'll be responsible and accountable for how we deliver supply chain mobilisation for social landlord's supply chain needs, and for contractor performance and delivery. You'll lead a team of three account managers who manage our top contractors like key accounts, and you'll also run account management yourself for our key strategic contractor partners.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We're looking for someone with a repairs and maintenance contractor background in the social housing sector, ideally at or alongside a Tier 1 contractor. You'll know how contractors run their businesses, and be comfortable making decisions from data.

What you'll do

Design the delivery solution for every new mobilisation

  • Take the client's requirements from Sales and put forward the delivery solution for each mobilisation proposal.

  • Make these decisions using the data including pricing rate benchmarks, contractor capacity and workload by trade and region.

  • Agree rates and SLAs with the contractors and negotiate on deliverables and pricing.

  • Oversee the contractor mobilisation through to delivery, stepping in on escalations.

Own contractor performance across the network

  • Own SLA attainment, aged WIP and escalations across our contractor network.

  • Accountable for contractor's performance per client against baseline KPIs, so every contractor is held to account for how they perform for each client.

  • Put improvement plans in place for under-performers, and route more work, projects and works packages to the contractors who perform well.

Lead the contractor account management team

  • Accountable for contractor monthly account management calls covering KPIs, aged WIP plans, pricing and quote health, capacity and growth, and platform adoption.

  • Set clear goals, KPIs for the team and review progress against them regularly.

Build strategic contractor relationships

  • Hold director-level relationships with our strategic Tier 1 contractors and join their monthly account calls.

  • Understand each strategic contractor's capacity, growth plans and interest in new regions or trades, and turn that into more work through Plentific.

  • Share what you hear from contractors so we keep improving our platform and our way of working.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in repairs and maintenance, construction or facilities management, including time at or alongside a Tier 1 contractor. You understand how contractors run their businesses: operatives, scheduling, pricing and margins.

  • Experience leading and developing a team, with clear goals and regular performance conversations.

  • Commercial confidence: you can price work against a schedule of rates and negotiate rates and SLAs with contractors.

  • Data literate. You're comfortable working with dashboards and KPIs, and you make decisions from data rather than relationships alone.

  • You build trusted relationships with contractor directors and senior stakeholders.

  • Highly organised, able to run several mobilisations at once against tight deadlines.

  • Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work, and keen to find new ways they can save time.

Nice to Have

  • Understanding of public procurement regulations and how frameworks operate within housing repairs

  • Experience with FSM or work order management tools

  • Experience in running competitive tenders and structuring contracts with subcontractors

Why Plentific

You'll join a scale-up with ambitious growth plans and the backing to deliver them, in a role where your deals directly shape how the sector manages its homes.

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped OTE

  • 25 days annual holiday

  • Flexible working, including a work abroad scheme

  • Private healthcare for you and immediate family, with discounted gym membership, optical, dental and private GP

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance (4x salary)

  • Pension scheme

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary sacrifice scheme

  • Learning platform powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation if someone you introduce joins

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle and Techscheme programmes

  • Company-sponsored lunches, dinners and social events, plus a fully stocked kitchen

raw.title: Repairs Case Officer
raw.description:
About Us

At Plentific, we’re redefining property management in real time. Our mission is to lead real estate through the transformative journey into "The World of Now," enabling us to empower property professionals through our innovative, cloud-based platform.

We harness cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights to streamline operations for landlords, letting agents, and property managers, enabling them to optimize maintenance, manage repairs, and make informed decisions instantly. Our platform is designed to create seamless, real-time workflows that transform traditional property management into a dynamic, digital experience.

Backed by a world-class group of investors, including Noa, Highland Europe, Brookfields, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures, and Target Global, Plentific is at the forefront of the proptech revolution. Headquartered in London with a global outlook, we’re continually expanding our reach and impact.

We’re looking for forward-thinking, passionate professionals who are ready to contribute to our mission and drive industry innovation. If you’re excited about making an immediate impact and shaping the future of property management, explore career opportunities with us at Plentific.

 

The Role

Plentific Services is Plentific’s own delivery arm. Rather than only connecting a housing provider with a contractor, we take end-to-end ownership of the work order: we agree the service and the fees with the client, source and vet the subcontractors who do the work, manage delivery through the Plentific platform, quality-check the output before the client sees it, and invoice at pre-agreed fees. Inspections and surveys are the first service line, and the business is moving from single programmes to several client contracts running side by side.

As Supply Chain Specialist you will be the operational point of contact for both clients and contractors, working across several client contracts and several contractors at the same time. This is a hands-on delivery role in a service that is still being built, so you will help shape how it runs as volumes grow. Commercial decisions on client fees, subcontractor rates and contractor vetting sit with the Head of Property Operations, and you will feed into them.

Responsibilities

  • Own the day to day delivery of all Plentific Services work orders, taking whatever action is needed on and off the platform to keep each job moving to completion.

  • Accept incoming job leads from clients, making sure the information and documents we need are in place before work starts and raising anything missing back to the client.

  • Set each work order up correctly on the platform so it reaches the right subcontractor ready to be delivered.

  • Manage delivery against the agreed service levels, tracking booking and completion times and escalating jobs at risk while there is still time to recover them

  • Resolve day to day issues with clients and contractors, from access and contact problems through to queries on the quality of what has been delivered, seeing each one through to closure

  • Report on work order status daily, weekly and monthly, and flag the trends worth acting on

  • Support the commercial cycle, tracking client invoicing on completed work and raising the requests that trigger contractor payment

  • Act as the operational point of contact for clients and contractors, working with the named contacts on both sides to answer enquiries and keep relationships strong

  • Manage all the above across multiple clients and multiple contractors at the same time

  • Help improve how the service runs as volumes grow, so delivery scales beyond manual follow-up

 

Requirements

Skills

  • Organised under volume, able to hold a large queue of live jobs and know which ones matter today

  • Confident and persistent in chasing clients and contractors without damaging the relationship

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, written and spoken

  • Comfortable in a job management or field service platform, and quick to learn a new one

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly where an error would reach the client

  • Ability to analyse data and make data-driven decisions

  • Resilient and able to cope with a fast growing, scale up culture where every day is different

  • Works with a high degree of autonomy and copes well under pressure

  • Able to deal with a client and contractor base, understanding different working practices on both sides

  • Great team spirit, a can do attitude and the ability to turn a challenge into an opportunity

 

Experience and Qualifications

  • Minimum 2-4 years of experience in a repairs, voids, compliance or contractor operations role, gained at a housing association, a local authority, an ALMO or a contractor delivering to them

  • Proven experience of working to service levels on live jobs, and first-hand knowledge of what goes wrong in the field

  • Experience of managing work orders through a job management, field service or contractor management platform

  • Some experience of dealing with contractors and trade industry knowledge

  • Desirable: experience of inspections or surveys, for example stock condition, void checks, damp and mould, post-disrepair or fire risk

  • Desirable: exposure to contractor invoicing, payment approvals or purchase orders

  • Desirable: an understanding of the regulatory pressure our clients are under, including Awaab’s Law and the Building Safety Act

 

Benefits

We offer:

  • A competitive compensation package

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Flexible working environment, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance at 4× salary

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation when someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle, and Techscheme programmes

  • Pension scheme

  • Company-sponsored lunches, dinners, and social gatherings

  • Fully stocked kitchen with drinks, snacks, fruit, and breakfast cereals

raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer
raw.description:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.


We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.
We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

This is a hands-on, fully remote role in one of Plentific's cross-functional product engineering teams. The Senior Backend Engineer works alongside product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers to build and operate the services behind repairs, quoting and invoicing, payments, contractor search, messaging, notifications, and fraud prevention. The role is open across the European countries where we currently employ or engage remote engineers.


Our backend is built primarily in Python and Django, with Django REST Framework and FastAPI supporting APIs in a service-oriented architecture deployed on AWS and Kubernetes. PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery underpin data-intensive and asynchronous workflows. The systems handle complex permissions, legacy integrations, high transaction volumes, and business processes where reliability and data correctness matter.


AI-assisted, spec-driven development is part of normal engineering practice at Plentific. The Senior Backend Engineer turns product requirements into implementation-ready specifications, uses agentic coding tools across implementation, testing, review, and documentation, and remains accountable for the resulting software. AI-generated output is held to the same standard as human-written code. Success means delivering reliable services, improving the codebase and engineering practice around the role, and enabling the wider team to ship confidently at pace.

Key Responsibilities

Backend Engineering

  • Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python, Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, and related platform tooling.

  • Design service boundaries, API contracts, relational data models, and integration flows for complex property operations. Produce ERDs and other technical diagrams where they make relationships, ownership, and system behaviour easier to review.

  • Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows using technologies such as Celery and Redis.

  • Write complex SQL, evolve PostgreSQL schemas safely, and optimise database performance where customer experience or operational throughput depends on it.

  • Review, refactor, and retire existing code so it remains readable, testable, maintainable, and suitable for new product requirements.

Quality, Reliability, and Operations

  • Write automated tests at the appropriate level and integrate them into CI/CD so changes can be released with clear evidence of quality.

  • Instrument services with logs, metrics, traces, and alerts that make production behaviour and failures easy to understand.

  • Diagnose and resolve production incidents across services, databases, queues, integrations, and infrastructure.

  • Design for security, resilience, performance, and data integrity across business-critical workflows.

Agentic and Spec-Driven Development

  • Partner with product managers, frontend engineers, and quality engineers to turn agreed product behaviour into implementation-ready technical solution designs covering assumptions, alternatives, service interactions, data and schema changes, failure modes, security, observability, rollout, rollback, and tests.

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to generate, refactor, test, review, and document code within clear technical constraints.

  • Evaluate AI-generated code critically for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and fit with Plentific's architecture.

  • Break specifications into small, reviewable changes and validate each change against its intended behaviour before release.

  • Improve the team's spec-driven development practice through reusable patterns, review checklists, examples, and concise documentation.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Collaborate with product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers from problem framing through release and production operation.

  • Surface technical risks and trade-offs early, and propose pragmatic changes to scope, design, or delivery plans.

  • Review code and technical designs, setting a high bar while giving feedback that helps other engineers improve.

  • Coach mid-level and junior engineers through pairing, code review, debugging, and design discussion.

Requirements

  • Expert-level Python and Django, with strong object-oriented design and software engineering fundamentals.

  • Strong command of API design, service-oriented architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous processing.

  • Expert-level relational data modelling, including the ability to produce clear ERDs, define entities, relationships, constraints, and ownership, and design PostgreSQL schemas that balance correctness, performance, and safe evolution.

  • Demonstrable ability to turn incomplete product requirements into clear technical solution designs for complex backend changes, identifying assumptions and resolving ambiguity with product and engineering colleagues through concise written analysis and appropriate architecture, sequence, data-flow, and entity-relationship diagrams.

  • Sound judgement around automated testing, observability, production reliability, security, and data integrity.

  • Strong working fluency with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development workflows, including specification writing, code generation, test generation, and critical review.

  • Demonstrable ability to review technical designs and code, explain trade-offs, and coach less-experienced engineers.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and delivery risks in plain English.

  • Pragmatic delivery judgement, balancing immediate product needs with the maintainability and scalability of a long-lived platform.

  • High ambition and a strong sense of urgency, with the drive to deliver an ambitious product roadmap at pace using AI, and a positive, can-do attitude.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial commercial experience in Python and Django.

  • Experience building and operating Django-based services in production on AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Django REST Framework or FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Track record of designing and safely evolving complex relational data models in a large, long-lived production codebase, using ERDs and written technical designs to align engineers and stakeholders while preserving design quality, testability, maintainability, and safe evolution.

  • Experience working in cross-functional product teams with shared ownership of customer outcomes and production operation.

  • Experience using AI coding tools in a professional software delivery workflow, ideally within a spec-driven development framework.

Benefits

We offer:

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Fully remote working, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance at 4× salary

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation when someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle, and Techscheme programmes

  • Pension scheme

  • Company-sponsored dinners and social gatherings

It is designed for the complexity, volume, and regulatory demands of social housing, public sector property portfolios, and large residential operations. We are headquartered in London, with engineering and operations across the UK and Germany.

We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you want to work on hard, real-world problems in the world's largest asset class, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Plentific's product engineering organisation. You will manage the team leads of multiple engineering teams covering the core domains of our platform, with full accountability for the engineers across every discipline frontend, backend, mobile, and quality. You will report to the VP of Engineering.


You bring deep technical knowledge and a strong appetite for learning especially around agentic AI and how it is reshaping the way software is built. Your hands-on coding focuses on the engineering organisation itself: improving the agentic tooling, the SDD framework, and the developer experience that makes every engineer faster and better. You stay close to the codebase, contribute code where it unblocks progress or moves the agentic SDLC forward, and review pull requests in enough depth to assess code quality, the maturity of our agentic practice, and individual engineer performance. You are equally comfortable in a 1:1 with a struggling engineer, in a roadmap conversation with a product manager, and in a design review with a staff engineer.


Plentific's agentic software development transformation is already under way and producing results. We need a leader who can keep the momentum, expand it across every team, and partner with our engineering guild to refine the spec-driven development (SDD) framework, the agentic tooling, and the practices that have got us this far. You will help roll out SDD across the engineering organisation, drive adoption, and track the outcomes.


Success looks like a team that is continuously getting stronger: accelerating delivery cadence against business commitments, rising engineering standards, and an agentic development practice that compounds month on month.

Key Responsibilities

 

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead the product engineering organisation through its team leads, owning delivery, technical quality, and people outcomes across frontend, backend, mobile, and quality engineering.

  • Contribute code that improves the agentic tooling, the SDD framework, or the developer experience that supports every team. Review pull requests in enough depth to assess code quality, the maturity of our agentic SDLC, and individual engineer performance.

  • Set and enforce a high bar for engineering standards code review, testing, observability, and architectural review and hold every team to it.

 

Agentic and Spec-Driven Development

  • Champion agentic and spec-driven development practices across every team. Roll out our SDD framework, drive adoption, track its impact on delivery throughput and engineering quality, and feed learnings back into the practice.

  • Participate actively in Plentific's engineering guild, partnering with other technical leaders to improve the SDD framework and the agentic tooling the guild produces. Treat the framework and tooling as a product whose customers are the product managers, designers, and engineers running our product development.

 

Team Performance and Growth

  • Recruit, close, and retain exceptional engineers. Set the bar high enough that every hire strengthens the team, and never compromise on quality to fill seats.

  • Own and continuously improve our technical and behavioural interview methods. Design and iterate on live coding exercises, take-home challenges, and structured assessments so we evaluate candidate skills accurately, fairly, and at hiring scale.

  • Own performance management and career development across engineering. Define what good looks like, coach every engineer toward that standard, and help them exceed it. Give direct, honest feedback.

  • Build and develop the team leads, growing them into stronger managers through coaching, feedback, and clear expectations.

 

Delivery and Partnership

  • Partner with product managers to size and resource the roadmap accurately. Flag delivery risks early, make trade-offs explicit, and own on-time delivery against business commitments.

  • Establish a clear operating rhythm across engineering planning, delivery review, and post-mortem that gives engineers predictable cadence and the wider organisation visibility into progress.

  • Translate technical context for non-engineering stakeholders product, design, commercial, and the executive team and bring business context back into engineering decisions.

  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives alongside other engineering leaders, on topics from career frameworks to platform investment to cross-team standards.

 

Requirements

  • Demonstrable track record managing engineering managers and team leads across multiple teams, with full ownership of delivery and people outcomes.

  • Deep technical knowledge across modern software engineering, with the credibility to make architecture calls and the hands-on coding ability to contribute meaningfully when it improves the developer experience, the agentic SDLC, or unblocks teams.

  • Working fluency in Python and TypeScript, with practical production experience in both.

  • Practical experience integrating, evaluating, or productionising machine learning systems not necessarily as a researcher, but as someone who has shipped ML-powered features.

  • Active, current hands-on experience with agentic development tools: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent used as a daily part of your own engineering practice.

  • Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping software engineering, with a habit of staying ahead of new tooling and practices and bringing the best of them back to the team.

  • Track record of recruiting, closing, and retaining senior engineers and engineering managers, with a high-bar hiring philosophy.

  • Track record of designing and improving technical interview methods live coding, take-home challenges, structured behavioural interviews that assess candidate skills accurately at hiring scale.

  • Demonstrable experience addressing under-performance directly setting expectations early, coaching engineers to improve, and giving honest, timely feedback so nothing is a surprise.

  • Commercial pragmatism: you optimise for the business outcome, you can explain trade-offs to product and executive stakeholders without losing engineering credibility, and you are not afraid to make decisions that are right for the business but unpopular in the moment.

 

Experience and Qualifications

raw.title: Senior Product Manager
raw.description:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale.

The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.
We are headquartered in London, with engineering and operations across the UK and Germany. Our investors include Highland Europe, Brookfield, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures, and Target Global.


We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

 

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a core product surface on our platform. This spans diagnostics, intake, scheduling, status updates, and communications across web, mobile, messaging, WhatsApp, SMS, chatbot, and voice channels, together with the hand-offs into the operational workflows behind them.


You will sit in the Product team and report to the Head of Product. You will work closely with design, engineering, data, operations, customer teams, and AI specialists to build product experiences that are simple, reliable, and practical to operate.


This is an AI-native product role. We expect you to use agentic prototyping and spec-driven product development as part of your normal workflow, and to judge which models fit a given problem: when a hosted commercial model is the right call, and when privacy, GDPR, or data-residency constraints mean an open-source model in our own cloud environment is better. You do not need to build these systems yourself, but you do need the technical understanding to navigate the trade-offs and direct the work. You will turn user problems into clear specs, define quality gates for AI-powered experiences, and decide when automation is ready for production.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy, Discovery, and Delivery

  • Identify and model the jobs-to-be-done and workflows for users, providers, and operational teams, weighing operational constraints and commercial outcomes, and capture them as clear specs that engineering and design can act on.

  • Prioritise work using product analytics, operational data, support contact drivers, customer commitments, and AI-readiness risk.

  • Own the roadmap for the product suite, spanning diagnostics, scheduling, communications, chatbot, voice-agent, and self-service surfaces.

  • Lead discovery with users, housing providers, customer teams, operations, and internal users.

  • Translate ambiguous service problems into sequenced bets, measurable outcomes, and crisp trade-offs for senior stakeholders.

  • Own go-to-market for customer-facing launches: launch readiness, release sequencing, enablement, and internal and external launch communications with product marketing, customer, and operations teams.

  • Align product, engineering, design, data, operations, customer success, implementation, and support teams around scope, launch readiness, and adoption.

  • Improve user journeys that cross multiple operational systems, including issue classification, contractor availability, scheduling changes, notifications, and case escalation.

  • Measure product outcomes through experiments, cohort analysis, operational metrics, qualitative research, and post-launch reviews.

 

AI-Native Product Development

  • Use agentic prototyping tools to test interaction patterns, conversation flows, scheduling logic, and multimodal diagnostics before committing engineering capacity, deciding whether a problem calls for straightforward automation, a copilot feature, a fully agentic workflow, or a mixture.

  • Define specifications, acceptance criteria, and launch criteria for AI-powered product experiences.

  • Build and own evals for these experiences: define what good output looks like, assemble eval sets that check outputs against the required format and quality, and use the results to improve the solution.

  • Partner with engineering and AI specialists on LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG, context management, prompt iteration, model selection, and cost-performance trade-offs.

  • Design human-in-the-loop controls for cases where AI confidence, safety risk, or operational complexity requires escalation.

  • Establish quality metrics for chatbots and voice agents, including task completion, containment, hand-off success, latency, retrieval precision, and hallucination rate, and account for how voice agents integrate with telephony and contact-centre tooling.

  • Define the privacy, consent, auditability, and data-handling requirements for customer-facing AI features, especially where personal or sensitive data is involved.

  • Work with Security, Legal, Privacy, and customer stakeholders to agree guardrails for automated decisions, user communications, and autonomous workflows.

 

Requirements

  • Product management experience in B2B SaaS, marketplace, workflow, healthtech, proptech, fintech, or another regulated or operational domain.

  • Demonstrable experience building native mobile app products, including ownership of a native iOS or Android app from discovery through release and ongoing iteration.

  • Demonstrable experience shipping AI-powered product features from prototype to production, including controlled rollout and post-launch iteration, ideally across conversational AI, voice agents and telephony, workflow automation, decision support, diagnostics, or intelligent self-service.

  • Strong working knowledge of multimodal models, LLM capabilities and limitations, prompt engineering, tool calling, embeddings, RAG, and AI observability.

  • Fluency with evals: defining what good output looks like, building eval sets to check that outputs meet the required format and quality, and using the results to improve the solution.

  • Hands-on fluency with agentic prototyping and AI-assisted product development tools, such as agentic IDEs and prompt-driven prototyping environments, used to produce testable prototypes.

  • Working knowledge of low-code automation platforms such as n8n, Tray.io, Workato, or Zapier, enough to prototype workflows, scope feasibility, and direct engineering, without owning production builds yourself.

  • Sound understanding of AI risk in production, including hallucination, retrieval failure, automation bias, latency, cost, drift, privacy, and human escalation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication across technical, non-technical, and senior stakeholders.

  • High ambition and a strong bias for action, with the drive to deliver a large roadmap at pace and a positive, can-do attitude.

 

Experience and Qualifications

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including ownership of customer-facing product surfaces from discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Experience working closely with engineering, design, data, operations, customer success, and senior stakeholders.

  • Experience with products that involve scheduling, logistics, case management, customer support, field operations, regulated workflows, or high-volume service journeys.

  • Located in London and able to work from our London office on a hybrid basis.

  • Right to work in the United Kingdom.

Benefits

We offer:

  • A competitive compensation package

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Flexible working environment, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance at 4× salary

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation when someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle, and Techscheme programmes

  • Pension scheme

  • Company-sponsored lunches, dinners, and social gatherings

  • Fully stocked kitchen with drinks, snacks, fruit, and breakfast cereals

About Us

At Plentific, we’re redefining property management in real time. Our mission, is to lead real estate through the transformative journey into “The World of Now,” enabling us to empower property professionals through our innovative, cloud-based platform.

We harness cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights to streamline operations for landlords, letting agents, and property managers—enabling them to optimize maintenance, manage repairs, and make informed decisions instantly. Our platform is designed to create seamless, real-time workflows that transform traditional property management into a dynamic, digital experience. Backed by a world-class group of investors—including Noa, Highland Europe, Brookfields, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures, and Target Global—Plentific is at the forefront of the proptech revolution. Headquartered in London with a global outlook, we’re continually expanding our reach and impact.

We’re looking for forward-thinking, passionate professionals who are ready to contribute to our mission and drive industry innovation. If you’re excited about making an immediate impact and shaping the future of property management, explore career opportunities with us at Plentific.

The Role

Senior Software Engineer
raw.description:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

AI is changing the engineering industry, and we see it as a huge opportunity to deliver more value to our customers, at unprecedented scale and pace, and to a higher standard than ever before. We want to be at the forefront of this change as we become an AI-native engineering organisation.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help lead this change and shape the next generation of products that transform how organisations around the world use data. You'll join our R&D department, over 200 people across London, Ireland and Malaga, working in cross-functional teams helping to build the Quantexa Platform, our core Contextual Decision Intelligence offering. Our technology helps customers tackle complex challenges across fraud detection, financial crime, data management and more.

In this role you will:

  • Own the design, planning and delivery of entire features and epics end to end, ensuring they are delivered on time and to a high quality bar

  • Lead technical and architectural discussions, considering performance, reliability and security, and ensuring solutions work well within the wider system

  • Lead by example in AI-native engineering, helping to shape and drive the adoption of agentic tools and practices across the software development lifecycle

  • Build clean, well-tested and maintainable software, primarily in Scala, working with agentic tools to accelerate delivery and setting the standard for quality through code review

  • Work with Product Managers, Designers and Team Leads to shape upcoming features, contributing to estimates and reliable delivery plans

  • Mentor and support other engineers through code review, pairing and technical guidance, and take part in interviewing

  • Spot opportunities to improve processes, tooling and ways of working

Tech Stack:

Agentic tooling and automated workflows are embedded across our software development lifecycle, from design and coding through to testing, review and release, and we are building our own software factory, using services such as Claude to automate and accelerate how our engineers work.

On the back end, we build highly scalable, performant distributed services in Scala, capable of processing huge volumes of data. Our services are built on the Typelevel ecosystem (Cats, Cats Effect and fs2) and Apache Pekko, and we apply techniques such as event sourcing and CQRS in our persistence layer, giving us scalable datastores, flexible enough to meet the varied requirements of our customers. We also use Apache Spark and Kafka for large-scale data processing and streaming.

Our front end is built with Angular, TypeScript and Signals and is designed to be highly extensible, with AI agents accelerating how we build UI components and Playwright underpinning our component and integration testing. We also use Python for our client SDKs, enabling data scientists and engineers to work with the Platform from notebooks and data science environments.

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a product-focused mindset, with a passion for building high-quality software that has real-world impact and that customers love

  • Have practical experience using agentic tools (such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor) across the software development lifecycle, with a clear understanding of their strengths, limitations and how to apply them effectively

  • Have significant commercial experience building scalable backend systems on the JVM, ideally in Scala with functional programming (we'll also consider strong Java engineers with some Scala experience)

  • Have a strong grasp of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, maintainability and performance, and set a high bar in code review

  • Have experience designing distributed systems that scale to high volumes of data and users, with a solid understanding of architectural patterns such as event-driven design, event sourcing and CQRS

  • Take a big picture approach to solving problems, considering security, reliability and how solutions fit within the wider system

  • Have experience owning significant pieces of work through the full engineering lifecycle and into a live SaaS environment, and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving setting

  • Enjoy mentoring others and can communicate complex technical ideas clearly to engineers and stakeholders

Experience in the following would be beneficial:

  • Building large-scale data processing and ETL/analytics pipelines with Apache Spark, ideally on managed cloud platforms such as GCP Dataproc, Azure Databricks or AWS EMR

  • Improving data quality through cleansing, parsing and standardisation, and indexing data into search technologies such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch

  • DevOps tooling and practices such as Infra-as-Code, containerisation, Kubernetes and CI/CD, and delivering software that runs both on-premise and as a service (automation is something we’re passionate about, and we even have a dedicated Developer Tooling team)

  • Building or extending AI-enabled developer tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers or automated review workflows

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

The role

You lead how Sparta builds software in the AI era. You own our AI-native software development lifecycle: the development agents engineers work alongside, the CI/CD that ships their code, and the testing strategy that lets us move fast without breaking trading workflows.

AI has changed how code gets written, reviewed, and tested, and the tooling has not caught up. Your job is to make an engineer with Claude Code, a good harness and a fast pipeline several times more effective, and to prove it with data, not anecdotes.

What you will do

  • Own the AI development toolchain. Set up and evolve Claude Code and other development agents across engineering: shared skills, MCP servers, repo context, and guardrails, so agents work well in our codebase out of the box.

  • Build agents into the lifecycle. Automate the work around the code: AI-assisted code review, test generation, dependency upgrades, migrations and incident triage, with humans in the loop where it matters.

  • Make CI/CD fast and boring. Own build, test and release pipelines across the Nx monorepo: caching, affected-only builds, preview environments and safe, frequent deploys to AWS.

  • Build the guardrails for everyone who builds. Anyone can build now, including product, design, data and domain experts working with agents. Create the tooling that makes it safe for them to contribute code: automated quality gates, code ownership and review rules, preview environments, policy checks and agent evals in the pipeline, so good changes ship fast and risky ones are caught early. Testing strategy sits inside this: define what we test at each level and make the right tests cheap to write.

  • Keep it secure. Secrets, permissions and sandboxing for agents that read code and run commands, and supply-chain checks in the pipeline.

  • Raise the bar for everyone. Run enablement, write the playbooks, pair with teams and turn good practice from one team into the default for all of engineering.

What you bring

  • Extensive experience as a hands-on software engineer, with recent focus on developer experience, platform or build and release engineering.

  • You have rolled out AI coding tools to a team and made them stick: you know where agents help, where they fail and how to set them up for a real codebase.

  • You lead without needing authority: you treat engineers as customers, listen first, and win adoption with tools people want to use.

Nice to have

  • Built Claude Code skills, plugins or MCP servers, or extended another agent harness.

  • Deep CI/CD experience: you have designed pipelines for a monorepo, cut build and test times, and run safe, frequent releases.

  • Infrastructure as code and container platforms.

  • Experience defining or running engineering metrics.

Our stack for this team

Claude Ecosystem · Nx monorepo · GitHub · AWS · TypeScript · Python · Kotlin

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social.

As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey!

Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell.

What You'll Be Doing

  • UX flow design for entire game experience

  • Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations

  • Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance

  • Discover and manage external partners where needed

What You Have

  • 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games

  • Portfolio showcasing end-to-end UI/UX work on game projects, with examples of UI and UX flows

  • Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists

  • Passionate about both UI & UX design

  • Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.)

  • Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

  • At the forefront with AI tools and actively experimenting

  • Enjoys TCGs

Where You'll Be

This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role.

Supercell New Games

This is a dedicated environment for building from zero and shaped around a core belief: the best developers don’t need more direction, they need more freedom and fewer barriers. This is where games get the space they need to become cultural phenomenons.

Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale.

This is not for everyone. Building towards a billion-dollar game is going to be hard. But let's not kid ourselves: it should also be fun.

You build the rocket. We bring the launchpad.

Game-changing Financial Model

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

The Supercell Recruitment team

raw.description:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match 3 Level Designer to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define the game’s level design framework while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with designers, product managers, programmers and analysts to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience and reach product goals

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets the team’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

raw.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

In this role as an Enterprise Account Executive at UiPath, you’ll be a dedicated sales specialist for the Manufacturing and Supply Chain Vertical Solutions, a world-class, enterprise-grade Agentic AI offering.


Our AI platform optimizes inventory and pricing for global industry leaders including Nike, Heidelberg Materials and PepsiCo. With a core belief that businesses need their own AI — built for their business, with their data — UiPath's pre-built AI solutions can be configured to fit unique requirements.


This position will be a hybrid role across new business logo acquisition and existing account expansion with a portfolio of accounts, working with our International GTM team.


You will be responsible for generating pipeline and executing towards a net ARR sales target. You will identify, establish and develop relationships with new and existing customers whilst working as part of a close commercial team to deliver the professionalism, consultation, and innovation that our Customers expect.


The role is based in Manchester, with a weekly presence in the office required.

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Responsible for increasing revenue by hitting & exceeding sales objectives each quarter, through net new logos within our ICP of Manufacturing and Consumer Packaged Goods.

  • Responsible for renewal and growth of an existing portfolio of accounts.

  • Identify, establish, and develop relationships with new and existing customers. Learn about their needs, build trust and identify the opportunities where UiPath Vertical Solutions can drive value.

  • Generate and manage net new sales opportunities via personal outbound efforts (networking, cold calls, emails, social selling, etc.).

  • Execute on an accurate weekly, monthly, quarterly forecast to rollup to management.

  • Work closely with the Marketing team to create marketing campaigns and convert those sales leads into profitable business.

  • Work closely with our Solution Engineering and Data Insights Team to bring pre-sales processes to life and inspire customers to start their Agentic AI journey. Crafting sales decks, materials, and narratives to drive a compelling story and narrative.

What you'll bring to the team

  • Extensive experience selling SaaS end to end, including 5+ years experience of enterprise SaaS sales in complex cycles.

  • High energy, quick learner and passionate about consultative selling.

  • Demonstrated experience consistently exceeding sales quotas in New Logo acquisition – you are a top performer no matter the environment, particularly with mid and large-sized enterprises.

  • Proven ability and desire to generate your own opportunities via personal outbound efforts.

  • Trained and/or experienced in customer-centric selling methodologies (MEDDPICC, BANT).

  • Experience developing relationships and working with a partner network throughout the sales cycle (particularly Regional SIs and Global SIs).

  • The ability to travel approximately 25-30% of the time to regional meetings with prospects, customers, partners and field marketing events.

  • Experience and understanding of advanced analytics, machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience selling to manufacturers or consumer packaged goods companies.

#LI-FF1

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

Your mission

We are seeking a highly accomplished Senior Account Executive to drive new business and expand existing relationships across our Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) solution suite — including AML, KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), sanctions screening, and fraud prevention technology — within financial services enterprise accounts. This role is ideal for a seasoned sales professional who combines deep domain expertise in financial crime and regulatory compliance with a proven track record of closing complex, high-value enterprise deals.

The successful candidate will own the full sales cycle — from prospecting through close — engaging C-level and senior compliance, risk, and technology stakeholders at banks, fintechs, payment providers, and other regulated financial institutions across UK&I.

Enterprise Sales Execution

• Own and drive the full sales cycle for enterprise financial services accounts, from lead qualification to contract close.

• Build and manage a robust pipeline of net-new logos and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

• Consistently meet or exceed quota and revenue targets for AML/FCC compliance solutions.

• Develop and execute account-based sales strategies for top-tier banks, fintechs, payment providers, and financial institutions.

Domain-Driven Selling

• Leverage deep knowledge of AML, KYC, CDD/EDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, adverse media screening, entity resolution, case management, and regulatory reporting to credibly engage compliance and risk stakeholders.

• Translate complex regulatory requirements and financial crime trends (e.g., sanctions evasion, mule accounts, digital assets, AI-driven financial crime, beneficial ownership transparency) into clear business value propositions.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers, speaking fluently to regulatory pain points and compliance program needs.

• Understanding of positioning AI driven solutions across business, IT and transformation teams.

Executive & Stakeholder Engagement

• Build and maintain relationships with senior executives, Chief Compliance Officers, Heads of Financial Crime, risk leaders, and technology decision-makers.

• Lead executive briefings, discovery sessions, and strategic account reviews.

• Partner with customers throughout the buying journey to align solution capabilities to business and regulatory outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver tailored solutions and ensure smooth handoffs post-sale.

• Provide market and customer feedback to Product teams to inform roadmap and competitive positioning.

• Contribute domain expertise to RFP responses, competitive evaluations, and proposal development.

Pipeline & Forecast Management

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date pipeline, forecast, and account data in CRM.

• Provide regular, reliable forecasting to sales leadership.

• Identify and mitigate deal risk through proactive account management.

 

What you'll bring to the team

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field (or equivalent experience).

• 10+ years of enterprise sales experience selling software/technology solutions into financial services (banks, fintechs, payment providers, insurers, or capital markets firms).

• Extreme depth of knowledge in Financial Crime Compliance — AML, KYC/CDD, sanctions screening, fraud detection, transaction monitoring, and regulatory risk.

• Demonstrated history of success consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

• Proven ability to sell to and influence senior executives, compliance leaders, risk officers, and technology buyers.

• Strong understanding of global AML/FCC regulatory frameworks across UK&I

• Excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.

• Experience with enterprise CRM tools (Salesforce or similar) and structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, Command of the Message).

• Ability to travel as needed to support customer meetings and industry events.

Senior Delivery Manager
raw.description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Delivery Manager for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex  challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role working from our London office 2 days a week 

The Role

Are you a collaborative delivery leader who excels at bringing people together, nurturing talent, and guiding complex projects to success? As a Senior Delivery Manager at Waracle, you’ll play a pivotal role in creating supportive, high-performing environments where cross-functional teams can thrive. You will lead complex digital transformations end-to-end, serving as a trusted advisor to clients while mentoring the next generation of delivery talent. If you enjoy empowering teams, tackling big ideas, and building meaningful partnerships, we’d love to welcome you aboard.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Empowering & Coaching Teams: Coach cross-functional team members on estimation and prioritisation, fostering an environment where self-organisation, resilience, and psychological safety can flourish.

  • Proactive Risk Management: Facilitate RAID sessions and guide risks to resolution in alignment with our Delivery Playbook, keeping projects smooth and transparent.

  • Governance & Quality Delivery: Partner with teams to ensure large project outcomes meet quality standards, embedding best practices and "Definition of Done" outcomes.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Bring together Product, Design, and Engineering to build shared clarity on outcomes, manage dependencies, and celebrate shared wins.

  • Stakeholder Partnership: Navigate complex discussions with empathy, simplify technical delivery topics, and build consensus among stakeholders.

  • Thoughtful Commercial Stewardship: Use budget forecasting proactively to adapt team shape and spend, keeping projects healthy and aligned.

  • Building Practice Capability: Mentor junior and mid-level Delivery Managers and help lead Community of Practice initiatives like tooling or delivery metrics.


What you'll bring:

  • Pragmatic expertise in multiple digital delivery frameworks (such as Agile, Lean, XP, or Waterfall) and a passion for adapting them to fit your team's unique needs.

  • Proven experience managing risks and de-risking complex technical projects through open communication and structure.

  • Strong commercial awareness, with comfort around budget forecasting and resource allocation.

  • A genuine passion for coaching, mentoring, and lifting up talent around you.

  • Clear, empathetic communication skills with a track record of building trusted relationships across clients and internal teams

Recruitment Process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

  • 3.Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. This will be a practical presentation.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

raw.description:

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands.
