A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We're looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You'll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you'll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

What you'll do

Lead the programme

  • Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.
  • Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.
  • Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.
  • Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.

Drive delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.
  • Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.
  • Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
  • Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.

 

Align clients and stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.
  • Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.
  • Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.
  • Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.

Deliver measurable outcomes

  • Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.
  • Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.
  • Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.
  • A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.
  • Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.
  • The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.

Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.

What success looks like

  • A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes.
  • Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed.
  • Clear accountability across workstreams and strong alignment between clients, partners and delivery teams.
  • Timely, informed decision-making supported by transparent reporting and a reliable view of programme performance.
  • Measurable client outcomes, with clear evidence of adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • A programme that meets its objectives while adapting effectively as priorities and requirements evolve.

We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. raw.title: Social Media Coordinator
raw.description:
🚀 The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Social Media Coordinator to help create high-quality content across ZOE’s Organic Social channels.

This is a craft-focused role for someone who enjoys turning complex ideas into value-led content through filming, editing, writing, and publishing work that is clear, credible, and educational to our audience of 3 million.

You’ll work closely with our Social Media Manager to keep our channels consistent, reactive, and improving, with a strong focus on short-form video and storytelling.

👥 The Team

Our team moves quickly, values experimentation, and iterates based on data and reaction.
The superstar team you’ll work directly with:

  • ZOE’s Social Media Manager (your Line Manager)

  • ZOE’s PR, Podcast, Creative, Marketing, and Product teams

  • ZOE’s expert spokespeople and contributors

🎯 What You’ll Be Doing

  • Content Creator: Filming, editing, and publishing a high weekly volume of short-form content across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

  • Editing & Optimisation Specialist: Turning raw footage into multiple high-performing formats, shaping pacing, hooks, and structure to maximise retention.

  • Multi-Voice Copywriter: Write sharp, platform-native captions and scripts, adapting tone of voice across ZOE and our expert spokespeople.

  • On-Set Operator: Support and run London-based shoots, capturing strong content efficiently, working with senior talent, and spotting opportunities in the moment.

  • Reactive Content Builder: Move quickly from idea to publish, turning around timely, relevant content without compromising quality.

  • Organisation & Workflow Owner: Keep content pipelines running smoothly by managing assets, versions, and approvals.

  • Creative Collaborator: Work with the Social Media Manager to evolve formats, test new ideas, and improve performance across our core content pillars.


🧠 What You’ll Bring to the Table

  • Organic Social Experience: 1-3 years creating or supporting content for a brand or professional creator, with a strong understanding of what performs on short-form platforms.

  • Content Creation & Editing Skills: Confident shooting and editing short-form video, with a clear sense of pacing, structure, and platform-native formats.

  • On-Set Experience: Comfortable working in content shoots. You’re organised, proactive, and able to adapt in fast-moving environments.

  • Growth Mindset: Experience contributing to the launch or growth of an organic social channel, with a track record of improving performance over time.

  • Writing & Tone of Voice: You’re able to write clearly and adapt tone across different formats, audiences, and speakers.

🏅Bonus Experience

  • Nutrition, Health and Science Experience/Knowledge: You have previous experience in or are knowledgeable about nutrition, health, and science.

  • Community Management: You’re an expert in engaging with and growing online audiences.

  • Systems Thinking: You’re comfortable working within structured workflows and improving how content gets made and delivered.

  • Platform Expansion: You have experience or interest in launching and growing new channels.

💫 What’s Exciting About This Role

  • Work directly with world-leading scientists and help translate complex ideas into clear, engaging content

  • Be part of a fast-moving team focused on meaningful, evidence-based storytelling

  • Take ownership of execution and see your work reach a large, global audience

  • Develop your craft across filming, editing, writing, and performance optimisation

✨ Our Hiring Journey

We value your time. While the exact steps and timeline can vary slightly depending on the role, seniority, and team, we’ve designed a streamlined 4-step blueprint to get us from "Hello" to "Welcome to the team" as efficiently as possible:

  1. 👋 Intro Chat with the Talent Team: A high-energy alignment check to learn about you and share our vision.

  2. 🧠 Hiring Manager Interview: A tactical conversation focused on your craft, experience, and aspirations.

  3. 🔄 The Remote Loop: 2 to 4 focused interviews assessing your technical expertise, behavioural approach, and collaboration style.

  4. 🎉 Offer & Welcome: Finalising the details and getting you ready to hit the ground running!

Once we connect, we pride ourselves on moving fast. Our average hiring process takes between 20 to 30 days, depending on the complexity of the role.

We love momentum, but we’re always happy to adjust the timeline to match your schedule and personal preference.

___________________________________________________________________________

🚀 Ready to thrive? Apply Now

If you are genuinely excited about ZOE's mission and this opportunity, please don't hesitate to apply—even if you don't meet every single requirement listed. We fundamentally value potential and commitment above all else.

ZOE is an equal opportunity employer. If you require any reasonable accommodations during the interview process, just let us know—we are here to support you.

___________________________________________________________________________

Not the perfect match? Join ZOE's Talent Community!

If this role isn't the exact right fit, or the timing isn't right, don't let the journey end here. Drop your resume here. When a role opens up that matches your unique superpowers, you'll be the first person we reach out to.

 

📸 Stay Curious. Follow the Journey.

Want to see life behind the scenes, our latest health breakthroughs, and how we're changing the world through food? Follow us on our socials:

LinkedIn | Instagram | TikTok | YouTube | Facebook

raw.title: Events Lead
raw.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to growth, we are seeking an experienced Events Lead to take complete ownership of our events programme and build CuspAI's events function from the ground up.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the global events engine that accelerates CuspAI and the AI Materials Foundry, which is critical for driving real-world impact of our work across international markets.

Your main focus initially will be executing our flagship in-person Foundry event and subsequent international roadshows across Asia and Europe. Over time you will build out a repeatable event model, assemble an agile agency and vendor network, and establish CuspAI’s experiential presence across global scientific and machine learning conferences. As the team scales, the function will also own internal events.

What You Will Do

Foundry Events & Global Roadshows

  • Own our flagship in-person Foundry event end to end, establishing the core gathering for our global partner network.

  • With Partnerships, design, plan and deliver a regional roadshow of Foundry events across Asia, Europe and North America, creating a repeatable model for international expansion.

  • Run a regular cadence of virtual events to keep the global Foundry ecosystem engaged between in-person moments.

Partner, Customer & Conference Presence

  • With Comms/Marketing and Partnerships, design high-touch events for industrial partners and enterprise customers (e.g. executive dinners, virtual showcases, roundtables) aligned to commercial and ecosystem goals.

  • Own CuspAI’s presence at major conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, materials science summits): evaluate sponsorships, oversee booth and recruitment stand design, manage on-site logistics, and report on ROI.

  • Partner with Operations to deliver internal moments such as CuspCon, offsites and all-hands.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Communications, Product Marketing and Creative to bring CuspAI’s brand identity into physical spaces.

  • Work with Partnerships, Comms/Marketing and Operations to align every event with commercial, ecosystem and company goals.

  • Source and direct external agencies, AV suppliers and local vendors, and own budgets, timelines and post-event reporting to leadership.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about enabling world-class scientists and industry partners to collaborate on global sustainability and materials challenges.

  • 5+ years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or event operations within a high-growth tech, deep-tech, or B2B environment.

  • Track record of delivering high-touch physical and virtual events internationally across EMEA and APAC regions.

  • Strong vendor management experience, with a history of sourcing, negotiating with, and directing production agencies, AV teams, and freelance staff.

  • Proven ability to balance strategic planning (e.g. budget management, roadmap design, ROI measurement) with hands-on, on-site event execution.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder skills, with experience collaborating directly with executive leadership, sales, partnerships, and creative teams.

  • Flexibility to undertake regular UK and international travel for events, conferences, and site visits.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment building an event function or operational processes from scratch.

  • Direct experience engaging scientific, research-led, or highly technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with event management software, virtual event tools, and CRM systems (e.g. HubSpot, event platforms).

  • An eye for spatial design, environmental branding, or experiential production.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

raw.title: Quantitative Analyst Intern
raw.description:
Talos: Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Quantitative Analyst Intern

As a Quantitative Analyst Intern, you will support our team in analyzing trading and proprietary data, and helping produce quantitative models that drive the decision making behind our quantitative execution offerings. You will assist in producing quantitative signals, impact models, and analyze Talos unique trading datasets to support improvements of the trading products and beyond.

You will work alongside experienced team members, including product owners, quantitative analysts, and managers who will provide guidance and mentorship. This role offers excellent exposure to quantitative trading technology and will provide hands-on experience with financial markets data analysis. You'll gain practical experience while working with experienced professionals in the field.

This is a 12-week internship running from June 1, 2027 to August 27, 2027 for NYC based candidates. Compensation for this role will be $50/hr for NYC candidates.

Want to learn more about Talos’s engineering culture? Check out Sonic, our first open-source project which allows Talos to achieve microsecond network stack latency in Go: https://github.com/talostrading/sonic

Responsibilities

Quant Modelling

  • Assist in analyzing trading data, proprietary intraday signals, to produce quantitative execution alphas

  • Help create bespoke analytics visualizations using Talos data to illustrate trading patterns and execution insights

  • Learn to use internal tools and systems for data analysis

Quantitative Execution Algorithms

  • Work with Talos quants upon quantitative strategies that utilize execution alphas to drive trading decision making

  • Help gather and organize data related to trading algorithm performance

  • Learn about market microstructure and best execution practices

Business Support

  • Assist in preparing quantitative content for client meetings, presentations and academic research reporting

  • Work with the  Quant strategies to backtest real-world trading features for the pleasure of top leading crypto firms in the space

Qualifications

  • Graduating class of 2029 pursuing a Masters or Doctorate degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Programming Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python, with hands-on experience in data science libraries (especially pandas) and a strong understanding of dataframe architecture for data manipulation, transformation, and analysis. Familiarity with Python-based data visualization tools is a plus.

  • Database and Query Languages: Experience with SQL, including constructing and optimizing complex queries for large datasets; experience with BigQuery or other cloud-based querying platforms is a strong advantage.

  • Computational Finance: Exposure to computational finance concepts, with familiarity in using quantitative methods and tools for finance-related applications.

  • Statistics and Data Analysis: Strong statistical knowledge, including probability distributions, hypothesis testing, and data sampling methods. Ability to apply statistical analysis techniques to analyze financial data.

  • Mathematics and Machine Learning: Solid foundation in mathematical principles, including linear algebra and calculus, with a focus on regression analysis. Exposure to machine learning and deep learning algorithms and methods in the presence of sparse data, including common imputation approaches. .

  • Portfolio Optimization: Knowledge of portfolio optimization methodologies, specifically the Markowitz risk-return models is a plus.

  • Local to New York HQ or our London office

Check out these videos and link to learn more about the team!

  • Market Impact Modeling: Understanding Market Impact in Crypto Trading: The Talos Model for Estimating Execution Costs | Youtube

  • Execution Alphas: Youtube

  • Prediction Markets: Prediction Markets on Talos: Quant Execution Alpha Dashboard

  • Digital Asset Industry Thought Leadership: Bitcoin is not the Digital Asset Industry and Before the First Fill: Quantitative Pre-Trade Analytics and the Agentic Future of Digital and Multi-Asset Execution

 

Learn More About Talos

 

Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

  • Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW

  • Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan

  • Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More

  • Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions

  • Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024

  • Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."

Benefits

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

  • A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office

  • Evening socials with the entire office and fellow interns

  • Other in-office perks: Catered lunches on Tuesdays, snacks, and drinks

Also, check out other open positions listed on our website. Questions? Please contact

Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
raw.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team in London or Munich with a hybrid work setup. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of our Gift Cards vertical; one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning provider integrations, checkout and redemption flows, and multi-market expansion across France, Germany, and Spain.

You will lead commercial relationships with key gift card providers, define the product roadmap, and partner with engineering and design to scale gift cards into an integrated core offering across web, app, and browser extensions.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

#LI-PM1

#LI-Hybrid

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. 

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.
Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Key Responsibilities:

Communication & Stakeholder Management:

  • Act as the vital bridge between technical data architecture and business-focused enterprise treasury operations, translating complex data findings into clear, non-technical insights.

  • Proactively communicate with cross-regional teams (finance, engineering, and global treasury) across multiple time zones, ensuring alignment on data definitions, reporting requirements, and project timelines.

  • Draft clear, concise documentation for data pipelines, dashboard usage, and reporting metrics to ensure global teams can easily understand and leverage your tools.

  • Present analytical findings and AI/ML capabilities confidently to both the Manager and broader global stakeholders.

Data Modeling & Technical Execution:

  • Take technical requirements translated by the Manager and develop robust data pipelines and models to support treasury operations.

  • Extract, transform, and load (ETL/ELT) complex datasets using modern tech stacks including dbt, Google BigQuery, and Snowflake.

  • Ensure data architecture is scalable, reliable, and optimized for rapid querying and analysis.

Reporting, BI & Visualization:

  • Design, build, and maintain automated, user-friendly treasury dashboards and reports using Looker/Tableau/Power BI (or similar tools).

  • Ensure all reports are highly accurate, timely, and aligned with broader business OKRs.

  • Uncover and visualize key trends across all treasury domains to support senior stakeholders.

AI & Advanced Analytics Initiatives:

  • Explore and implement AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics to improve treasury insights.

  • Drive continuous improvement by evaluating new tools and methodologies to keep the team’s tech stack at the cutting edge.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field (Not Mandatory).

  • Experience:

    • 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence, preferably within a fintech, banking, payments, or financial services company.

    • Proven track record of working collaboratively and communicating effectively in distributed or cross-regional teams.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Advanced proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehousing (specifically BigQuery and Snowflake).

    • Hands-on experience with data transformation tools (dbt).

    • Strong expertise in building dashboards and visualizations in Looker.

    • Bonus: Practical experience or strong familiarity with integrating AI/ML models or leveraging Python/R for predictive analytics.

Key Competencies:

  • Exceptional Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex, technical data into clear narratives for diverse, global audiences.

  • Technical Agility: Deep understanding of the modern big data tech stack with an appetite for adopting new technologies, particularly in the AI space.

  • Collaboration & Teamwork: Thrives in a globally distributed environment, working seamlessly with diverse teams across borders and cultures.

  • Analytical Problem-Solving: Highly skilled at diving into complex, messy data to extract clean, reliable, and actionable insights.

  • Execution-Oriented: Ability to take high-level objectives and technical tasks delegated by the Manager and deliver scalable solutions efficiently.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

The Role

Checkout.com is looking for a proactive, data-driven and highly technical Associate to join our global Network Fee Management team. In this role, you’ll be building end-to-end AI solutions and fee simulation models, querying large-scale databases and transaction datasets, and evaluating card scheme economics to ensure billing accuracy and identify cost efficiencies. Partnering directly with commercial teams, you’ll deliver client-facing insights, prepare data-backed scenarios and cost models to support pricing strategies and help win and retain key merchant business.

Based in London as a core quantitative and data contributor, you’ll collaborate across Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. You’ll maintain and expand analytical models, design and deploy AI models from inception to production and evaluate scheme release impacts through structured data pipelines helping to automate this process. By turning complex database and fee data into practical financial models and actionable recommendations, you’ll directly guide commercial strategy, pricing decisions, and merchant discussions through strong project ownership and stakeholder influence.


How You'll Make an Impact

  • Tools, Data & Insight: Lead the end-to-end development of AI models - from data pipeline creation and training to final deployment - to drive automation, build predictive reporting, and improve analytical tools.

  • End-to-End AI & Predictive Modeling: Develop, train, and deploy machine learning and predictive models from start to finish to assess scheme changes (Visa, Mastercard), detect fee leakage, and identify cost optimization opportunities automatically.

  • Controls, Governance & Process Improvement: Maintain clear controls, documentation, and repeatable processes for fee analysis, reconciliations, and change management, helping the team work accurately and efficiently across markets.

  • Cost Simulation Engines: Architect and scale simulation engines and data models that enable internal Commercial and Finance teams to stress-test interchange and scheme fee changes without manual intervention.

  • Network Fee Analysis & Reconciliation: Analyse network and scheme fee data across data sources and scheme insights. Investigate variances, identify root causes, and document findings with clear supporting evidence.

What We're Looking For

  • Cost Model Delivery: Direct experience successfully designing, building, and launching complex global Cost models and structural frameworks, to aid the business in strategic design making.

  • Payments Expertise: 3+ years of experience in the payments industry within a fast-paced B2B environment, must have an understanding of payment network fee structures (Interchange, Scheme Fees, etc.) in particular Visa and Mastercard.

  • Operational Excellence & Commercial Impact: exceptionally organised and proactive operator who looks to drive continuous improvement, strengthens revenue assurance, and identifies opportunities to optimise costs.

  • Advanced SQL & Databases: Expert-level proficiency in SQL (window functions, query cost optimization, partitioning/clustering) and a comprehensive understanding of relational and analytical database architectures, with a strong proficiency in Big Query for data extraction and transformation; hands-on experience with BI tools.

  • Ambiguity & Drive: Takes ownership of complex, evolving scheme-fee challenges - reconciling data and turning fee changes into clear, practical guidance for merchants and internal teams.

raw.title: Staff Software Engineer - Payment Processing
raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Staff Engineer (Payment Processing) at Checkout.com, you will set the technical direction for our Gateway, Routing and Payout platforms. Every payment and payout we process passes through these systems, from the merchant's API request to the routing decision that sends it to the right acquirer, payment method or payout rail. Correctness matters on every transaction, and small changes in availability, latency or routing quality show up directly in our merchants' approval rates and revenue.

This is a role for engineers who are energised by scale and by the hard trade-offs that come with it: latency budgets on the authorisation path, failure domains and blast radius, consistency and idempotency across regions, and the operational reality of running critical infrastructure around the clock.

You will operate as a force multiplier across multiple teams - shaping architecture, raising the engineering bar, and turning ambiguous, business-critical problems into designs that can be delivered incrementally. We're looking for individuals with deep technical judgement, strong ownership, and a pragmatic approach to breaking big problems into smaller iterations that deliver value continuously.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own the architecture of high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems, defining the service boundaries, data models and integration patterns that let them scale by an order of magnitude

  • Design for resilience from first principles - redundancy, graceful degradation, backpressure, idempotency and recovery - so that partial failures never become customer-facing outages

  • Set and defend the non-functional requirements that matter: availability targets, latency percentiles, throughput ceilings, data durability and recovery objectives

  • Maintain accurate candidate intelligence, market maps and applicant tracking system records. Stay on top of commitments and next steps, and flag search risks early.

  • Use research platforms, market intelligence and AI tools to improve search speed and quality, checking accuracy and protecting confidential information.

What we look for

  • Recruitment experience with substantial hands-on responsibility for research, sourcing and candidate screening, and a track record of building strong pipelines for senior or specialist roles.

  • Thorough market-mapping skills. You can build a clear picture of a talent market, identify relevant organisations and people, and explain the reasoning behind your recommendations.

  • Compelling written and verbal communication. You create personalised outreach, engage senior candidates and ask thoughtful, probing questions.

raw.description:
Business Development Representative

CreatorIQ is looking for an ambitious Business Development Representative to join our sales team. Our BDRs are often the first point of contact for prospective clients, so you’ll be responsible for representing CreatorIQ and making a positive impression that sets the tone for the entire sales lifecycle. You will be empowered to prospect, qualify, set meetings, and develop strategic accounts for our Sales Teams with top media companies, agencies and brands. You’ll also become an expert in the rapidly expanding Influencer Industry as well as our SaaS technology platform as you prepare yourself for the next step in your sales career.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage and uncover opportunities from outbound & inbound leads

  • Research companies and approach potential partners through a targeted selling strategy

  • Connect with prospects using phone, email and LinkedIn

  • Drive revenue by collaborating with account executives and setting qualified meetings for Sales Reps

  • Collaborate with our Marketing team on lead generation efforts

  • Leverage a curated sales technology stack, such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, to execute your lead strategy

  • Become an expert on CreatorIQ’s platform, its value proposition and be able to communicate it effectively to prospective clients

  • Achieve daily and weekly effort metrics such as delivered emails and cold calls

  • Achieve monthly quota targets

 

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • 0-2+ years of experience in a BDR position or lead generation role

  • Naturally curious and have a strong desire to learn about the sales process, the people and companies you’re prospecting, the CreatorIQ platform, and the Influencer Marketing Industry

  • Self starter with creative problem solving ability

  • Communicate clearly and concisely, especially when it comes to complicated topics. You can break it down into simple terms people can understand

  • Enjoy being part of a team and doing whatever it takes to help that team succeed

  • Excited to build a long-term sales career

  • B.S. or a B.A. college degree.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Interested about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply!

What you will get from us:

  • People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave.

  • Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits.

  • Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead.

  • Equity: Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Work from home stipend: To assist you in setting up a home office that works for you.

Compensation, benefits, and beyond:

We know that benefits play a significant role in your overall compensation. We invite you to review our benefits and perks.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is enterprise infrastructure for creator marketing, trusted by more than 1,300 of the world's leading brands and agencies, including Beiersdorf, Delta Air Lines, Dentsu, Google, Nestlé, and Wella. Powered by the Creator Graph®, CreatorIQ's proprietary AI and intelligence foundation grounded in over 11 years of data, it’s built for teams, agents, and the entire enterprise tech stack. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices in Austin, London, Manila, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw, CreatorIQ’s global team moves quickly and deliberately because we're setting the pace for an industry that's still being defined.

Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, different perspectives make our work better. The people we hire come from different backgrounds and think in different ways — and that's exactly what helps us connect with each other, and with the customers and creators we serve.We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, and being a good human, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

Part-time; (10 hours per week)

With a dash of hard-work, a sprinkle of teamwork and a whole dollop of creativity, we created “Editions” which is our ‘dark kitchens’ business. Delivery-only kitchens have never been higher profile, or more valuable for improving service and selection for customers. Deliveroo Editions were the world's first delivery-only kitchens, and we are still the market leaders in helping our restaurant partners succeed. What’s even more exciting is that we’re expanding our portfolio further.

Great people help to drive our business forward and we are always looking for more to join our sites. If you don’t have the exact experience, that’s okay, we’d still love to hear from you. 

Does this sound tasty to you? Take a look at our Kitchen Assistant role and apply below to join the Roo family.

About the role

The Cleaner / Site Associate role covers a wide range of tasks across the Editions site. You will ensure that the site is clean, support the wider operation of the site to ensure that our loyal customers receive their orders as quickly as possible from our trusted partners. 

Responsibilities will include:

  • You will report into the Site Manager and the site management team.

  • Ensuring that the cleanliness of the site is maintained to a high standard by cleaning as you go throughout the shift as well as regular deep cleaning of various equipment throughout the week

  • Cleaning communal areas, such as staff room, bathrooms, stock rooms, maintaining site health and safety standards at all times

  • Working with the management team to ensure a safe and clean site by participating in regularly checking

  • Supporting our partners by keeping kitchen equipment clean and ready for use throughout the shift with the pot wash

Who we are looking for

  • You radiate positivity!

  • You have a great attitude to work, you are driven and have willingness to learn

  • You are a team player, punctuality and reliability is your forte

  • You always go above and beyond, you’re looking to progress in your career

  • You can work autonomously but you LOVE working with a fantastic team and with our partners

  • You like to solve problems, making recommendations on how to improve daily tasks

  • Previous experience in a Kitchen Porter or Kitchen Cleaner role is a bonus, but don’t worry if you haven’t, if you have the right attitude and drive, we can train you.

  • Step 1: apply for any role you'd like to be considered for - we'd love to hear from you!

  • Step 2: if your application is successful, you will receive an assessment from Maki People

  • Step 3: if you're successful following assessment, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to say hello and understand more about your experience

  • Step 4: if we decide to progress your application, you will be invited to an onsite interview with one of the site managers

  • Step 5: We'll come back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the outcome!

Why Deliveroo


Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. . We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace and Diversity

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer multiple great benefits in areas including health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest growing startups in an exciting space.

raw.description:
Warehouse Associate

Location: Canning Town (E16)

Working pattern: Onsite | Part-time | Shift-based (15 hours per week)

Pay: £14.40 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Associate to join our Canning Town team. Our Warehouse Associates are the beating heart of our day-to-day site operations. You’ll work closely with your management team to ensure our loyal customers get what they want when they need it, ensuring the smooth running of our Hop sites.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Execute precise order fulfillment by picking customer essentials quickly and accurately to meet delivery deadlines.

  • Maintain product integrity by ensuring all goods received and dispatched meet our high standards for freshness and quality.

  • Facilitate seamless logistics through clear communication with riders to ensure prompt order handovers.

  • Drive inventory excellence by supporting the intake of daily stock deliveries and assisting with ongoing inventory management.

  • Champion site safety and standards by maintaining a clean, organized warehouse environment for the whole team.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Adaptability in fast-paced environments, with the ability to remain focused under pressure.

  • Strong attention to detail to ensure order accuracy and high-quality stock control.

  • Effective communication skills to collaborate with teammates, managers, and riders.

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality with a drive to solve problems as they arise on-site.

  • A customer-first mindset, understanding that your speed and accuracy directly impact the user experience.

  • Previous experience in FMCG, Retail, or Warehouse environments is valued but not required.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, operations are central to how we build trust across our marketplace. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment where service excellence drives real impact.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences across our three-sided marketplace.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills with structured progression pathways and real opportunities to move into management.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively to achieve shared goals in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Enjoy the benefits of shift-based work that fits your schedule.

Our Interview Process

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine:

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

raw.title: Senior Associate, Dasher & Logistics - Strategy & Operations EMEA (L3)
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Role outline

Proposed title: Senior Associate, Dasher & Logistics - Strategy & Operations

Location: London Head Office (The River Building) - Hybrid working (60% in Head Office)

Mission: Ensure a reliable and scalable courier network across EMEA markets by continuously optimising the end-to-end lifecycle experience. You will translate data-driven insights into practical actions that strengthen engagement, performance, and long-term participation. Your role is to maintain the right balance of supply to meet changing operational and customer demand across markets.

Core interfaces: EMEA Dasher & Logistics Operations (Regional Operations, Planning & Performance, Content & Engagement), Product, Data Science, Analytics Engineering as needed.

Job Description (ready to paste into Greenhouse)

The team

The EMEA Strategy & Operations team is responsible for ensuring our Dasher network remains stable, engaged, and responsive across multiple markets. We oversee the processes behind courier onboarding and activation, focusing on enabling new couriers to get started successfully and supporting ongoing participation over time.

Our mission is to maintain a reliable and adaptable supply base that can flex in line with changing customer and operational demand. We combine data insights, operational strategy, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure our network remains healthy, resilient, and ready to scale.

The role

As a Senior Associate, you will play a key role in shaping the performance and stability of our courier network across multiple markets. You will focus on supporting the teams responsible for onboarding and activation through data driven insights.

 

This is a fast-paced and high-impact role, centred on understanding network dynamics, identifying emerging risks or opportunities, and implementing effective operational responses. You will be accountable for maintaining a healthy and responsive supply base throughout the lifecycle, ensuring it aligns with business and customer needs.

 

You will operate as a hands-on operator, executing upon team initiatives and driving continuous improvement. Working closely with cross-functional partners across operations, product, analytics, and other central teams, you will translate data and insights into scalable processes and frameworks. 

 

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience delivering operational improvements through complex data analysis and modelling in fast-paced environments. You have a track record of identifying gaps or opportunities and working across teams to build scalable solutions.
  • Strong analytical capability. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, structuring problems clearly and using data to inform decisions and prioritisation.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and confidence working with large datasets. You can use data to answer business questions and track performance, combining strong logical thinking with the ability to learn quickly. Experience building dashboards or automating reporting is a plus.
  • Confidence using AI tools to improve how work gets done. You can integrate AI into existing processes to improve efficiency and the quality of outputs, applying sound judgement to validate results.
  • A strong bias for outcomes. You focus on delivering impact, measuring results, and iterating based on evidence and learning.

Preferred, but not required

  • Familiarity with experimentation, measurement design, and operational change management.
  • You have experience using basic automation tools (like Zapier, smart spreadsheets, or basic scripts) to automate repetitive tasks and build simple systems that handle high-volume operations.
  • Experience with courier, logistics, or gig economy operations.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to be the definitive food company. We are transforming the way the world eats by making food more convenient and accessible. We are a technology-driven company working at pace, with the autonomy to build, test, and ship. If you enjoy solving messy problems and turning them into scalable systems, you will find plenty to do here.

Location and working pattern

This role is based in our London Head Office (The River Building) and follows our hybrid working approach, with an expectation of around 60% of your time in the office. We aim to be flexible where possible, balancing individual needs with collaboration, stakeholder engagement, and delivery.

Benefits and diversity

At Deliveroo, people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer a wide range of competitive benefits across health, family, finance, community, growth, and time away.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. We welcome people from all backgrounds and identities. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of building one of the fastest growing technology businesses in an exciting space.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

raw.title: Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Our global Legal team has built a strong reputation within the company for our highly collaborative and supportive approach to counseling, always with a bias for action. We are a diverse group of lawyers and legal professionals with a shared passion for providing creative, best-in-class service to our business partners. The Competition & Litigation team advises DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo on antitrust, competition, and litigation matters across every market we operate in.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you'll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week. 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.
  • Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams.
  • Manage antitrust and competition regulatory investigations and inquiries globally.
  • Help build out DoorDash's international competition compliance program, partnering with the Director, Competition & Litigation on training, policies, and processes across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.
  • Support competition-related litigation matters as needed, including document collection and review, witness preparation, and responses to third-party subpoenas.
  • Partner with policy and government relations teams to track legal and regulatory developments that could affect the business.

We're excited about you because…

  • You are a qualified solicitor in England & Wales (or bring similar qualifications in another European jurisdiction) with significant experience providing strategic legal advice to international businesses.
  • You have 7+ years of experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department, with a strong grounding in antitrust/competition law as a generalist — spanning M&A counseling, litigation, and regulatory/government investigations.
  • You have experience advising on competition issues in mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments, including regulatory filings and clearance strategy.
  • You have experience handling antitrust/competition regulatory inquiries or investigations, ideally including direct engagement with regulators such as the European Commission, UK CMA, DOJ, FTC, or other competition authorities.
  • You're comfortable operating as a generalist across a broad portfolio — you don't need deep pre-existing expertise in every sub-area, but you can quickly get up to speed and give practical, business-minded advice.
  • You're an excellent product counselor: able to translate complex antitrust concepts into clear, fast, actionable guidance for product and business teams.
  • You're comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and legal systems, and can navigate the added complexity of advising across three global brands (DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo).
  • You have strong organizational skills and can juggle multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-moving environment, both independently and as part of a team.
  • You're an outstanding communicator, both orally and in writing, with sound judgment on when to escalate and when to move forward independently.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Partner closely with business stakeholders with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Learn something new everyday Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

Engineering the future of customer support — at global scale 🌍

We believe exceptional customer service is more than just a feature, it's a fundamental part of who we are. That's why we've built our own internal support tooling from the ground up, tailored to help our customer, courier, and merchant support teams shine in every interaction.

As we scale our operations from 30 to 60 countries, supporting millions of users and partners, our internal tools need to scale with us. The Support Engineering group is at the heart of this mission. We build high-performance admin applications and core operational tools that empower our support teams to work smarter and faster. A key part of this is our in-house chat platform, which already handles around 5 million conversations every month. On top of this foundation, we're developing advanced features to reduce manual work, improve communication, and proactively resolve issues — often before our users even notice them.

Our systems range from automated reach-outs for delayed orders to deeply integrated tools that enable our support teams to deliver assistance quickly, reliably, and with a human touch. By removing inefficiencies and automating repetitive tasks, we're ensuring that our users and partners receive world-class support at scale.

 

About the role

We're now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to join us in building scalable, low-latency systems that power these tools and shape the future of customer support. You'll work on impactful products that directly influence how millions of people experience our platform every day.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain high-throughput backend services using Go.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and frontend developers to ship features that support internal support agents across the globe.

  • Design systems that are scalable, resilient, and easy to maintain.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making.

  • Write well-tested code and help the team maintain high code quality standards.

     

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling complex systems.

  • Production experience in Golang, with an interest in developing strong engineering practices.

  • Strong hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases — especially Cassandra.

  • Solid understanding of designing and operating low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Previous on-call experience, with a pragmatic approach to reliability and incident management.

 

Nice to have

  • Background in Node.js or other backend languages.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and event-driven architectures.

On top of this foundation, we're developing advanced features to reduce manual work, improve communication, and proactively resolve issues — often before our users even notice them.

Our systems range from automated reach-outs for delayed orders to deeply integrated tools that enable our support teams to deliver assistance quickly, reliably, and with a human touch. By removing inefficiencies and automating repetitive tasks, we're ensuring that our users and partners receive world-class support at scale.

 

About the role

We're now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to join us in building scalable, low-latency systems that power these tools and shape the future of customer support. You'll work on impactful products that directly influence how millions of people experience our platform every day.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain high-throughput backend services using Go.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and frontend developers to ship features that support internal support agents across the globe.

  • Design systems that are scalable, resilient, and easy to maintain.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making.

  • Write well-tested code and help the team maintain high code quality standards.

     

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling complex systems.

  • Production experience in Golang, with an interest in developing strong engineering practices.

  • Strong hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases — especially Cassandra.

  • Solid understanding of designing and operating low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Previous on-call experience, with a pragmatic approach to reliability and incident management.

 

Nice to have

  • Background in Node.js or other backend languages.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and event-driven architectures.

     

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice.
