raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Role

We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We obsess about building the future of food, whilst using our network as a force for good. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers.

Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build a definitive career, motivated by impact. Firstly, the impact that working here will have on your development, allowing you to grow faster than you might elsewhere; secondly, the impact that you can have on Deliveroo, leaving your mark as we scale; and finally, being part of something bigger, through the impact that we make together in our marketplace and communities.

This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What you'll do?

As a Software Engineer at Deliveroo, your individual work contributes to achieving goals in and across your team. While you will work with your team and you may lead projects, some of your work will contribute outside of your direct remit. You will report to managers and group leads and together deliver the results.

Technical Execution:

  • You will improve code structure, have an impact on architecture, and review code of any scope produced by your team.
  • You'll aim to simplify the maintenance and operation of production systems, visibility, operational readiness, and health of your team's systems.

Collaboration & Leadership:

  • As well as leading from the front regarding technical execution, you'll build relationships with other engineering teams and, identify collaboration opportunities.
  • You'll own larger pieces of work, assist with design and technical / implementation choices and influence the roadmap within your team.
  • You will take an active role in the hiring process and conducting engineering interviews. This will also extend to the current team where you will support the personal growth of colleagues, encouraging efficiency in their roles.

Expectations:

We want to emphasise that we don't expect you to meet all of the below but would love you to have experience in some of these areas.

  • Strong fullstack experience — comfortable working across backend (Go, or similar) and web frontend (React/TypeScript) to unblock delivery end-to-end
  • Experience designing, implementing and rolling out A/B experiments (or strong aptitude to quickly learn our experimentation platform) — including guardrail metrics, staged rollouts and reading results
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities and short XP cycles (weeks, not quarters)
  • Strong ownership mindset — able to take a brief/RFC through design, implementation, rollout and production monitoring with minimal hand-holding
  • Track record of shipping incrementally and iterating on data rather than big-bang launches
  • Willing to participate in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
  • 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.
  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
  • 🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
  • 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Lead Engineer
raw.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 2 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

We are looking for an experienced Lead Engineer to join our Collections, Recoveries and Investor (CRI) Engineering team, part of the Multi Product Experience (MPX) group within Core Services Engineering.

CRI spans two domains - Collections, Recoveries & Litigation (CRL) and Investor Management. Our systems sit directly in the path of every loan we fund and every investor relationship we hold, so reliability isn't optional. The stack is a mix of Ruby, Clojure and Python.

As Lead Engineer, you'll:

  • Lead your team(s) to deliver large, complex, ambiguous initiatives - brokering solution ideation across team boundaries and holding your team accountable for outcomes. With your Engineering Manager, you jointly own your team's engineering performance metrics, driving a culture of continuous improvement against them.

  • Champion engineering-led improvements across Product Engineering, proactively spotting gaps and shaping engineering-wide standards, including how to most effectively leverage AI.

  • Solve technical problems within your area of focus, acting as a recognised technical authority across Product Engineering and role-modelling effective use of AI tooling.

  • Drive technical strategy that correlates with commercial outcomes, proactively identifying how your area accounts for end-to-end customer needs and making trade-offs visible to product partners.

  • Collaborate with your Engineering Manager and Product Manager to set the technical and product vision for your team and domain, ensuring alignment with broader Technology and business strategy.

  • Drive architectural decisions affecting your team(s) and domain, ensuring designs are durable, scalable, and secure, while referring global decisions to the appropriate forums and owning the outcomes.

  • Communicate expertly with stakeholders at all levels (including non-technical audiences) and know how to adapt your stakeholder-management style to the situation, navigating contentious conversations when they arise.


What we’re looking for 🌱

We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.

  • A technical leader with a track record of owning complex, ambiguous delivery across team boundaries. Not just shipping features, but driving outcomes.

  • A genuine passion for mentoring and coaching, with feedback (both giving and receiving it) embedded in how you work.

  • Strong instincts for spotting cross-team friction or misalignment early, and the skill to navigate differing priorities to resolve it.

  • Experience in at least one major Programming language (e.g. Python, Ruby, Clojure).

  • Recognised technical authority in your domain, with Circlers across sub-departments seeking out your advice and trusting your judgement.

  • Proven ability to leverage AI tooling to raise the bar on how your team builds and ships. Using it yourself, but also helping others build genuine fluency.

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

raw.title: AI Platform Engineer
raw.description:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in under 200ms. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

 

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively uses AI tools to do their best work, from research and writing to building automated workflows. We expect every new hire to bring genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to working smarter and faster with it.

For some, this means staying open to new tools. For others, it means architecting new systems with AI at the core. We're transparent about expectations for every role, and we give you the tools and support to thrive.

About the Team

You'll join our small central AI team. We help every function at Harmonic, from sales to legal, achieve more with AI. People closest to the work bring the ideas and prototype solutions. We provide the shared platform, standards and guardrails, and turn the ideas with the most impact into AI solutions the whole company benefits from.

About the Role

At Harmonic we use AI to help us operate more effectively and scale as a business. You’ll take what works for one person and make it work for everyone: building skills, agents and workflows with AI at their core, and the shared platform where they are deployed and secured. You'll be the first engineer dedicated to this shared platform, working directly with the VP AI Engineering and with support from senior engineers across Harmonic.

Your time will be split roughly evenly between applied AI engineering, building the solutions, and platform and DevOps, the foundation they run on. Early on there is more platform work, as we set up things like agent deployment and a marketplace for sharing AI tools. As the platform matures, the balance moves towards building.

You'll partner closely with TechOps, Engineering, Security and the business teams we build with.

What You'll Do

You will be building and supporting the solutions and platform that let the whole company scale through AI, taking advantage of the latest vendor tools and capabilities. You'll use AI coding tools every day to do your work.

Applied AI Solutions that Work Company-Wide

  • Design and build AI skills, agents and workflows that use the latest models, tools and capabilities, working with the people who do the job.

  • Develop colleagues' ideas and prototypes into secure, scalable, cost effective companywide solutions.

  • Build and deploy shared AI capabilities as skills, agents, connectors and more.

  • Write tests and evaluations from real examples, and run them in CI within cost limits.

  • Monitor shared skills, agents and connectors, maintain and tune what's working, retire what isn't used.

  • Track, experiment with and evaluate the latest AI vendor features and tools as they are released.

Platform & DevOps: The Foundation Our AI-Powered Solutions Run On

  • Build and run shared AI infrastructure as code, reviewed and deployed through CI/CD pipelines, today on AWS, with Terraform and GitLab.

  • Deploy and operate secure connectors (MCP servers) so AI can act with the right constraints and permissions, with secrets managed centrally.

  • Build the pipeline for publishing, versioning and sharing skills, plugins and other AI tools.

  • Maintain and operate scheduled and triggered agents safely, each with its own identity, secrets and monitoring, tracking cost, performance, stability and usage across the platform.

  • Help colleagues build on the platform with docs, templates and support.

  • Create, document and maintain standards for AI solutions, such as how agents are deployed, so other teams can adopt them.

What You Bring

Engineering foundations

  • Demonstrable experience of hands-on DevOps, platform or cloud engineering in a real software team. A substantial internship on real production software counts.

  • Practical cloud infrastructure experience; for example AWS IAM, containers/ECS, S3 and networking basics.

  • Experience writing and reviewing infrastructure as code, for example with Terraform or OpenTofu, and shipping changes through CI/CD pipelines with a standard Git workflow.

  • Python (or similar) for tooling and automation, plus Linux and Docker basics.

Building with AI

  • Enthusiasm for solving real world problems with AI, shown by something you've built beyond using coding assistants, such as an agent, workflow or integration. A personal, university or work project counts.

  • Established day-to-day use of AI coding tools, and the habit of checking what they produce.

  • Awareness of the infrastructure and technical ecosystem that supports AI solutions; for example agent hosting platforms such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, MCP services, plugin marketplaces, LLM APIs and SDKs.

Working with colleagues

  • Clear communication with non-engineers: you explain technical choices, trade-offs and limits in plain language, in writing and in conversation.

  • Curiosity about how other teams work: you ask questions to understand a colleague’s problem before proposing a solution.

You don't need to have had an AI job title or an AI background, and you don't need to match every requirement.

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Are bright, curious, learn fast, and enjoy being the first person to build something.

  • See AI as a tool to help you build smarter, faster and better, and want to point it at problems that have real impact.

  • Want to spend at least half your time building AI solutions that colleagues rely on, using the latest tools and capabilities as they emerge.

  • Like being the link between engineers and the people who do the work.

  • Enjoy switching hats, moving between technical implementation and collaborating with colleagues.

  • Like to ship early and iterate.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced startup where priorities evolve and ambiguity is the norm.

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job, it's a chance to help define a category, and to build this chapter of the story from its first page. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

  • Recognized momentum: named to Rising in Cyber 2026, a signal the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity: join early in a category-defining company shaping how enterprises tackle one of tech's biggest unsolved problems

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity: a real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits: 401K, generous PTO

  • A small, high-trust team: transparency, creativity, continuous learning, no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership that cares about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites: past trips include Lisbon and Nashville

  • Real ownership: you'll shape a new part of the company from day one

 

Harmonic's Core Values

 

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work.

raw.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We’re hiring for the GTM Strategy & Operations team within Revenue Operations. This team serves as a core strategic and operational business partner to the GTM organizations, playing a critical role in driving GTM growth. In this role, you’ll act as a strategic force multiplier and a trusted advisor to GTM leadership.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with UKI Enterprise sales leadership to shape GTM strategy, refine existing processes, and optimise execution across the organisation

  • Run the Rhythm of the Business, building the operating cadences that enable structured growth, including business reviews, forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and annual planning

  • Own high-priority regional GTM initiatives end to end, from framing the problem and building the case through to delivery and measurable impact

  • Apply AI to turn pipeline and performance data into clear insights that sharpen decisions, surface bottlenecks, and speed up sales execution


What You Have

  • 7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Strategy & Operations, Consulting, or Professional Services. Ideal candidates will have a combination of operational experience in GTM Strategy & Operations experience in a high-tech growth environment, and experience in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, strategy / management consulting, or other highly analytical roles

  • Demonstrated ability to be an effective business partner – you know how to build trusted relationships, navigate different working styles, and influence without direct authority

  • Experience operating autonomously as a senior IC, owning projects end to end without people management

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; you’re energized by working across teams and can bring people together around shared goals

raw.description:
Join Instil's agentic product development team in 2027 and learn to build software the way it will be built in the agentic age: engineers owning the problem, the architecture and the key decisions, with AI agents accelerating everything in between.

About the role

At Instil, agentic product engineering is how we deliver. Our teams work alongside an agentic workforce that generates requirements, builds across parallel workstreams, runs continuous quality and security checks or monitoring systems in production. The result is software that ships faster, with lower risk.

The agents do a lot, but people stay firmly in charge - orchestrating. We own the problem, the architecture and the key decisions. That is the skill set we will help you build from day one.

As a graduate you will join a delivery team working on real client products for organisations ranging from ambitious start-ups to global brands. You will learn the fundamentals of great software engineering and, alongside them, how to direct, review and get the best out of AI agents.

What you'll do

You will work across our full delivery lifecycle, supported by experienced engineers and mentors.

  1. Plan: take part in discovery with clients, help shape requirements and use agents to turn ideas into rapid prototypes and a backlog ready to build.

  2. Build: write, review and test production code, directing agents across parallel workstreams and learning to judge when their output is right and when it is not.

  3. Ship: help release software to production, design for observability and use agents to monitor systems, analyse issues and drive improvements.

Along the way you will:

  • Learn to make sound technical decisions and explain them clearly

  • Build good habits in security, testing and code quality, so speed never comes at the cost of trust

  • Work directly with clients and colleagues as part of a collaborative, multi-disciplinary team

  • Share what you learn, as our ways of working with agents are evolving all the time

What we're looking for

We care more about how you think than what you already know.

Essential:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline

  • Solid programming fundamentals in at least one modern language, such as TypeScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, or C#

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor or similar, through projects, hackathons or coursework

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the judgement to question an answer rather than simply accept it

  • Clear communication skills and an enjoyment of working in a team

Nice to have:

  • Side projects, open source contributions or a portfolio that shows what you have built

  • An interest in cloud platforms, security or web and mobile development

raw.title: Finance Analyst
raw.description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting to our Financial Planning and Analytics Director, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the way our Finance team manages and interprets financial data. This is a unique opportunity to influence decision-making across the business, helping to drive sustainable growth and operational efficiency through structured, insightful analysis.

Please note that this role is initially offered as a six-month fixed-term position. You will join a lean, collaborative FP&A team and contribute to building a new way of working, where data is clean, accessible, and actionable. You will be part of transformative projects, including system migrations, which will redefine our financial processes and reporting capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Clean, transform, and organise large volumes of financial data from multiple systems into a structured format suitable for analysis.

  • Extract and manage data from ERP and finance systems, including Sage, Adaptive (from Workday), Salesforce, Certinia, and Melon, ensuring consistency and reliability.

  • Collaborate closely with Operations and other stakeholders to aggregate and interpret data for reporting and decision-making purposes.

  • Conduct detailed financial analysis, variance reporting, and forecasting to support senior management in strategic planning.

  • Build accurate, actionable reports and dashboards that provide clear insights to senior stakeholders.

  • Support the development of greater process, structure, and discipline in financial data management and reporting across the business.

  • Work proactively to meet deadlines, balancing multiple priorities and ensuring data integrity.

Qualifications

  • Over 2 years’ experience in financial planning, analysis (FP&A), and forecasting, with hands-on experience extracting data from ERP systems.

  • Strong financial knowledge, with the ability to interpret financial data.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate raw data into reports and actionable insights, and to inform decisions and develop business strategies.

  • Structured approach to streamline and automate processes while maintaining data integrity.

  • You’re great at collaborating with team members to achieve common goals, valuing and respecting diverse contributions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Senior Manager, Engagement
raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the Role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Professional Services is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced leader to run Legora's Professional Services team, building and developing the people who own our most significant professional services relationships, and setting the standard for how those firms adopt Legora and change the way they work.

This is a role for someone who has led teams through change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed, not hoped for. You will own the performance of the team and the outcomes of the portfolio it delivers: hiring and developing Engagement Managers, setting the adoption strategy they execute against, governing quality and pace, and stepping in at the senior moments that decide whether a programme lands.

That portfolio includes our global relationship with one key Big 4 client, our most significant professional services partnership, delivered by the Engagement Managers in your team across its member firms. You will set the direction for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide, hold the programme to account, and be the senior Legora voice in the room when it matters. You will travel when needed to support your team in market and build relationships at the most senior level.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption capability at Legora: designing the playbook the team works from, helping our clients realise measurable ROI, and scaling a function that can carry far more than it does today.

What You'll Do

You'll lead the Professional Services team and own the outcomes of the portfolio it delivers. Specifically, you will:

  • Lead, hire and develop the Professional Services team: set expectations, coach Engagement Managers, run performance and development conversations, and build a bench that can scale with the business.

  • Own the global adoption strategy for the portfolio, including our flagship Big 4 relationship, and hold the team accountable for coherent execution across regions and member firms.

  • Define the adoption playbook the team works from: the change-management approach, stakeholder mapping, operating cadence and target outcomes that make our programmes repeatable rather than heroic.

  • Govern delivery quality and pace: success plans, enablement, value reviews, escalation paths, and intervene where a programme is off track.

  • Act as the senior Legora relationship owner for the most important stakeholders in the portfolio, stepping in at executive moments, QBRs and escalations while your team runs the day-to-day programme.

  • Be accountable for adoption, retention and satisfaction across the portfolio, with clear measurable outcomes and ROI you can defend to clients and internally.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional engagement to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), maintaining end-to-end context across the portfolio.

  • Partner with GTM on key commercial moments to ensure seamless transitions, continuity and exceptional customer experience, and to identify and realise expansion opportunities across the portfolio.

  • Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning and enablement.

  • Travel internationally to support your team on the ground and build senior relationships across member firms.

What You Bring

You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You get satisfaction from making a team better than it was when you found it, and you're comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change.

We're looking for:

  • 8+ years' professional services experience - management consulting, legal, LegalTech or enterprise customer success in an AI-native B2B vertical.

  • At least 5 years in a people management role, with a track record of hiring, developing and retaining high-performing teams.

raw.title: Commercial Account Manager - UK
raw.description:
monday.com is building the AI work platform that not only helps manage and orchestrate work, but also does the work for you. Over 250,000 customers across departments worldwide use monday to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform, where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. From work management and CRM to service and dev, every product in our ecosystem runs on the same AI layer, automating tasks, running workflows, and helping teams deliver exponentially more with less effort.

We move fast with big impact, fuelled by a vibrant, ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations achieve more and outpace their competition.

This is a hybrid position, 3 days a week in our London office.


The role

We are building our UK Commercial Account Management team around one idea: we grow when our customers get real value from monday and can explicitly name the impact it has had for them.

As a Commercial Account Manager, you own a large book of existing customers and a revenue number. Your job is to understand each customer's business, find where monday can do more for them, build the case in their terms, and see it through to signature. It is a high-volume, high-activity role: you will speak to a lot of customers every week. You earn the right to ask for the business by being useful to the people you work with.

What you will do

  • Understand the customer's business first. Ask the questions that uncover what is costing them time or money, and build the business case in their numbers rather than ours.

  • Run a large book with intent. Prioritise your accounts, give the ones with the most potential a proper plan, and make sure no customer goes unspoken to.

  • Grow accounts across the platform. That means more teams, more products, AI that does real work for the customer, and services that help them get there faster.

  • Build your own pipeline. Pipeline is core to the job, not an afterthought. Plan your week around a high volume of customer conversations and protect that time.

  • Own your number. You carry an expansion and renewals quota and always know your gap and what you are doing this week to close it.

  • Plan renewals early. Start months ahead so renewal is a conversation about value and growth, not price.

  • Be a partner, not a vendor: Work with customer success, solutions and partner teams so customers get the outcomes they bought, and bring what you hear back into the business.


What we are looking for

Experience

  • At least two years in a target-carrying, customer-facing role with a lot of activity; agency recruitment, estate agency, inside sales and field sales roles are all good preparation. So is B2B SaaS, but it is not required.

  • A track record of something you’ve excelled at, whether that’s hitting a target, building a client portfolio, climbing a league table or excelling at a sport. We’d love to hear how you got there and the habits behind it

How you work

  • Drive. You want to hit the number and then beat it, quota is the floor not the target and you can show us times you have over achieved previously.

  • Organisation and work ethic. You can tell us how you structure your week and how you hold yourself to it when nobody is checking.

  • Coachability. You look for feedback, act on it quickly, and can give us an example where it changed how you work.

How you work with customers

  • Curiosity. You ask good questions about customers, about the people who do this job best, and about how you can get better.

  • Commercial intelligence. You can understand how a customer's business works, what is getting in its way, and explain clearly how we can help.

  • Relationship building. You communicate clearly, build trust quickly, and keep relationships strong over the long term, including with senior stakeholders.

  • Confidence. You’re comfortable talking about value and price with senior stakeholders, and you can handle pushback in a way that strengthens the relationship.


What you'll get from us

  • Clear, written standards for how to deliver in the role, so you always know what good looks like and where you stand.

  • Coaching on your own customer calls, and a monthly skills workshop built around live practice.

  • A development plan from your first month, with a clear route into Mid Market and beyond for people who perform.

  • A team that recognises great work, says what it thinks, and wants you to win.

You will scope and price the services that move an enterprise from AI ambition to AI running in production, support the sale of that work alongside the Account Owner, and orchestrate the consultants and engineers who deliver it. You will stay with the engagement well past the build, accountable for turning what the customer bought into AI that is genuinely doing their work.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our London office.

Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery with executives and process owners, then build the deployment strategy with them: which departments, workflows, and use cases move to intelligent, agent-driven execution on the monday AI work platform.

  • Translate that strategy into a scoped and priced services engagement, owning packaging, effort and unit estimation, and the proposals and statements of work that carry it.

  • Support the sale of services alongside the Account Owner, articulating the path from a customer's current state to AI in production for stakeholders from technical staff to executive sponsors.

  • Define the work clearly enough for someone else to build it, capturing the outcome, the estimate, and the shape of the solution, then bring in the forward deployed consultants and engineers who execute it.

  • Own timeline, budget, quality, risk, and commercial administration across your engagements, running one-time projects directly, overseeing execution on ongoing ones, and directing the resources assigned to you.

  • Define the work plan with customers on ongoing engagements, deciding together which AI use cases to build next and in what sequence.

  • Own AI value realisation inside your engagements, tracking consumption against the plan agreed at sale and diagnosing where adoption gaps or unbuilt workflows hold it back.

  • Identify and/or support the next outcome opportunity within your accounts, and drive the additional services needed to deliver it — expanding the engagement as new use cases and workflows are identified.

  • Communicate status, risk, and progress to stakeholders at every level, manage escalations to resolution, and surface account risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner.

  • Feed the practice from the field, contributing the patterns, estimation inputs, and playbooks that make each AI deployment faster than the last.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of professional services experience in delivery management, engagement management, or technical program management, with significant time in front of enterprise customers delivering successful strategic outcomes

  • Experience in B2B SaaS scoping and delivering software implementation, transformation, or managed services engagements in complex enterprise environments, working in industry-standard work management, project management, or CRM platforms.

  • Hands-on experience with Generative and Agentic AI tools, and a strong understanding of how AI changes the way work gets done.

  • Commercial acumen sufficient to scope, price, and support the sale of services rather than simply deliver them, including effort estimation and statement of work authorship.

  • Experience with consumption-based or usage-based commercial models, and with holding a customer to the value they set out to achieve, is a strong plus.

  • A track record of leading technical and non-technical delivery teams through influence, keeping the team aligned to a common goal.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to be credible in an architecture conversation and to recognise when an engagement needs deeper expertise: how enterprise systems exchange data, and when a goal calls for software to be built rather than configured.

  • Strong customer-facing and presentation skills, able to establish credibility with executives, articulate technical topics to a non-technical audience, and frame business outcomes for a technical one.

  • Detail-oriented with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies.

  • Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a positive attitude, empathy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt.

  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time.

  • BA or BS degree preferred.

offer.title: Member of Technical Staff (Index Engineer, Search Crawler)

raw.title: Member of Technical Staff (Index Engineer, Search Crawler)
raw.description:
AI answers are only as trustworthy as the information behind them. Perplexity grounds its answers in fresh, real-world sources, and the index is what makes that possible. We're looking for an engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of Perplexity's Search Crawler. You'll build systems that ingest, process, and organize large volumes of crawled content into efficient, queryable structures, working primarily on offline and nearline pipelines that keep data fresh, complete, and accessible to downstream retrieval. Throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical across datasets that change continuously.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines at the core of Perplexity's search infrastructure.

  • Develop and optimize indexing strategies that balance performance, freshness, and resource efficiency.

  • Work on storage formats, compaction, and update mechanisms that keep data accessible and current.

  • Keep pipelines reliable and predictable under high-throughput conditions.

  • Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interface contracts that stay flexible as the system evolves.

  • Define and implement observability across offline and near line pipelines, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals.

  • Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations as business needs change.

  • Partner with retrieval, ranking, and ML teams to make sure indexing outputs meet their requirements.

  • Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems.

  • Strong programming experience in Go, C++, or Rust.

  • Experience with high-throughput data processing systems and very large datasets.

  • Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability.

  • Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents.

  • A systems-thinking mindset and the ability to reason about end-to-end data flows.

raw.description:
Accountant

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're seeking an Accountant to join our Finance team and become the backbone of our financial operations. Working day-to-day with the Senior Accountant and Manager – Group Reporting, you'll be responsible for keeping cash flowing, invoices accurate, records clean, and month-end close predictable. This is a high-impact, hands-on role in a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure company where your accuracy and initiative directly enable faster decision-making and smoother operations.

You'll have broad exposure to financial operations across Radiant's global platform — from day-to-day banking and AR/AP to supporting the setup of new entities as we expand. If you're someone who takes pride in getting numbers right, enjoys solving problems, and wants to grow as the business scales, this role offers real visibility and development opportunity.

What You'll Do

  • Own AR/AP and banking activities that keep cash flowing and vendor relationships strong, processing invoices, payments, and queries with speed and accuracy.

  • Support and gradually own month-end close processes toward becoming predictable and smooth, preparing journals, accruals, and management schedules that leadership can rely on.

  • Assist with and learn revenue billing to ensure invoices go out accurately and on time, supporting clean revenue recognition and customer relationships.

  • Prepare reconciliations (balance sheet, bank, intercompany) that give the business confidence in its numbers, identifying and resolving issues quickly.

  • Support new global entity setups as Radiant expands into new jurisdictions, working with the Senior Accountant and external advisors to ensure proper accounting foundations from day one.

  • Collaborate across finance and operations to understand the business behind the transactions, learning how deals, contracts, and operations flow through the numbers.

  • Assist with year-end financial statement preparation and audit support, ensuring auditors have clean deliverables and the process runs smoothly.

  • Contribute ideas for process improvements and automation - spotting inefficiencies and suggesting ways to work smarter as we scale.

What You'll Bring

  • Part-qualified or actively working towards a professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

  • Experience in accounting or finance, ideally in a fast-paced or multi-entity environment where you've worked hands-on with AR/AP, reconciliations, and month-end close.

  • Solid accounting systems knowledge, strong Excel skills and comfort picking up new tools quickly.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy, you catch errors before they become problems and take pride in clean, reconciled numbers

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, you can investigate discrepancies and resolve them with support from the Senior Accountant.

  • Clear communication and collaborative approach, you work well with the Senior Accountant, colleagues across finance, and stakeholders in operations

  • Strong organisation and time management, you can juggle multiple deadlines and priorities in a fast-moving environment

  • Intellectual curiosity about the business, you want to understand not just how to process a transaction, but why it matters and how it impacts the company

  • Proactive mindset, you don't just follow processes, you suggest better ways to do them

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with Xero or other modern accounting platforms and navigating system migrations

  • Exposure to fast-scaling or multi-entity businesses

  • Familiarity with energy, infrastructure, or capital-intensive industries

What Success Looks Like

AR/AP runs smoothly, invoices are processed on time, and payments happen without friction or escalation.

Month-end close is predictable and efficient, the team trust your work, your schedules, and your ability to own pieces of the close.

Your reconciliations are thorough and timely, you catch issues early, resolve them fast, and the business has clean, accurate numbers it can rely on.

You contribute ideas that improve how we work, suggesting automations or process changes that make the team more efficient.

Why Join Radiant

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

  • Work on a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure business at the forefront of the industry

  • Get broad exposure to financial operations, AR/AP, close processes, entity setup, audit - developing well-rounded accounting skills

  • Be part of a team where you're genuinely valued and your work directly enables business decisions

  • Develop your career in a Brookfield-backed company with resources, mentorship, and genuine growth opportunities

raw.description:
Job Title: Associate, Capital Markets

Location: Hybrid

 

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Job Summary:

As we expand our portfolio of AI factories, GPU clusters and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring an Associate to join our capital markets team.

You will support the capital markets function responsible for raising, monitoring and refinancing the debt required to build out Radiant’s AI infrastructure platform. Working closely with senior members of the capital markets, investment and executive leadership teams, you will build financial models, prepare lender materials, help evaluate commercial term sheets, coordinate execution and contribute to the development of the group’s financing strategy. You will interact with teams across the business, from procurement and construction to power and operations, to ensure financings are aligned with GPU delivery schedules and capex requirements.

You will operate at the intersection of power, compute, capital and software — gaining exposure to complex financings while helping deploy significant capital into infrastructure assets that will underpin the next era of the AI economy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support all financing activities for new GPU clusters and AI factories, including project financings, GPU / equipment-backed financings, and corporate facilities.

  • Track broad bank / debt capital markets conditions and market developments relevant to our business.

  • Build and maintain financial models covering debt sizing, cash flow waterfalls, covenant and ratio analysis, sensitivities and downside cases.

  • Analyse offtake arrangements and associated credit support to assess bankability and inform financing structure.

  • Draft lender information memoranda, credit rating agency materials and financing recommendations for senior management.

  • Review and comment on financing documentation (e.g. credit agreements, intercreditor arrangements, and security packages).

  • Coordinate transaction execution, including data rooms, due diligence requests, closing checklists and conditions precedent, through to financial close.

  • Support the platform’s preparation for debt capital markets issuance to term out bank and project financings, including analysis of market comparables, pricing and investor appetite.

  • Contribute to financing strategy discussions and the growth of Radiant’s capital markets capabilities.

Qualifications:

  • 4–6 years of credit experience gained in project finance, acquisition finance, debt capital markets, private credit or infrastructure lending, with a working knowledge of debt structuring and credit documentation.

  • Advanced financial modelling skills, including the ability to build and audit project finance and corporate debt models.

  • Strong written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience drafting lender presentations, information memoranda and credit papers.

  • Ability to read and interpret commercial contracts, including customer, supply and financing agreements, and identify financing implications.

  • Experience working with guidance and increasing independence in ambiguous and fast-moving environments, managing multiple workstreams and delivering high-quality work under tight timelines.

  • High levels of ownership, accountability and attention to detail together with commercial judgement, intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for AI infrastructure.

Desirable:

  • Experience in data centres, digital infrastructure, telecommunications, energy, power, utilities or cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, AI infrastructure or hyperscaler ecosystems and their financing considerations.

  • Exposure to interest rate, FX, power or commodity hedging.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Produce robust credit analysis, financial models and lender materials that support sound decisions and execution.

  • Help execute financings efficiently from term sheet through closing and post-close, across multiple deployments.

  • Grow into greater responsibility for structuring, negotiation and financing strategy while contributing to a diversified funding base and lower cost of capital.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

raw.title: Director, Technical Product Marketing
raw.description:
• Radiant builds and operates AI-native cloud platforms for high-performance GPU workloads.

  • Our infrastructure brings together data centres, compute, networking, storage and software for customers with demanding AI requirements.

  • As we grow internationally, we are establishing Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in several regions to provide specialist capability and operational support to teams across Radiant.

About the Role

Radiant is looking for a Director of Technical Product Marketing with deep, hands-on knowledge of AI infrastructure, GPU compute and datacenters to turn our technical advantages into clear, credible, market-facing narratives.

The role in brief

  • An embedded role, close to the product, close to engineering, and close to what we are building: end-to-end datacenters purpose-built for large-scale GPU compute and AI model training and inference.

  • You will spend time with infrastructure, datacenter design and operations, product, engineering, solutions, partnerships and the leadership team.

  • You will extract the technical truth from the building (power and cooling design, GPU cluster architecture, networking fabric, how customers train and serve models) and identify what is differentiated.

  • You will turn that into blogs, web pages, whitepapers, case studies, executive thought leadership, speaking narratives and product storytelling.

What this role is not

  • Not a conventional PMM role centred only on launch checklists, personas and sales decks. Our audience is hyperfocused and well understood.

  • Not a technical writing role.

The right person

  • Technically curious, commercially sharp, and an exceptional writer.

  • Deeply technical in data centers / AI factories and AI infrastructure.

  • Understands GPU and accelerator architectures, how frontier models are trained and served, and what those workloads demand of power, cooling, networking and physical design.

  • Knows how to sit with engineers, ask good questions, pressure-test claims, and translate complex infrastructure into language that is accurate, compelling and useful.

What You'll Do

Technical Product Narrative

  • Own Radiant's technical product narrative across our GPU platform, infrastructure, datacenter footprint and market-facing offerings.

  • Work with product and engineering to understand what we build, how it works, what problems it solves and why it is different, from site, power and thermal design through to GPU cluster performance and model workload efficiency.

  • Translate that into positioning, messaging, product explanations and technical narratives for customers, partners, analysts, executives and the broader market.

  • The questions you'll be asking:

    • Why did we build this this way?

    • What breaks at scale: power density, liquid cooling, GPU interconnect, cluster utilisation?

    • What tradeoff did we avoid?

    • What is genuinely differentiated, and what is defensible?

    • What should a technical buyer, such as a model builder or hyperscaler infrastructure lead, care about?

Technical Content & Thought Leadership

  • Create the core technical content that gives hyperscaler and AI lab customers confidence that Radiant is who they should trust to run their most demanding GPU workloads.

  • Formats include:

    • Technical blog posts, product pages and solution pages

    • Whitepapers and reference architecture content (GPU cluster design, high-density rack deployments, liquid cooling, power architecture)

    • Case studies and customer stories

    • Launch narratives and technical explainers

    • Executive essays and long-form thought leadership

  • Make complex topics understandable without making them simplistic.

  • Write for technical buyers, ML and infrastructure engineers, datacenter engineers, business decision-makers, partners, investors and industry observers, adjusting the level of detail without losing credibility.

Web & Product Copy

  • Help shape the language on Radiant's website and product pages.

  • Turn internal product reality into strong external copy that covers:

    • What the product does and who it is for

    • Why it matters and how it is different

    • The proof points that support the claim (GPU performance, power efficiency, capacity, deployment speed)

  • Work with design, web, product and marketing teams to create pages that are clear, technically grounded and commercially useful.

Speaking & Executive Substance

  • Create the technical spine behind talks, panels, submissions, keynotes, podcasts, executive posts and strategic narratives across the AI and datacenter industry calendar.

  • The social and communications team may own the opportunity pipeline and distribution cadence. You provide the substance: the thesis, the architecture, the proof points, the technical argument, the story arc and the language.

  • Ghostwrite for corporate and executive voices where content needs technical depth, product understanding or strategic market framing, on topics such as GPU generations, AI compute supply, power availability and model scaling.

  • Be public-facing yourself: an excellent communicator with a credible presence in the datacenter and AI infrastructure community, able to hold your own on stage and in a room of engineers and AI researchers.

Case Studies, Customer Stories & Proof Points

  • Build Radiant's library of customer, partner and product proof.

  • Work with sales, solutions, customer teams, GPU and hardware partners, and leadership to identify strong stories.

  • Turn them into case studies, web copy, blogs, presentations and sales-supporting narratives.

  • Find the real story behind each account:

    • What problem existed

    • What was deployed (compute, cooling, power, network)

    • What changed for the customer's models and workloads

    • What was hard, what mattered, and what the market should learn from it

Internal Translation

  • Act as a bridge between engineering, datacenter operations, product, sales, marketing and leadership.

  • Engineers should trust you because you ask good questions and represent the technology accurately, down to the GPU, the rack and the megawatt.

  • Marketing should trust you because you can turn complex ideas into clear, compelling language.

  • Sales should trust you because your work helps customers understand why Radiant matters.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days

  • Strong working relationships built with product and engineering.

  • A clear understanding of Radiant's technical architecture, GPU platform, datacenter design and product priorities.

  • A meaningful set of market-facing assets shipped.

  • A repeatable process for extracting technical stories from the organisation and turning them into blogs, web copy, technical narratives, executive content, speaking inputs and longer-form assets.

Over time

  • Radiant has a deeper, sharper, more technically credible voice and is recognised as a leading voice in AI infrastructure and datacenters.

  • The website explains the product more clearly.

  • Our blogs are technical, differentiated, and read by the people who build and run AI at scale.

Who You Are

Experience and technical depth

  • 8–12+ years in technical product marketing, product marketing, technical content, developer marketing, infrastructure marketing, solutions marketing or a closely related role, with a substantial part of that in AI infrastructure, GPU compute or datacenters.

  • A background in cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, data infrastructure, datacenters or high-performance computing.

  • Deep technical AI experience (essential): you understand how GPUs and accelerators work, how models are trained and served, and how those workloads drive compute, networking, power and cooling design. A technical degree is preferred.

  • You know datacenters from the inside: power density, liquid and air cooling, electrical and mechanical design, capacity planning and build-out, with a visible presence or network in the datacenter community.

  • Technically fluent enough to work directly with product managers, engineers, architects, ML practitioners, datacenter engineers and technical executives. You don't need to be an engineer, but you understand complex systems, from GPU interconnects and cluster topology to the power and thermal envelope of a hall.

  • You keep up with the market: GPU roadmaps, model releases and datacenter developments, and you can explain what each new generation means for infrastructure.

Writing and judgment

  • An excellent writer who can produce product pages, blogs, whitepapers, case studies, executive essays, launch narratives and technical explainers on GPU infrastructure, AI models and datacenter design with minimal handholding.

  • Strong product judgment: you can distinguish a feature from a benefit, a claim from a proof point, a capability from a differentiated position, and a generic AI market trend from a useful point of view.

  • Strong editorial taste: you know when copy is too generic, too inflated, too shallow or too complicated, and can make technical content sharper without making it flashy or imprecise.

Ways of working

  • Comfortable working in the building: regular face time with product, engineering and leadership is part of the job, as is time on site in our datacenters.

  • Highly autonomous: you don't wait for perfect briefs. You find the right people, ask the right questions, create the draft, pressure-test the claims and move the work forward.

  • Commercially aware: you understand that technical marketing exists to help the market understand the company, help customers evaluate the product, help sales tell the story, help executives communicate clearly, and help the company build credibility in a highly competitive AI infrastructure market.

Ideal Background

  • Where you've worked: high-growth B2B technology companies, AI infrastructure companies, GPU cloud / neocloud providers, hyperscale and colocation datacenter operators, AI model companies, cloud platforms, data infrastructure companies, telecom infrastructure businesses, semiconductor ecosystems (particularly GPU and accelerator vendors), or technical agencies with deep infrastructure experience.

  • Strongly preferred: experience working with engineers, architects, ML researchers, datacenter design teams, product leaders, founders or technical executives.

  • Required: experience writing about complex technical topics for external audiences, specifically on GPU compute, AI models and datacenter infrastructure.

  • Strong advantage: a track record of speaking, publishing or being visibly active in the AI infrastructure or datacenter community.

To ensure our recruitment processes provide an equal opportunity for all applicants to succeed, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments that we can make.

  • Lead month-end and year-end close cycles that keep pace with rapid growth, consolidating entities across multiple jurisdictions while maintaining audit-ready quality.

  • Own IFRS consolidation and intercompany accounting, eliminating the noise so leadership sees true group profitability and liquidity position.

  • Collaborate across engineering, HR, operations, and marketing teams -translating financial data into insights that inform business decisions and ensuring finance is a true partner in building cohesive company communication.

  • Manage the audit relationship as the exec team's partner, ensuring external auditors have confidence in our controls and processes.

  • Partner across finance and operations to understand the business drivers behind the numbers, becoming a strategic advisor not just a reporter.

  • Support strategic decision-making by translating complex multi-entity transactions into clear financial data and metrics.

  • Drive continuous improvement, building world-class, controls driven processes that champion AI-driven reporting tools and automation to increase speed, accuracy, and scalability as we grow.

What You'll Bring

  • Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA/CPA or equivalent) with 5+ years of experience in financial reporting, with at least 2 years in IFRS consolidation or group financial reporting.

  • Strong technical skills withdvanced Excel, PowerPoint for reporting, and ability to transition to enterprise accounting software.

  • Clear understanding of complex accounting areas, particularly IFRS 16 lease accounting and revenue recognition under IFRS 15, you can navigate non-standard transactions and help business teams understand accounting implications before deals are done.

  • Strong collaborator who can translate between business and accounting, explaining finance to non-finance teams in clear language.

  • Excellent stakeholder management - building relationships with business leaders, external auditors, and finance teams to ensure complex transactions are properly reflected in consolidated statements.

  • Commercial acumen to understand lease negotiations, revenue terms, and deal structures - and helping inform strategic decisions while ensuring accounting reflects business reality.

  • Experience with IFRS 9 derivatives and hedging.

Month-end close is a smooth, predictable rhythm; your team owns the calendar, not the other way around.

Leadership trusts our consolidated numbers completely, they reference your reports in board meetings and investor calls with confidence

Execs proactively involve you in strategic decisions because they know you understand the financial implications, your insights help shape how Radiant deploys capital

  • Work on a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure business at the forefront of the industry

We're seeking a Senior Accountant to own core financial operations across Radiant's fast-scaling platform and help build the finance function as we grow.   • Own Revenue & AR and Expenses & AP processes end-to-end, establishing robust controls, driving accuracy, resolving complex queries, and ensuring timely collections and payment approvals that maximize vendor relationships

  • Lead month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, reviewing journals, accruals, and management schedules, and ensure all stakeholders have timely, accurate reporting

  • Oversee revenue billing and reconciliations, managing the complete cycle from billing accuracy to resolution external discrepancies

  • Take ownership of year-end financial statement preparation, including supporting schedules, disclosures, and technical accounting decisions

  • Act as the primary contact for external auditors, coordinating audit deliverables, resolving technical accounting questions, and driving resolution of audit matters

  • Lead the finance and accounting workstream for new global entity setups, navigating multi-jurisdictional complexity and establishing proper financial foundations from day one

  • Mentor and review work from junior team members, building their technical skills, quality control, and understanding of our accounting approach

  • Collaborate across the broader finance team and business stakeholders, building effective relationships and ensuring timely, accurate financial information flows across the organization

  • Drive continuous improvement in financial controls, accounting processes, and reporting procedures, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and strengthen our financial foundation.

What You'll Bring

  • Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with 4-7 years of accounting experience, gained in public accounting or industry roles, ideally in multi-entity or international environments.

  • Strong Excel capabilities, accounting system knowledge, and ability to pick up new tools and processes quickly.

  • Strong technical accounting and financial reporting skills, you understand accounting standards and controls and can navigate complex transactions.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy, you maintain high standards while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving ability, you investigate issues thoroughly and drive resolution, often taking ownership of solutions.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, you build trust with colleagues, external auditors, and senior management.

  • Natural mentor, you help junior team members develop skills, ask good questions, and take pride in building capability in others.

  • Strong organisation and time management, you juggle multiple work streams, manage competing deadlines, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Background with modern accounting platforms (Xero, NetSuite, or equivalent)

  • Experience with regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions

Financial operations run smoothly, AR/AP is accurate and timely, month-end close happens predictably without fire-fighting, and senior management trusts the numbers.

Your junior team members are developing stronger skills and ownership, they come to you for guidance, and you're actively building their capability.

raw.description:
Job Title: Senior Legal Counsel (Director)

Location: Hybrid

 

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Job Summary:

We're looking for a Senior Legal Counsel (Director) to join Radiant's Legal Team, working alongside and reporting to the General Counsel as one of the first lawyers in the business. You will take ownership of and lead on contractual negotiations and drafting of a wide range of agreements covering our customers and supply chain, plus areas of compliance and the development of new systems and processes. You will get to shape how the business operates and functions, allowing it to seize opportunities and grow rapidly, whilst managing risk, scaling sustainably and keeping clear long-term goals in focus.

Strong technical legal skills are the bedrock of this role, combined with a strong sense of commercial judgment and the wider risk environment. The answers are not always clear or certain and being able to balance a range of factors and still give clear guidance or make a decision is part of this role.

Your experience will ideally be built in commercial contracting within the data centre and AI space or, more generally, IT or technology, alongside developing or running in-house compliance programmes.

You will work across hyperscaler and enterprise customer contracts, supply chain arrangements and data centre agreements. Integrating with our debt financing and understanding and managing how that impacts and shapes so much of what we do will be critical. Supporting or leading on ABC and other areas of compliance will be essential.

Additional areas of work will be numerous. You need to be at ease with being out of your comfort zone, bringing your experience and intelligence to new areas and will view this as a great opportunity to grow and expand rather than just turning up 9 to 5.
