raw.title: Treasury Manager
raw.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our investment platform and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our capital markets capabilities with leaders who can combine rigorous underwriting with commercial judgement and execution excellence.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

As Radiant scales its portfolio of GPU clusters, AI factories, and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring a Treasury Manager to support the Group's treasury function, partnering with the Group Finance Director and Head of Capital Markets to build a best in class treasury operation.

You will play a central role in managing Radiant's cash and liquidity position, supporting bank relationships and financing activities, and helping build out treasury processes and controls as the business scales. You will work closely with finance, capital markets, accounting, and the wider business to ensure the Group has the visibility and controls it needs over its cash, funding, and financial risk exposures.

This is an opportunity to help build treasury capabilities from the ground up within a fast-growing AI infrastructure platform, working alongside senior finance leadership on high-impact, high-visibility initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Manage day-to-day cash management activities, including bank account administration, payments oversight, and intercompany funding.

  • Prepare and maintain short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts across the Group, monitoring actual versus forecast performance.

  • Support management of banking relationships, including account opening/closing, KYC processes, and day-to-day bank queries.

  • Assist with the administration of financing arrangements, including drawdowns, covenant monitoring, and compliance reporting.

  • Support treasury-related aspects of financing transactions, including due diligence, documentation review, and liaison with lenders and advisors.

  • Monitor and help manage financial risk exposures (FX, interest rate, and counterparty risk), including implementing hedging strategies where appropriate.

  • Maintain and develop treasury policies, procedures, and controls, ensuring compliance with internal governance requirements.

  • Prepare treasury reporting and analysis for senior management, including liquidity, debt, and risk dashboards.

  • Partner with the wider finance team on cash forecasting, working capital initiatives, and ad hoc treasury projects as the function scales.

What You'll Bring

  • 5–8 years of experience in treasury, corporate finance, banking, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of cash and liquidity management, banking operations, and financial risk management.

  • Experience with financing documentation, covenant monitoring, or debt administration is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Proficiency in Excel; experience with treasury management systems (TMS) or ERP systems including implementation is a plus.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across finance and the wider business.

  • High levels of ownership, integrity, and accountability when handling sensitive financial information.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach with a willingness to build processes and take on new challenges as the function scales.

  • Team-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to shared success above any personal accomplishment or recognition.

  • Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for the AI infrastructure ecosystem, analytical skills and creative problem-solving ability.

Nice to Have

  • Professional qualification (or progress towards one), such as ACT (Association of Corporate Treasurers), ACA, ACCA, or CFA.

  • Experience in infrastructure, data centres, energy, or technology sectors.

  • Exposure to project or acquisition finance, syndicated debt, or capital markets transactions.

  • Experience with FX and interest rate hedging instruments.

  • Familiarity with treasury management systems (e.g., Kyriba, GTreasury, or similar).

What Success Looks Like

  • Robust, reliable cash flow forecasting and reporting across the Group.

  • Strong, well-managed banking relationships and efficient payment processes.

  • Clear visibility and proactive management of the Group's financial risk exposures.

  • Well-documented and controlled treasury policies that scale with the business.

  • Become a trusted advisor to the wider team.

Why Join Radiant

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry

  • Build infrastructure that underpins the next industrial revolution.

  • Help shape a category-defining company at the intersection of power, compute and capital.

  • Participate in the company's growth and value creation.

  • Collaborate with experienced operators, investors and technologists.

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. 

This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

This may not be the right role for you if: 

  • You aren't willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You aren't a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.
  • You have nothing more to learn: Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won't get us there.

In this role, you will: 

  • This is a pure hunter role focused on 90% net-new logo acquisition," and "Candidates must have a minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role.Work on strategic account mapping & outbound prospecting
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • Previous experience in a pure hunter role focused on 80-90% net-new logo acquisition
  • Minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement
  • Experience handling complex mid-large deal cycles
  • Value-based selling approach
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and curious by nature

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

raw.title: Object Detection and Tracking Engineer (R5244)
raw.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

This position is ideal for an individual who thrives on building advanced perception systems that enable autonomous aircraft to operate effectively in complex and contested environments. A successful candidate will be skilled in developing real-time object detection, sensor fusion, and state estimation algorithms using data from diverse mission sensors such as EO/IR cameras, radars, and IMUs.

 

The role requires strong algorithmic thinking, deep familiarity with airborne sensing systems, and the ability to deliver performant software in simulation and real-world conditions. Our Perception Engineers are instrumental in creating the situational awareness that underpins autonomy, ensuring our systems understand and respond to the operational environment with speed, precision, and resilience. 

What you’ll do:

  • Develop advanced perception algorithms — Design and implement robust algorithms for object detection, classification, and multi-target tracking across diverse sensor modalities.

  • Implement sensor fusion frameworks — Integrate data from vision systems, radars, and other mission sensors using probabilistic and deterministic fusion techniques to generate accurate situational awareness.

  • Develop state estimation capabilities — Design and refine algorithms for localization and pose estimation using IMU, GPS, vision, and other onboard sensing inputs to enable stable and accurate navigation.

  • Analyze and utilize sensor ICDs — Interpret interface control documents (ICDs) and technical specifications for aircraft-mounted sensors to ensure correct data handling, interpretation, and synchronization.

  • Optimize perception performance — Tune and evaluate perception pipelines for performance, robustness, and real-time efficiency in both simulation and real-world environments.

  • Support autonomy integration — Work closely with autonomy, systems, and integration teams to interface perception outputs with planning, behaviors, and decision-making modules.

  • Validate in simulated and operational settings — Leverage synthetic data, simulation environments, and field testing to validate algorithm accuracy and mission readiness.

  • Collaborate with hardware and sensor teams — Ensure seamless integration of perception algorithms with onboard compute platforms and diverse sensor payloads.

  • Drive innovation in airborne sensing — Contribute novel ideas and state-of-the-art techniques to advance real-time perception capabilities for unmanned aircraft operating in complex, GPS-denied, or contested environments.

  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 10-15% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events). 

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience 

  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 7 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.

  • Background in implementing algorithms such as Kalman Filters, multi-target tracking, or deep learning-based detection models.

  • Familiarity with fusing data from radar, EO/IR cameras, or other sensors using probabilistic or rule-based approaches.

  • Familiarity with SLAM, visual-inertial odometry, or sensor-fused localization approaches in real-time applications.

  • Ability to interpret and work with Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and hardware integration specs.

  • Proficiency with version control, debugging, and test-driven development in cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on integration or algorithm development with airborne sensing systems.

  • Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or Tensorflow, particularly for vision-based object detection or classification tasks. * Experience deploying perception software on SWaP-constrained platforms.

  • Familiarity with validating perception systems during flight test events or operational environments.

  • Understanding of sensing challenges in denied or degraded conditions.

  • Exposure to perception applications across air, maritime, and ground platforms.

raw.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

This position is ideal for an individual who thrives on solving complex integration challenges that span hardware, software, and systems engineering. A successful candidate will be skilled at deploying autonomy solutions onto unmanned platforms, preparing systems for flight, and troubleshooting mission-critical issues in both lab and field environments.

 

The role is highly dynamic, requiring hands-on experience, strong systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, real-world test conditions. Our Flight Integration Engineers are essential to bridging the gap between R&D and deployment, ensuring that autonomous systems function reliably and effectively when and where they are needed most. 

What you'll do:

  • System Integration & Deployment — Integrate autonomy software onto unmanned aircraft systems, ensuring seamless operation across onboard compute, sensors, and control interfaces.

  • Pre-flight Preparation — Own the build, configuration, and validation process for flight-ready systems; coordinate hardware/software compatibility and mission readiness.

  • On-site Flight Test Support — Travel to test sites and support live flight operations, including safety checks, system bring-up, and troubleshooting under time-critical constraints.

  • Hardware/Software Debugging — Diagnose and resolve integration issues across complex autonomy software stacks and embedded systems in lab and field environments.

  • Flight Data Capture & Analysis — Manage data collection during missions and post-test analysis, working with autonomy engineers to refine behaviors and identify improvements.

  • Collaboration Across Teams — Work closely with autonomy, GNC, systems, and test teams to ensure mission-critical functionality is delivered on time and validated thoroughly.

  • Continuous Improvement — Build tools and processes to improve integration timelines, flight test reliability, and team efficiency across deployment cycles.

  • Support Certification and Compliance — Assist with documentation and system-level validation required for certification, airworthiness, and compliance in defense-relevant environments. 

  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 30-40% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events). 

Required qualifications:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience. 

  • Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or 4 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience. 

  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).

  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and experience working with embedded systems, shell scripting, and system diagnostics. 

  • Knowledge of sensor integration, sensor fusion, and middleware frameworks (e.g., ROS, DDS).

  • Hands-on experience supporting flight demos or live exercises. 

  • Experience with simulation tools and environments for testing and validation.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance.

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience supporting unmanned aerial systems or similar flight test campaigns.

  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, flight control systems, or GNC pipelines.

  • Competence in sensor integration, electronics debugging, or avionics bring-up.

  • Proficiency in developing automation tools for system testing, logging, and data parsing.

  • Comfortable interfacing with DoD stakeholders during field events or technical reviews.

  • Experience with UCI and OMS Standards.

raw.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
raw.description:
The DevSecOps Engineer at Shield AI is responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating the software delivery infrastructure required to develop and deploy advanced autonomous systems for defence applications.


This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, cyber security, and defence systems engineering. The DevSecOps Engineer works alongside autonomy, software, systems, integration, and test engineers to create secure and reliable development environments and delivery pipelines that enable teams to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and deploy mission critical software.


The ideal candidate has a strong software and platform engineering background combined with significant experience operating within UK defence environments. They have a strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps, Secure by Design, cyber risk management, security assurance, and the delivery of software into classified and operational environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and operate secure development and deployment infrastructure for Shield AI autonomy and defence programmes.

  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable rapid, repeatable, and secure delivery of autonomy and mission software.

  • Embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring security controls, testing, evidence, and assurance are integrated into engineering workflows rather than treated as separate activities.

  • Apply UK MOD Secure by Design principles throughout the development lifecycle and help engineering teams understand and meet their responsibilities for cyber security and technical assurance.

  • Work closely with software, autonomy, systems, cyber security, integration, and test engineers to establish development environments that support rapid engineering while meeting defence security requirements.

  • Design and maintain development and deployment environments spanning cloud, on premises infrastructure, laboratory environments, simulation, hardware in the loop, and operational platforms.

  • Enable secure software development and deployment across different security classifications and appropriately segmented development environments.

  • Implement automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, dependency scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, software composition analysis, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement.

  • Champion a DevSecOps culture where software engineers take ownership of the security, reliability, deployability, and operational performance of the systems they develop.

Required Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Significant experience delivering software or digital capabilities within UK defence or another highly regulated national security environment.

  • Strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps and Secure by Design, including the integration of cyber security and risk management throughout the capability lifecycle.

  • Experience applying MOD security policies, security assurance processes, and technical security requirements to software intensive defence programmes.

  • Experience developing and operating CI/CD pipelines using modern source control, build, test, artefact management, and deployment technologies.

  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, containerisation, and infrastructure automation

  • Experience with technologies such as Git, GitLab or GitHub, or equivalent tooling.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience supporting DevSecOps, software delivery, or digital engineering activities across NATO nations or multinational defence programmes.

  • Understanding of DevSecOps approaches, security frameworks, and software assurance practices used by other NATO nations, particularly the United States and European NATO partners.

raw.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

Shield AI is a defence technology company building intelligent autonomous systems for defence programmes. We are seeking a Senior Manager, UK Security to establish and lead the UK industrial security capability required to pursue and deliver sensitive Ministry of Defence, allied-government, and prime-contractor programmes.

This hands-on leader will serve as Shield AI's senior UK security adviser and, subject to government approval and contractual need, perform the appropriate Facility Security Controller and Personnel Security Controller responsibilities. The role will align UK operations with Shield AI's global framework while preserving UK sovereign requirements and government direction.

What You'll Do

  • Establish and manage Shield AI's UK security programme across personnel, physical, information, cyber-enabled, and operational security.

  • Lead readiness for Facility Security Clearance (FSC) and Industry Personnel Security Assurance (IPSA), including gap assessments, secure-site preparations, evidence, corrective actions, and continuing assurance.

  • Serve as the principal interface with MoD contracting authorities, the Industry Security Assurance Centre (ISAC), United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV), customers, and prime contractors.

  • Establish and administer the authorised national security vetting process through NSVS, including role validation, sponsorship, clearance verification, transfers, renewals, aftercare, and cessation.

  • Partner with programme owners to identify positions requiring BPSS, SC, enhanced SC, DV, or other directed vetting, based on contractual need and need-to-know.

  • Advise Capture, Business Development, Contracts, Legal, and Programme teams on Security Aspects Letters, DEFCONs, classification guidance, flow-down obligations, costs, schedules, and risks.

  • Develop UK company security instructions, policies, risk assessments, appointment letters, procedures, registers, training, and inspection-ready records.

  • Lead secure-facility and classified-asset controls, including access, storage, accounting, transmission, destruction, visitor management, Requests for Visit, IVCO coordination, and classified logistics.

  • Coordinate with Cybersecurity and IT on secure systems, remote-working controls, government assurance, incident response, and remediation.

  • Work with product security, engineering, Cybersecurity and programme teams to identify UK customer security requirements early, support Secure by Design activities, and ensure product security risks, decisions and assurance evidence are tracked through the lifecycle.

  • Manage UK security incidents, aftercare reporting, foreign ownership or influence concerns, insider and supply-chain risks, and required government notifications.

  • Build metrics, budgets, vendors, and the UK security team as the business grows; support occasional out-of-hours response and UK or international travel.

  • Maintain a UK security risk register covering personnel, physical, information and programme security. Work with Cybersecurity and IT to identify and track relevant cyber risks, and advise or escalate material risks to UK leadership and the Board Level Contact.

Required Qualifications

  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible industrial, government, defence, intelligence, or corporate security experience, including ownership of a UK defence-security programme.

  • Experience serving as, or directly supporting, a UK Facility Security Controller, Personnel Security Controller, Security Controller, or comparable senior supplier-security role.

  • Practical experience with FSC or IPSA readiness and assurance, UKSV sponsorship, NSVS administration, SC or DV aftercare, and government inspection activity.

  • Strong knowledge of the Government Security Classifications Policy, GovS 007: Security, the UK Security Policy Framework, and MoD supplier and contract-security requirements.

  • Experience establishing or operating secure facilities and controls for classified information, systems, material, visitors, and international engagements.

  • Strong leadership, judgement, discretion, writing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate requirements into practical processes in a fast-paced technology environment.

  • British nationality, or qualifying dual nationality including British nationality, subject to government restrictions for designated security-controller duties.

  • Current SC or DV clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain the required level, plus legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current SC or DV clearance and prior appointment as a Facility Security Controller or Personnel Security Controller for an FSC- or IPSA-assured supplier.

  • Experience standing up a security programme or secure facility and supporting multinational defence, NATO, allied, or AUKUS-related work.

  • Relevant degree, professional certification, or recognised security-body membership; working knowledge of U.S. industrial security and export-control requirements is advantageous.

  • Working knowledge of applicable MOD security policy, including JSP 440, and the ability to identify and implement the security requirements specified in contracts.

  • Familiarity with the MOD Cyber Security Model, Defence Standard 05-138, Defence Cyber Certification, Cyber Essentials and supplier security obligations.

Shield AI’s mission is to protect service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We are seeking a Senior or Staff Robotics Perception Engineer to develop and deploy advanced perception and navigation capabilities for autonomous aircraft operating in complex and GNSS-denied environments.

This role requires deep expertise in visual-inertial odometry (VIO), visual SLAM, vision-based navigation, state estimation, and camera–IMU sensor fusion. You will take algorithms from early-stage prototypes through embedded implementation, field testing, and flight validation on operational autonomous platforms.

This is not a general AI/ML or object-detection role. We are looking for an engineer whose core expertise lies at the intersection of robotics perception, VIO/SLAM, state estimation, camera and inertial sensing, and real-time embedded deployment.

What you'll do:

  • Design, develop, and deploy VIO, visual SLAM, visual localization, and vision-based navigation capabilities for autonomous aircraft.

  • Develop robust state-estimation and sensor-fusion solutions using cameras, IMUs, and other onboard sensors.

  • Build geometric computer-vision components, including feature tracking, optical flow, pose estimation, triangulation, and visual localization.

  • Develop geo-localization and map-matching capabilities using satellite, aerial, or orthophoto imagery.

  • Integrate perception and navigation algorithms with flight-control and autonomy systems.

  • Implement and optimize algorithms in C++ for real-time operation on embedded Linux platforms.

  • Develop and maintain real-time camera and video-processing pipelines using technologies such as GStreamer and V4L2.

  • Optimize workloads for NVIDIA Jetson, Orin, or comparable embedded-compute platforms, including CUDA and TensorRT where appropriate.

Required qualifications:

  • Significant hands-on experience developing robotics perception or navigation systems.

  • Strong expertise in VIO, visual SLAM, vision-based navigation, or GNSS-denied localization.

  • Deep understanding of camera–IMU sensor fusion, state estimation, calibration, and time synchronization.

  • Strong knowledge of geometric computer vision, including feature tracking, optical flow, pose estimation, triangulation, and visual localization.

  • Experience deploying perception or navigation capabilities on UAS/UAVs or other autonomous robotic platforms.

  • Strong C++ development skills and experience working in Linux environments.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Orin, or similar embedded-compute platforms.

  • Experience optimizing perception workloads using CUDA, TensorRT, or comparable acceleration technologies.

  • Hands-on experience with GStreamer, V4L2, camera pipelines, and real-time video processing.

  • Experience deploying containerized software to embedded platforms using Docker.

  • Experience with vision-based navigation, geo-localization, or map matching using satellite, aerial, or orthophoto imagery.

  • Familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as OpenVINS, VINS-Fusion, ORB-SLAM3, GTSAM, Ceres Solver, OpenCV, or Kalibr.

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a highly autonomous Staff Systems Administrator to serve as the accountable technical owner for enterprise IT infrastructure and end-user computing within a dedicated, security-sensitive entity environment. This senior individual contributor will design, implement, operate, secure, and continuously improve on-premises systems, cloud platforms, identity services, networks, and endpoints while preserving required legal, operational, information-security, and access boundaries.

The role combines deep infrastructure ownership with hands-on service delivery. The successful candidate will translate security and compliance requirements into durable technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, drive equipment and endpoint hardening, and deliver resilient support to engineering and business teams with minimal oversight.

What you'll do:

  • Infrastructure Ownership (On-Prem & Cloud)

    • Own and operate on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers, storage, backup platforms, identity services, core network services, and enterprise applications.

    • Administer Azure and/or AWS environments with responsibility for availability, capacity, performance, monitoring, secure configuration, backup, and disaster-recovery readiness.

    • Define technical roadmaps, identify operational risks, and independently drive modernization, standardization, scalability, and resilience improvements.

    • Maintain accurate architecture diagrams, inventories, operating procedures, recovery documentation, configuration records, and service ownership information.

    • Plan and execute infrastructure changes using disciplined change, testing, rollback, and post-implementation review practices.

    Firewalled Entity and Segmented-Environment Support

    • Operate technology services for a dedicated legal or operating entity with explicit separation of systems, identities, data, administration, suppliers, and access from other corporate environments where required.

    • Implement and maintain approved trust boundaries, network segmentation, firewall policies, secure remote access, administrative tiers, and controlled cross-entity connectivity.

    • Ensure data, devices, accounts, cloud resources, and third-party access remain within authorized entity, contractual, regulatory, and data-residency boundaries.

    • Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and corporate IT teams to translate entity-specific obligations into practical controls, operating procedures, and evidence.

    • Document and periodically validate boundary controls, data flows, privileged access paths, exceptions, and intercompany dependencies; escalate gaps and drive remediation to closure.

    • Support local business continuity and operational autonomy while aligning with approved global architecture, security standards, and governance.

    Security, Compliance, and Systems

    • Establish, implement, and maintain secure configuration baselines for Windows, macOS, Linux, servers, network devices, cloud services, and endpoint-management platforms using recognized frameworks and vendor guidance.

    • Own patching and vulnerability-remediation workflows, including asset coverage, risk-based prioritization, remediation timelines, exception documentation, validation, and status reporting.

    • Administer and validate endpoint protections such as full-disk encryption, EDR/XDR, host firewall, secure boot, application controls, device compliance, removable-media controls, and least-privilege configurations.

    • Harden identity and administrative access through role-based access control, multifactor authentication, privileged-access separation, conditional access, service-account governance, and periodic access reviews.

    • Maintain logging, alerting, time synchronization, configuration monitoring, backup protection, and security telemetry needed for detection, investigation, and auditability.

    • Collect and maintain audit-ready evidence; support internal and external audits, control assessments, security reviews, customer requirements, and remediation plans.

    • Participate in incident response, containment, recovery, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for infrastructure and endpoint security events.

    • Manage technical risks and policy exceptions transparently, including compensating controls, accountable owners, expiration dates, and closure plans.

    Identity, Endpoint, and Service Delivery

    • Administer Active Directory and Entra ID or equivalent identity platforms, including user and group lifecycle, authentication, authorization, federation, and policy enforcement.

    • Manage Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints through Intune, Jamf, or equivalent tooling, ensuring secure provisioning, configuration compliance, software deployment, inventory accuracy, and timely retirement.

    • Lead onboarding and offboarding activities, including device provisioning, access configuration, license assignment, asset recovery, and compliance validation.

    • Provide advanced troubleshooting and escalation support for employees, engineering systems, lab environments, collaboration services, and secure connectivity.

    • Own IT asset lifecycle, software licensing, vendor coordination, procurement support, warranty management, and secure equipment disposal.

    • Use scripting and automation to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and provide meaningful operational and compliance reporting.

    • Contribute reusable infrastructure patterns, standards, and documentation that can scale across comparable international entity environments.

Required qualifications:

  • 8 + years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, enterprise IT operations, or a closely related discipline.

  • Demonstrated success independently owning production IT infrastructure and end-user environments in a complex, regulated, segmented, or security-sensitive organization.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Windows, macOS, and Linux; server administration and virtualization; Azure and/or AWS; and Active Directory and Entra ID or equivalent identity platforms.

  • Practical experience implementing system and endpoint hardening, configuration baselines, patch management, vulnerability remediation, encryption, endpoint detection and response, and least-privilege controls.

  • Experience supporting security or compliance programs and producing evidence for audits, assessments, or customer and regulatory requirements.

  • Strong networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, network segmentation, firewall policy, and secure remote access.

  • Experience with endpoint management platforms such as Intune, Jamf, or equivalent, including compliance policy and device lifecycle management.

  • Experience implementing and testing monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities.

  • Excellent documentation, prioritization, risk communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to drive outcomes under limited supervision.

  • Ability to support time-sensitive operational needs and participate in planned after-hours maintenance or incident response when required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting a firewalled, ring-fenced, subsidiary, joint-venture, sovereign, or otherwise separately governed entity environment.

  • Experience supporting engineering, R&D, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or other mission-critical technical teams.

  • Working knowledge of recognized security and compliance frameworks such as CIS Controls and Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials, or equivalent local and contractual standards.

  • Experience with security tooling such as SIEM, vulnerability-management platforms, privileged-access management, data-loss prevention, certificate management, or network-access control.

  • Experience supporting isolated, air-gapped, export-controlled, or data-residency-restricted systems.

  • Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, infrastructure as code, or configuration-management tooling.

  • Familiarity with GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD environments, and secure engineering workflows.

  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, AWS, VMware, Cisco, CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CISM, GIAC, ITIL, or equivalent.

Our international teammates receive a comprehensive total rewards package aligned to your country office location. For full details on compensation and benefits, please consult your talent acquisition partner.

raw.title: Staff Systems Engineer - Autonomy & Software (5652)
raw.description:
The Systems Engineer, Autonomy & Software at Shield AI is responsible for solving complex systems engineering challenges associated with the development, integration, and deployment of advanced autonomous systems for defense applications.


This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, software engineering, and autonomy. The Systems Engineer works across multidisciplinary engineering teams to translate mission and customer needs into system requirements, architectures, interfaces, and verification strategies while maintaining a deep technical understanding of the software and autonomy capabilities being delivered.


The ideal candidate has a strong background in software and autonomy, is comfortable developing and debugging software in C++ and Python, and has significant experience applying systems engineering principles within complex defense programs. They should be equally comfortable working at the system level and diving into technical implementation when required.

What you’ll do

  • Apply systems engineering principles to the development and integration of autonomous systems for defense applications.

  • Translate operational needs, mission objectives, and customer requirements into clear system, subsystem, software, and autonomy requirements.

  • Develop and maintain system architectures, functional decompositions, interface definitions, Interface Control Documents, requirements traceability, and verification strategies.

  • Work closely with autonomy, software, guidance, navigation and control, avionics, hardware, test, and platform engineering teams to ensure successful system integration.

  • Define and manage interfaces between Hivemind Autonomy, vehicle systems, mission systems, sensors, communications, payloads, and external systems.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the underlying autonomy and software architecture, including how system level requirements translate into software behavior and implementation.

  • Develop software, prototypes, analysis tools, test infrastructure, and engineering utilities using C++ and Python when required to solve integration and system level engineering problems.

  • Use code, simulation, logs, telemetry, and other engineering data to investigate system behavior, diagnose failures, validate assumptions, and support technical decision making.

  • Lead and support system integration activities across simulation, software in the loop, hardware in the loop, ground test, and flight test environments.

Required Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical discipline.

  • 5+ years of experience developing, integrating, or delivering complex software intensive systems, preferably within aerospace, defense, robotics, or autonomous systems.

  • Strong software engineering background with hands on experience developing and debugging software in C++ and Python.

  • Experience with autonomous or robotic systems, including familiarity with areas such as perception, planning, estimation, guidance, navigation, controls, or mission autonomy.

  • Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and their application to complex defense systems.

  • Experience developing and managing system and subsystem requirements, including requirements decomposition, allocation, traceability, and verification.

  • Experience developing system architectures, functional architectures, interface definitions, Interface Control Documents, and other system level engineering artifacts.

raw.title: Staff Talent Sourcer - UK & EU
raw.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

Job Description:

We’re looking for a Staff Talent Sourcer who lives and breathes talent discovery - someone who can take complex, highly specialized talent needs across multiple functions and translate them into precision sourcing strategies across the EU region. You’ll be the go-to expert for talent intelligence, market mapping, proactive candidate generation, and pipeline cultivation across our aerospace, autonomy, AI, advanced hardware, and broader business organizations.

This isn’t just a "find resumes" role - it’s about building intelligence, relationships, and repeatable systems that fuel our hiring engine across EU. As a Staff Talent Sourcer, you'll serve as a strategic partner to recruiters and hiring leaders while leveraging modern AI tools, regional market intelligence, and scalable sourcing practices to help us identify and hire world-class talent across a broad range of functions, levels, and geographies.

What you'll do:

  • Own the top of funnel: Partner closely with recruiters and hiring leaders to define target profiles and build deep, data-informed sourcing strategies across EU for roles spanning Engineering, Software, Embedded, AI/ML, Systems, Manufacturing, Operations, Product, Program Management, Corporate functions, and other critical disciplines.

  • Map the EU market: Develop comprehensive talent landscapes by company, skillset, function, geography, seniority, and organizational structure across key European and EU markets; identify hidden talent pools, competitor insights, regional talent hubs, and emerging talent trends to inform recruiting strategy and workforce planning.

  • Generate and engage: Use advanced Boolean search techniques, sourcing platforms, and creative sourcing channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, HireEZ, GitHub, professional communities, niche industry networks, conferences, referrals, and more) to identify, engage, and attract exceptional talent across diverse functions and EU markets.

  • Build pipelines proactively: Cultivate long-term relationships with passive, highly specialized, and hard-to-find talent across EU to enable just-in-time hiring across strategic programs, business functions, and growth markets.

  • Navigate diverse talent markets: Develop deep expertise across Eu countries and talent ecosystems, adapting sourcing strategies to local market dynamics, candidate expectations, languages, mobility considerations, competitive landscapes, and regional hiring requirements.

  • Leverage AI to scale sourcing: Design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered sourcing workflows, research agents, and practical automations that increase recruiter productivity, accelerate candidate discovery, enhance market intelligence, and improve operational efficiency.

  • Build repeatable sourcing systems: Use AI tools and workflow automation to create structured market maps, talent intelligence reports, outreach content, sourcing documentation, and scalable recruiting processes that can be leveraged across the Talent Acquisition organization and adapted to different EU markets.

  • Be the sourcing SME: Serve as the subject matter expert on EU sourcing by coaching recruiters and hiring managers on regional market insights, sourcing strategy, talent availability, competitive intelligence, candidate engagement best practices, and emerging recruiting technologies.

  • Partner for impact: Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition Operations, Employer Brand, University Recruiting, People teams, and business leaders to optimize recruiting strategies, outbound messaging, candidate experience, and operational excellence across EU.

  • Track and iterate: Use recruiting analytics, experimentation, and storytelling to measure sourcing effectiveness across markets, optimize outreach strategies, improve conversion rates, identify regional differences, and continuously evolve sourcing practices.

Required qualifications:

  • 8+ years of sourcing experience, with significant experience supporting hiring across multiple EU markets and a broad range of functions and talent profiles.

  • Proven track record in market mapping, competitive intelligence, and candidate generation for highly specialized, difficult-to-fill, and business-critical roles.

  • Demonstrated experience sourcing across multiple disciplines, which may include Engineering, Software, AI/ML, Hardware, Manufacturing, Operations, Product, Program Management, Commercial, G&A, and other corporate functions.

  • Deep expertise in advanced Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, HireEZ, SeekOut, GitHub, and other modern sourcing platforms, with the ability to identify talent across diverse EU markets.

  • Strong knowledge of the EU talent landscape, including regional talent hubs, competitor ecosystems, candidate behaviors, market dynamics, and differences in recruiting across countries.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a consultative partner to recruiters, hiring managers, and senior leaders, influencing hiring strategy through market insights and talent intelligence.

  • Hands-on experience building or leveraging AI-powered sourcing workflows, agentic AI tools, workflow automations, or practical AI solutions that improve recruiting or business processes.

  • Direct experience using AI development environments or coding assistants (such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar tools) to create repeatable sourcing workflows, structured research outputs, market intelligence, process automation, or operational documentation.

  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with passive, niche, senior, or otherwise difficult-to-engage talent across multiple markets.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills with the ability to engage candidates from diverse professional and cultural backgrounds and influence stakeholders across functions and geographies.

  • Strong judgment, curiosity, cultural awareness, and a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies to improve recruiting outcomes.

  • Highly organized, data-driven, and able to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, mission-driven, internationally distributed environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior experience supporting aerospace, defense, robotics, autonomy, AI/ML, advanced technology, manufacturing, or other complex hardware/software organizations.

  • Experience sourcing across multiple European talent markets, including established and emerging technology and engineering hubs.

  • Experience navigating cross-border hiring considerations, candidate mobility, work authorization, export control, or other regulatory considerations relevant to hiring across EU.

  • Experience sourcing across both highly technical and non-technical functions, with the ability to quickly develop expertise in new talent markets and disciplines.

  • Familiarity with Ashby and recruiting analytics, CRM, or talent intelligence platforms.

  • Experience supporting high-growth, venture-backed, multinational, or rapidly scaling technology organizations.

  • Demonstrated passion for staying ahead of emerging recruiting technologies, regional talent trends, sourcing methodologies, and AI advancements.

 

Our international teammates receive a comprehensive total rewards package aligned to your country office location. For full details on compensation and benefits, please consult your talent acquisition partner.

We're looking for an exceptional AI-native operator to join Smartly as Chief of Staff, People & AI Transformation, working directly with our Chief People Officer.

Smartly is a global technology company at the intersection of AI, advertising, and creativity. As AI transforms how businesses operate, we're rethinking how we organize work, build capabilities, and unlock productivity across our global organization.This is an opportunity to be at the center of that transformation.

You'll help drive some of our most important strategic initiatives—from launching new R&D centers globally to building an entirely new approach to workforce planning. You'll create the operating rhythm that keeps our People leadership team aligned, accountable, and moving forward. And you'll build AI-powered tools, agents, and workflows that connect information, automate processes, and help us make better decisions.

We're looking for a builder, not just a coordinator.

You're the kind of person who sees a messy problem, builds a plan, gets the right people moving, and then asks how AI could make the whole process 10x better.

What You'll Do

Drive high-impact transformation projects

  • Own the execution of strategic, cross-functional initiatives, including global expansion, workforce planning, organizational transformation, and AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Translate ambitious priorities into clear project plans, milestones, deliverables, and accountability.
  • Bring senior stakeholders together, unblock decisions, and ensure important initiatives move forward with urgency and discipline.

Build AI-powered tools and operating systems

  • Design and build AI agents, automations, and workflows that make our People organization more effective.
  • Develop tools that connect People data with Finance, Operations, and business performance metrics to improve visibility into organizational effectiveness and transformation outcomes.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies, prototype new solutions, and turn successful experiments into scalable workflows.
  • Partner with technical and analytics teams to ensure solutions are reliable, secure, and useful.

Be the operational engine of our People leadership team

  • Establish a consistent cadence of planning, reporting, project reviews, and accountability across our global People organization.
  • Create dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into strategic priorities, progress, risks, and decisions.

  • Help our Chief People Officer and leadership team stay focused on the work that matters most.

Who You Are

  • An AI-native builder. You don't just use AI tools—you've built agents, automations, or workflows that solve real problems. You're constantly experimenting with what's new.
  • An exceptional operator. You're highly organized, detail-oriented, and relentless about follow-through. Nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Entrepreneurial and resourceful. You thrive in fast-moving environments, figure things out independently, and love building from scratch.
  • Confident and people-oriented. You enjoy meeting people, asking questions, and engaging senior leaders. You're comfortable pushing for clarity and accountability.
  • Analytical and articulate. You can turn messy information into clear thinking, compelling presentations, and actionable recommendations.
  • Intellectually curious. You learn quickly, challenge conventional thinking, and get energized by unfamiliar problems.

You likely have 2–5 years of experience in a high-growth startup, founder's office, strategy and operations, consulting, product operations, or a similarly demanding environment.You don't need an HR background or a traditional Chief of Staff title. We're far more interested in what you've built, how you think, and what you're capable of becoming.

Why This Role?

  • You'll work directly with the Chief People Officer on initiatives that shape how a global technology company operates.
  • You'll gain exposure to executive decision-making, international expansion, organizational strategy, AI transformation, and the future of work—while taking real ownership from day one.
  • You'll have the freedom to experiment, build new tools, challenge existing processes, and make a visible impact.

If you're ambitious, love solving hard problems, and want to help build the operating model of an AI-native company, we'd love to hear from you.

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

raw.title: Growth Associate
raw.description:
About us

Every large industrial company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made.

STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data.

STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup, profitable and majority founder-owned with our Series A still ahead of us, funded by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by 15 global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

The role

You own how we reach the commercial leaders at Europe’s largest manufacturers, and whether they reply. You plan and run the campaigns, make the calls, write the sequences, build the materials that get someone into a room, and keep the pipeline numbers our CRO takes to the board. You do all of it with AI tooling that lets one person cover what used to take a team, and you work directly with the CEO, CRO and CMO on what to try next.

Tasks

  • Run campaigns end to end. Plan, launch, and optimise outreach campaigns. Write, test, measure, iterate.

  • Own outbound. Run cold calling, email sequences, and LinkedIn programmes targeting commercial leaders at Europe’s largest manufacturers, armed with the AI-recommended warm intro paths and account intelligence.

  • Drive our paid channels. Organise, launch, and optimise paid campaigns, from targeting and creative through to spend decisions and attribution.

  • Build materials that win meetings. Produce client documents, demos, and interactive presentations from our library of high-end content, using our templates and AI tooling. Fast turnaround, senior-team standard.

  • Keep the engine clean. Log your activity, keep pipeline data spotless in HubSpot, and produce the weekly pipeline, coverage, and forecast numbers the CRO uses to manage the number and brief the board.

  • Make our commercial engine sharper every week. New plays, new automations, new content for the library. What you build compounds.

  • Use AI as a force multiplier. We are an AI-first company. You will use our AI tooling and automations to do the work of a team several times your size.

Who this is for

Most people who do well here have one to three years behind them in growth, sales development or commercial execution at a B2B software company, or a strategy background and a clear preference for doing the work over advising on it.

  • You have run outreach yourself and can tell us the numbers: how many you sent, what came back, and what you changed when it didn’t work.

  • You write well under constraint. Most of this job is persuading a busy executive in four sentences, and you know the difference between a cold email that lands and one that gets deleted unread.

  • You reach for automation before you reach for repetition. HubSpot, Sales Navigator, sequencing tools and modern AI tooling are things you have used already, or will teach yourself over a weekend.

  • You measure yourself on meetings booked and pipeline created.

  • You are comfortable hearing that your campaign didn’t work, and quick to change it.

This probably isn’t for you if you want a defined remit, a marketing role one step removed from the phone, or a job where someone else owns the number.

What we offer

  • Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

  • A highly competitive salary

  • Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

  • Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

  • Private healthcare

  • Pension scheme

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

  • Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time

  • Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available

  • A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes

Practicalities

  • London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

The process

  1. First round with our Talent Lead — 30 minutes

  1. Hiring Manager interviews with CRO – 30 minutes

  1. Stakeholder interview with CMO – 30 minutes

  1. Final interview with CEO – 30 minutes

Any questions before you apply, email me at -----

Graduate Tax Analyst
raw.description:
Learn tax from scratch. Then help rebuild how it's done.

No prior tax knowledge needed. We'll teach you the tax and fund your professional qualification.

What you bring is the other half: SQL, code, and hands-on experience using AI workflows to turn large datasets into clear answers. Because tax, it turns out, is a data problem with deadlines.

And you'll join while the tax function is still being built, so the tools you make become part of how it runs.

 

The Job

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries. Every new market and product line brings tax questions, and you'll help answer them.

  • Plan for what's next: work with our Director of Finance and tax specialists on tax planning for new markets and products, and build your own view of how tax works across the business.

  • Follow the data: map how tax data moves from our systems to our returns, and spot where it could be faster, more accurate or better controlled.

  • Fix what you find: turn those findings into a plan and take a leading role delivering it, using AI and better data so manual steps become the exception.

  • Ship tools people use: build tax tools on live financial data, from first idea to everyday use.

  • Deliver the returns: work with our tax specialists on returns and reporting across our markets, on processes you helped improve.

 

Why you'll want it

A qualification, paid for. Learn tax on the job from specialists across multiple disciplines, with your professional qualification funded.

The whole function, not one corner. Planning, launches, processes and returns: you'll see how tax works across a high-growth fintech, start to finish.

Real outcomes, early. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you own real work early and take on more as soon as you're ready.

A CV with both halves. You'll come out knowing tax, and knowing how to build the AI-enabled systems behind it in a regulated business.

 

Is this you?

You have, or are on track for, a first-class degree in a numerate subject (or equivalent experience). You're graduating in 2026 or 2027, or you're up to two years into your career.

You write strong SQL plus Python or similar, and you've used AI workflows on large datasets in practice.

You think in systems, and you can explain technical work to people who don't write code.

And you're genuinely curious about tax, with the drive to qualify.

 

Never studied tax? That's the part we teach. Send your CV, even if it isn't polished yet.

raw.description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Тoday, we serve over 5 million clients, with more than €30 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.

The role

As a Compliance Associate in the Advisory team at Trading 212 UK, you'll help the business meet its FCA obligations through day-to-day second line advice, review and approval. You'll handle time-sensitive requests from across the business, including financial promotions, client communications, employee compliance and regulatory queries, and help keep the UK compliance framework up to date.

What you’ll do

  • Review and approve financial promotions for Trading 212 in line with FCA rules, Consumer Duty and internal guidelines.

  • Review and approve client communications.

  • Respond to compliance queries from the business on a wide range of subjects.

  • Review and approve professional client opt-up applications.

  • Support partner and affiliate onboarding reviews.

  • Deliver compliance inductions and support the Compliance training plan, including training materials.

  • Support horizon scanning, impact assessments, gap analyses and implementation of regulatory change.

  • Review and update policies, procedures and the Compliance Manual.

  • Support SM&CR administration, FCA notifications, regulatory reporting and responses to FCA requests.

  • Support product governance, appropriateness and Consumer Duty work on new products and changes.

  • Collect data and help produce monthly MI.

  • Support senior members of the team with projects and ad hoc tasks.

What you need to have

  • 2–3 years' compliance experience within an FCA-regulated firm, ideally in retail investments, brokerage or payments.

  • Experience reviewing financial promotions or client communications is strongly preferred.

  • Working knowledge of FCA rules, including COBS 4, PRIN and Consumer Duty, SYSC and SM&CR.

  • Ability to manage a high volume of time-sensitive work accurately and prioritise under pressure.

  • Strong attention to detail and record-keeping.

  • Strong IT skills.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, Business or any other relevant field.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a high-performance

  • A strong drive for excellence and a continuous improvement mindset

  • Strong time management and organizational abilities

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Working with a highly motivated and successful team of high performers - with real ownership and room to grow

  • A culture that values talent, ideas, and execution

  • Challenges that will help you grow fast and unlock your potential

raw.title: Account Executive (Travel)
raw.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded in 1992 with a simple mission for a service-minded enterprise providing the highest quality language services to leading organizations worldwide. Since then, we've spent more than three decades solving global business challenges for our clients. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need.

Whether that’s through a technical document in 50 different local languages, or website, an online store, a customer support center, or the development of multilingual AI - as our clients’ business offerings have evolved, so has our solutions.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

We are seeking ambitious business development professionals with a proven track record of success in sales and a passion for building lasting client relationships. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and winning new business through to account development and long-term relationship management.

While the primary focus of the role is acquiring new travel clients through a proactive, direct sales approach, successful candidates will also have the opportunity to develop and grow the relationships they establish. You will be responsible for promoting our services to corporate clients, with the benefit of uncapped commission and ongoing ownership of the accounts you bring on board.

This role offers growth potential for high performers, with opportunities to progress based on sales results, business growth, and leadership capability.

Key position responsibilities:

  • Source and close new clients through referrals, cold outreach, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

  • Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

  • Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

  • Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

  • Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

  • Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

  • Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

  • Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 2 years successful sales experience

  • Fluency in English and German with excellent communication skills

  • Proven track record in achieving sales targets

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection.
